- [VSCode] Changed `ultrathink` to run its turn at `xhigh` effort and show in a rainbow in the chat box, as in the terminal
- [VSCode] Fixed the missing Effort slider, Ultracode switch and model name when the model setting has the `[1m]` tag, such as `opus[1m]`
- [VSCode] Fixed saved `/btw` side-question history being deleted too early while a settings file has errors
- [VSCode] Fixed a conversation coming back in Auto mode after a reload or restart when its plan was approved with "Yes, and manually approve edits"
- [Cloud sessions] Added a form card to cloud sessions, so you can fill in or decline a form an MCP server asks for instead of the request being canceled without you seeing it
- [Cloud sessions] Added a "Catching up…" line that shows while a cloud or Remote Control session you switch back to is still bringing its messages up to date
- [Cloud sessions] Changed network secrets so Enterprise members can add and delete them on their own cloud environments, instead of only viewing them
- [Cloud sessions] Improved the Changes pane for cloud sessions: the note about what the list leaves out is now a badge beside the branch name, not a row above the diff
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed file search in a cloud session's Files pane showing folders as ../.. paths after Claude changed directory; results now show their path from the project's root
- [Claude Tag] Fixed Claude refusing to edit or append to a canvas it made in a Slack channel, from that channel, once the canvas was also shared to another channel or a DM
- [Claude Tag] Fixed untagged replies going unanswered in a Slack Connect thread when both organizations have installed Claude and Slack delivered the reply to the other organization's app
- [Claude Tag] Fixed a cloud scheduled task's live status checklist in Slack staying half-done; a run can now edit the top-level messages it posted during that run
- [Claude Tag] Changed a Slack channel's Respond automatically switch to a "How Claude participates" choice on the channel's Configure page and in Claude Tag admin settings
- [Code Review] Added a findings-by-severity card to the Code Review analytics page, showing the period's total findings, a daily chart stacked by severity, and each severity's count

releases.name: v2.1.317
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added a warning to `/schedule` when a new cloud scheduled task gets connectors you did not ask for, with how to remove them
- Added a check that asks before a web or shell tool call sends your account email address to the network
- Added `onFailure: "block"` for Agent SDK hook callbacks, so a callback that fails blocks the action instead of letting it run
- Added a notice in Claude Desktop's Code tab when your organization's remote managed settings haven't loaded for the session, and another once they do
- Added a notice when auto mode's check has no answer for a subagent's tool call, which used to leave nothing in the main view
- Added `anthropic.plan`, `anthropic.seat_type`, `anthropic.provider` and `anthropic.custom_base_url` to OTel metrics, events and spans
- Added a cost report to the Claude apps gateway admin API, `GET /v1/organizations/analytics/cost`, for reading past spend over a date range in total, per developer, per day or per IdP group
- Added a daily record of each developer's IdP groups on Claude apps gateways with `admin:` set, kept for `admin.identity_retention_days`, which the cost report groups by
- Added `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_SESSION_ID`: set it to `1` on a self-hosted runner to have `claude -p` run inside a session use that session's ID and transcript, as in earlier versions
- Fixed project and local MCP servers disconnecting after the first turn in some Claude desktop sessions
- Fixed auto mode failing every turn when an LLM gateway set as the base URL answers 403 or 422 to its server-side safety check (a 403 with an apiKeyHelper is unchanged)
- Fixed `claude auth status` exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run
- Fixed a project's `effortLevel` setting being ignored by sessions that an app starts ahead of time and then opens in the project, such as new sessions in the desktop app's Code tab
- Fixed `claude --from-pr` reporting "No conversations found" in projects with many sessions when the linked session was older than the first page
- Fixed the second of two simultaneous permission prompts showing no file path or command on claude.ai and the mobile apps
- Fixed Remote Control and SDK hosts offering "don't ask again" on a mod's tool calls
- Fixed session titles being lost in cloud and SDK sessions when a new message or Stop arrived while the title was generating
- Fixed self-paced `/loop` wakeups sometimes not being scheduled when Claude left a field out of its request
- Fixed auto mode in cloud sessions stopping for approval when the Artifact tool uploaded, wrote to a database or saved a file through the outputs folder
- Fixed skills synced from claude.ai being lost or downloaded again every ten minutes when they can't be written to disk
- Fixed `/schedule` leaving a cloud scheduled task's next run time and link out of its results after creating or updating it
- Fixed screen readers speaking a running subagent's elapsed time and token count on every change in screen reader mode
- Fixed a region or network block (HTTP 403) being shown as a sign-in failure; the error now explains the block
- Fixed Claude saying a working claude.ai connector needed authorization or had failed in cloud sessions when a synced plugin included the same server
- Fixed `claude -p` exiting 0 when a full disk or quota lost its transcript or ~/.claude.json writes; it now prints an error and, in text and json output, exits 1. Full NFS exports may be missed
- Fixed edits to settings files made in the first second or so after launch not taking effect until a settings file changed again
- Fixed old transcripts not being cleaned up on machines where some runs skip cleanup, such as runs using `--setting-sources`
- Fixed deleted agent team inboxes being re-created by a teammate's late message
- Fixed a re-created agent teammate being removed from its team by an earlier shutdown approval
- Fixed stored scheduled tasks being impossible to list or delete after scheduled tasks were turned off
- Fixed Claude deleting your most recently updated `/team-onboarding` guide when asked to delete one without naming which
- Fixed Claude saying a `/team-onboarding` guide was deleted when the server refused the delete
- Fixed the Claude apps gateway hiding Amazon Bedrock's "Input is too long." error, which left sessions failing every turn with "upstream rejected the request" instead of compacting
- Fixed self-hosted runner sessions losing recent turns or the whole conversation when restarted while a plan waited for approval
- Fixed "Prompt is too long" after automatic compaction in sessions whose very large CLAUDE.md changed since it was last sent
- Fixed high memory use and slow startup in headless sessions with many plugins that register commands
- Fixed stdio MCP servers receiving an empty `AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK` when their env config sets it to empty; the variable is now unset, so the server can use the machine's own AWS credentials
- Fixed API requests failing with "unable to get local issuer certificate" behind some TLS-inspecting proxies after a root certificate renewal
- Fixed very long conversations losing their earlier summary when compaction had to shorten its own request
- Fixed a PDF's own metadata being able to make Read and @-mentions under-count its pages
- Fixed `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_OPUS` and `DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING_SONNET` having no effect on `[1m]`, other-region and undated spellings of the default model
- Fixed `/artifacts` and the Artifact tool's shared list showing no shared artifacts when you have 200 or more of your own
- Fixed Claude treating partial Grep and Glob results as complete when a search hit its time limit
- Fixed OpenTelemetry exports to an `https://` endpoint through a proxy never being sent when they started while another export was still in progress
- Fixed a flood of connection attempts to a proxy that blocks (HTTP 403) OpenTelemetry exports to an `http://` endpoint
- Fixed OpenTelemetry exports hanging indefinitely behind a proxy that never answers; they now time out after 10 seconds, or `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT` up to 30 seconds
- Fixed resumed sessions telling Claude again about a file change it already knew about
- Fixed Claude sometimes not using a built-in tool in a resumed session after an earlier call failed because the tool was switched off
- Fixed `/remote-control` answering "Unknown command" instead of saying that Remote Control is turned off by the `disableRemoteControl` setting
- Fixed agent team teammates in tmux or iTerm2 panes starting in auto mode when the lead session was in manual mode
- Fixed a background session sometimes losing a just-made change of permission mode when it was upgraded or retired
- Fixed Ctrl+C stopping all running background agents when pressed to clear typed text at the prompt
- Fixed /feedback showing "Enter to confirm" while a report is being sent
- Fixed child processes of a stopped shell command sometimes being sent SIGTERM twice, which could make some programs skip their cleanup
- Fixed `claude -p` run inside a cloud or self-hosted runner session sharing that session's ID: it wrote into the session's transcript, and a restart could resume the wrong conversation
- Fixed `claude -p` run inside a cloud or self-hosted runner session generating a title of its own and sending it to that session
- Improved the error shown on Microsoft Foundry when Azure credentials can't be loaded: it now says to check or refresh them, and reports as `cloud_credential_error`
- Improved `/design-sync` to say up front when your design system has moved to Claude, and stop before building instead of failing at upload
- Improved the startup error when a required Claude apps gateway can't be reached: it points to the network instead of a sign-in, and says when the gateway's TLS certificate can't be verified
- Improved the "Resume this session with" hint shown at exit to repeat the flags you launched with (for example `--chrome --debug`) ahead of `--resume`
- Improved how self-hosted runners recover from server errors: after a 5xx other than 501 or 529, a runner's next poll now opens a new connection instead of reusing the one that failed
- Improved how self-hosted runner sessions recover from server errors: after a 5xx other than 501 or 529, a session now opens new connections instead of reusing the one that failed
- Improved how self-hosted runner sessions recover when connections stop answering: after a heartbeat gets no answer, a session now opens new connections instead of trying each idle one in turn
- Changed SendMessage so a message to a running background agent arrives earlier: its running command moves to the background, without being stopped
- Changed subagents and teammates on a different model from the main conversation to use that model's saved effort level or its default, instead of the session's effort level
- Changed exit to skip the "Background work is running" prompt for plugin monitors
- Changed the built-in `plugin-authoring` skill to offer once, after a mod you built works, to help share the mod
- Removed the Read tool's "file unchanged since your last Read" stub: reading an unchanged file again returns its content
- Windows: Fixed every tool call being refused on some volumes where the native path lookup fails; the working-directory check now compares the folder's identity instead
- Windows: Fixed the session scratchpad and other temporary paths growing with your project's path length in sessions not started by Claude Desktop, which made repositories cloned into them hit the 260-character path limit
- Gateway: Fixed the status line and `/usage` showing a developer's own spend limit as 100% used after their group's pooled budget ran out
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed Claude not seeing the interrupted tool call when a session moves to a new runner and the turn is older than `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS`
- Self-hosted runner: Fixed an MCP server that was switched off coming back on after the session moved to a new machine, when the session service had refused to save the switch
- Remote Control: Improved fork names when the app doesn't set one: a long name keeps its "(fork)" ending, and in sessions started with `claude remote-control` a fork of "Name (fork)" is "Name (fork 2)"
- [VSCode] Fixed forked conversations dropping messages: only one of the tool calls Claude ran in parallel was kept, and the last messages a compaction kept were lost, which could leave Claude's answer without the question it answered
- [VSCode] Fixed a message being lost when Claude did not finish starting in time: the extension now starts Claude once more before showing the error
- [VSCode] Fixed the sign-in screen opening when a request is blocked for its region or network
- [VSCode] Fixed the Account panel showing the plan name with a lower-cased second word
- [VSCode] Fixed file links in a Claude tab opening on top of the chat instead of in another editor group
- [VSCode] Fixed attachment chips, menus, banners and dialogs in the Claude panel staying small when `chat.fontSize` is raised
- [VSCode] Fixed `ultrathink` not raising effort for its turn or showing its rainbow when telemetry is off
- [Cloud sessions] Added a link card to cloud sessions, so you can open or decline a link an MCP server asks you to visit instead of the request going unseen
- [Cloud sessions] Changed the organization environment dialog in admin settings to the personal dialogs' short layout: each section opens from a row, and unsaved input asks before closing
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed adding a network secret for a host that already has one silently replacing it; the Add secret form now refuses and points you to the existing secret
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed new scheduled tasks ignoring your organization's default environment: the form now starts on the one an admin chose instead of the Anthropic-hosted default
- [Remote Control] Fixed the next message to an idle session going unanswered after you restart `claude remote-control`, when you sent it within a minute of your previous message
- [Claude Tag] Changed newly pasted artifact links in Slack to show a simpler card with an Open button that opens the artifact in Claude, instead of Slack's side panel

releases.name: v2.1.318
releases.body:
## What's changed

- Added a record of your answer when Claude Code asks to turn on the mods it writes in a session
- Added `assume_role` on `mantle` upstreams of the Claude apps gateway, for a role in another AWS account and for per-developer AWS cost attribution
- Added an `effort` option to a mod's `$.model.fork`, so a quick side job can run at `low` whatever effort the session uses; the result reports the effort sent
- Added the date a stored claude.ai sign-in ends to `claude auth status` (`loginExpiresAt`) and to `claude -p` JSON results (`credential_expires_at`)
- Added a one-line stderr warning to `claude -p` text output, starting 10 days before a stored claude.ai sign-in ends
- Fixed `--continue` sometimes losing the earlier conversation after a malformed tool call's retries ran out (regression in 2.1.314)
- Fixed macOS sessions with many running Bash commands stalling while memory grew
- Fixed permission prompts being answered by keys typed just after sending a message, or before a slow prompt appeared
- Fixed `/logout`, `claude auth logout` and `claude mcp remove` reporting success, and changes to trust, consent or MCP settings being dropped with no word, when the config file could not be updated on a shared network home directory
- Fixed jobs exiting with `Not logged in` when another terminal or host signs in again to the same account and organization on the same home
- Fixed `claude mcp add` and `remove` writing the config without its lock: they now wait for it or exit 1, though another job's save can still replace a saved server
- Fixed `claude plugin` commands exiting before a slow token refresh was saved, which could sign you out on the next run
- Fixed `claude plugin validate` passing a custom-named marketplace file that `claude plugin marketplace add` rejects
- Fixed stdio MCP servers that exit on the version probe being re-probed on every start; a server that dies in under 3s for its own reason is also pinned to the legacy handshake for 7 days
- Fixed sessions being refused at startup by an `allowedProviders` list that another login on the same machine had stored
- Fixed idle compaction replacing a conversation with a reply that was not a summary
- Fixed the "Now using usage credits" notice reappearing about every 30 seconds while a background subagent is running
- Fixed custom slash commands that fail, or that only Claude can invoke, printing nothing in `claude -p` and SDK sessions
- Fixed `claude -p` and Agent SDK sessions reporting success when an API error cut off a reply while a mod hooked `turn.step`
- Fixed a message sent right after a model change still running after Stop in headless sessions: Stop now cancels or stops it as it would a queued message
- Fixed a deleted session transcript being re-created with its last prompt when an idle non-interactive session exited
- Fixed `claude remote-control` hosts, the background daemon and self-hosted runners failing to start new sessions (`spawn ENOENT`) after an update or version cleanup removed the binary of a still-running process
- Fixed a running Claude Code process owned by another user (for example one left by `sudo claude`) being treated as dead by version cleanup, which could delete its binary
- Fixed `/remote-control` showing a session as available after a failed connection
- Fixed `/design revoke` reporting success when the request failed with a 404
- Fixed a shell command approved after a self-hosted runner or cloud session restart running in the session's start folder, not the folder it was asked in; if that folder can't be entered, it is not run
- Fixed Claude not being told when an approved connector tool was unavailable after a cloud session restart
- Fixed cloud sessions being stopped in the middle of a turn when the service refuses uploads for several minutes
- Fixed variables a `Setup` hook writes to `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE` not reaching the Bash tool in some cloud sessions
- Fixed the iPhone app showing a cloud session's turn as finished while it kept running, after a response was cut off at a tool call or a refused image or document was removed
- Fixed a restarted session re-sending a message that failed with an API error, ahead of the newer message waiting behind it
- Fixed a restarted session dropping its interrupted turn when the restart came right after Claude read a large image or retried a tool call
- Fixed every connection failing when the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file is empty, not PEM, or starts with a damaged certificate: readable certificates are now used, with a warning on stderr
- Fixed workflows re-running finished agents when resumed after a usage limit
- Fixed `/mcp` in cloud sessions counting tools the model can't use; a server's row now shows how many of its tools are available
- Fixed a duplicate notification when Claude left the status field out of a PushNotification call
- Fixed the error for a too-large image in a request with more than 20 images always saying the limit was 2000px; it now shows the API's limit
- Fixed the runtime in background shell details not updating while the dialog is open
- Fixed a mod's `turn.step` hook making a stopped reply finish as a success in headless runs
- Fixed retention cleanup leaving a home that only runs `claude -p` with no `~/.claude.json` backup: it now takes a fresh backup before deleting the last good one
- Fixed the stored login being replaced by an empty file when a network home directory has no room left for data but still takes new files
- Fixed tokens from `setup-token` being refused at start on machines with `forceLoginOrgUUID`, when the token belongs to a permitted organization
- Fixed non-interactive launches replacing a `~/.claude.json` that isn't valid JSON with defaults; the start now fails, says how to restore the file, and leaves it as is (anthropics/claude-code#87551)
- Fixed an empty `~/.claude.json` with no backup being reported as corrupted; Claude Code now starts as it does when the file is missing
- Fixed the restore command printed for a damaged or missing `~/.claude.json` naming an empty or cut-off backup, or failing on a read-only file
- Fixed the sign-in failure when a stored claude.ai login reaches its time limit: it now says so, and in `claude -p` names `claude auth login` and `claude setup-token`
- Improved how `~/.claude.json`, settings files and the stored login survive saves on shared network home directories: they are less often deleted, briefly emptied or replaced by a near-empty or older copy
- Improved sessions on network file systems to look again when the configuration file is wrongly reported as missing, so fewer start without your MCP servers and trusted folders
- Improved MCP tool errors: a call made before the tool is loaded now returns its input schema
- Improved the reliability of git commits and pull request creation when the Bash tool runs macOS's built-in `/bin/bash`
- Improved "Ask your admin for more usage" in the usage limit menu to send the request in one step
- Improved how fast remote sessions reconnect after a pause or sleep
- Improved You should know toasts to say "try again" instead of "press 2", which only works in the terminal
- Improved auto-update reliability: a brief network failure while verifying a release is now retried right away instead of waiting for the next check
- Improved unattended runs (`claude -p`, SDK apps) to stop rewriting `~/.claude.json` on every run when nothing in it changed
- Changed Claude Code to no longer install or update the IDE extension when started in an IDE terminal; use `/ide` from an outside terminal or your editor's extensions view
- Changed subagents to stop instead of switching models when "Switch models when a message is flagged" is set to "Ask each time"
- Changed background subagents to move a shell command to the background after 3 minutes on all providers, so the prompt cache doesn't expire while it runs
- Changed subagent progress summaries on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or with telemetry off: on a cold prompt cache, one can now wait up to 5 minutes for the subagent's pending response
- Changed what a mod attaches at `prompt.submit` to stay in the user's turn rather than go out as a system message
- Changed `deniedMcpServers` URL entries to also block Anthropic-provided servers whose upstream URL matches, and connectors in cloud sessions and on self-hosted runners, where the session is given the connector's own URL; otherwise deny a connector by name
- Changed the `/permissions` rule details, built-in rules and delete confirmation views to use the standard dialog; pressing Ctrl+C twice there now goes back or cancels instead of quitting
- Changed `/claude-api managed-agents-onboard` to give a new agent's built-in tools, and a quickstart template's MCP tools, the `auto` permission policy ("Judge risky actions") by default, matching the Claude Console; say "run without asking" to opt out
- Removed the 2.1.288 fix that kept the model's earlier thinking when resuming a conversation started on 2.1.286 or earlier; that thinking can now be dropped
- Gateway: Added a log warning when the Google access token from a federation (`external_account`) credentials file is about to expire
- Gateway: Improved the log hints about `listen.trusted_proxies`: they now say to list only a proxy that adds the connecting address to `X-Forwarded-For` itself
- Gateway: Improved the warning when AWS CountTokens fails on Amazon Bedrock: it says Claude Code, not the gateway, counts after the 501, and points at IAM only when AWS denies access
- Self-hosted runner: Added `CLAUDE_RUNNER_SPAWN_REASON` to the orchestrator's spawn-runner hook environment: why Anthropic sent the request (e.g. `runner_lost`, `resumed`); unset when none was sent
- Self-hosted runner: Added a startup warning when `--release-idle-session-min` is the last argument with no value (still ignored) or has a value of only spaces (still read as `0`)
- Self-hosted runner: Changed the orchestrator's log lines: `ok session=…` now prints at every log level on stdout (was debug only, stderr) with `reason=…` after `jti=…`, and `nack session=…` ends its fields with `reason=…` after `retryable=…`; update scripts that match `retryable=true:` or `retryable=false:`
- Remote Control: Fixed a misleading "spawn error: ENOENT" when a session's working folder is missing; the error now names the folder
- Remote Control: Improved the title a fork of a terminal fork is created with when the app doesn't set one: "Name (fork 2)"
- [VSCode] Fixed a window whose sign-in the organization's settings refuse starting a new Claude Code process in the background every minute
- [VSCode] Fixed a long word in the chat panel's error banner pushing its close button out of view
- [VSCode] Improved the sign-in screen to show what Claude Code printed when its sign-in status check fails
- [Cloud sessions] Added a No repository option: a cloud session on an Anthropic-hosted environment can now start without picking a repository
- [Cloud sessions] Added the usual Chrome names to cloud sessions, so tools other than Playwright can find the built-in Chromium through google-chrome and CHROME_PATH
- [Cloud sessions] Added a New session button to the card shown when a cloud session's environment was deleted, where the message box is hidden
- [Cloud sessions] Fixed reading GitHub Actions logs in cloud sessions: `gh run view --log` and `gh api` log requests now get the log in most environments, not an unreachable redirect
- [Cloud sessions] Improved most Create PR failure messages in cloud and Remote Control sessions: they now give the reason or a link to GitHub instead of saying Try again
- [Cloud sessions] Changed connector search results to tell Claude that the search covers only part of the connector directory
- [Remote Control] Fixed side-by-side checkouts of one repository looking identical in the environment menu's Remote Control rows; each now shows its own folder name
- [Claude Tag] Fixed keyboard focus and screen reader announcements in Claude Tag admin setup; pressing Escape in the connect form no longer also closes the Add dialog
- [Code Review] Improved the Code Review analytics page to retry once after a server or network failure, then show a Try again banner instead of empty cards

releases.name: 0.147.0-alpha.13
releases.body: Release 0.147.0-alpha.13

## New Features
- Install portable Agent Plugins and search across local, personal, workspace, and remote plugin catalogs. (#36544, #36409, #36919, #36796)
- Organize conversations into persistent, manually ordered sections and browse long transcripts incrementally. (#35722, #36007, #36380, #36948, #36950)
- Enable automatically reviewed approvals with the new `--approve-for-me` CLI flag. (#36373)
- Import Cursor-managed skills and synchronize changes to imported Claude and Cursor conversations without creating duplicates. (#36361, #36356, #35623)
- Support the opt-in MCP 2026-07-28 protocol, including paginated discovery, multi-round requests, and non-blocking server startup. (#35724, #35725, #35590, #35742)
- Enable cached web search and remote conversation compaction for Amazon Bedrock. (#36938, #36981)

## Bug Fixes
- Redact secrets and complete bearer tokens from displayed commands and replayed conversation history. (#36893, #36908)
- Prevent lost or stalled terminal input when focus returns, MCP servers initialize, or Ghostty handles keyboard shortcuts. (#35649, #35957, #36834)
- Correct rendering and cursor positioning for Japanese characters, emoji, hyperlinks, and text near viewport boundaries. (#35960, #35962, #37166)
- Properly interrupt Windows background processes and handle Windows filesystem paths consistently. (#35655, #35851, #37129)
- Require explicit trust for unfamiliar local projects and enforce managed authentication restrictions before credentials are used. (#36960, #37132)
- Harden plugin isolation and deny network access when policy updates fail. (#37027, #36967, #36037)

## Documentation
- Improve the bundled OpenAI documentation skill with targeted official-source lookup and clearer guidance for Codex, model selection, and API workflows. (#36014)

## Chores
- Upgrade the MCP SDK to 3.0.0, Ratatui to 0.30.2, and V8 to 150.4.0. (#36001, #35959, #35831)
- Secure macOS release notarization using Azure Key Vault instead of exporting private signing keys. (#37154)
- Remove the deprecated `codex exec --full-auto` flag; use `--sandbox workspace-write` instead. (#36054)
- Stop publishing redundant Linux bundle archives; use the standard `codex-package-<target>` release archives. (#36342)

## New Features

- Export complete TUI conversations to Markdown with `/export`, either to the clipboard or a new file. (#37358)
- Fork sessions with `codex exec fork`, and archive or restore sessions from the TUI resume picker. (#37367, #37369, #37371)
- Draft prompts while the TUI initializes, with resume and fork progress shown during startup. (#38642, #38788)
- View estimated thread credits or cost in `/status`, status lines, and terminal titles for eligible workspaces. (#38281, #38282)
- Use Amazon Bedrock Runtime as a built-in provider with AWS profile, region, and GPT-5.6 routing support. (#38470)
- Hooks can now run commands asynchronously and invoke MCP tools. (#37533, #38705)

## Bug Fixes

- Model switches and settings updates no longer leave stale instructions behind or change an active turn midstream. (#37260, #38785)
- Resumed sessions now restore their persisted working directory and approval policy, with more accurate transcript previews. (#37198, #37368, #38605)
- Turns reconnect through temporary provider outages, and MCP servers recover after OAuth reauthentication without restarting Codex. (#37337, #37485, #38418)
- TUI startup no longer lets buffered terminal input activate prompts accidentally, and onboarding appears when authentication is missing. (#38641, #38643, #38644)
- Composer and transcript rendering now handle CRLF pastes, wrapped whitespace, and long URLs correctly. (#37709, #38380, #38704)
- Sandbox restrictions now fail closed for denied or unreadable paths across Linux and Windows. (#37875, #38026, #38416, #38660)

## Documentation

- The bundled skill-creator guide is more focused, and validation now rejects unfinished TODO placeholders. (#38384)

## New Features

- Added an interactive `codex agents` dashboard for searching, starting, opening, renaming, and stopping tasks, with configurable shortcuts. (#39094, #39112, #39114, #39142)
- Added `/cd`, `/pwd`, and `/cwd` commands for managing the working directory in TUI sessions. (#38894)
- Added `codex queue` for sending messages to existing local or remote sessions. (#39092)
- Expanded Vim editing with character replacement and more change motions such as `cw`, `c$`, and `cc`. (#39661)
- `codex doctor` now diagnoses endpoint protection, network/proxy failures, desktop app state, and update connectivity. (#38827, #38918, #39060, #39074)
- SDK users can now pass exact CLI config overrides and select `max` or `ultra` reasoning effort. (#38817, #39662)

## Bug Fixes

- Queued messages now wake idle sessions reliably, resolve duplicate session names more usefully, and preserve pasted or deferred command semantics. (#39034, #39385, #39604)
- Resumed and forked threads now restore their active permission profile instead of silently falling back to current defaults. (#39153)
- Fixed duplicate sub-agent activity and tightened TUI routing for sub-agent notifications and approvals. (#39049, #39088)
- Realtime WebRTC sideband connections now reconnect after unexpected transport loss without dropping pending output. (#39257)
- Inline TUI history now remains available in Windows Terminal scrollback. (#39619)
- Inactive TUI thread replay buffers are now bounded to prevent excessive retained streamed output. (#39081)

## Documentation

- Clarified that external contributions should go through issues and design discussion rather than pull requests. (#39089)
- Documented DNS exfiltration risks and trust limitations for secure devcontainers. (#39283)

## New Features

- Reference other Codex tasks with `@` mentions, and ask agents to read, create, or message tasks from the terminal. (#40308, #40315)
- `/copy` now offers a picker for full responses, individual code blocks, and blockquotes. (#39997)
- Unnamed terminal tasks receive descriptive titles automatically, and `/rename` suggests an editable title based on the conversation. (#40492, #40495)
- Markdown links appear as clickable labels in supported terminals, with visible URLs retained elsewhere. (#40471)
- Bind shortcuts to cycle permission modes, and use `.` in Vim mode to repeat your last edit. (#39873, #40521)
- New `Interrupt` hooks can run commands or MCP handlers when an active top-level turn is interrupted. (#40511)

## Bug Fixes

- Untrusted projects no longer supply project-level `AGENTS.md` instructions, and managed deny-read rules remain enforced after permission changes. (#39837, #40004)
- Improved credential redaction in app-server diagnostics, including provider, authentication refresh, and attestation fields. (#39993)
- Fixed remote MCP bearer-token lookup and required-server startup while preserving compatibility with older executors. (#39926, #39952, #39979)
- Fixed elevated Windows sandbox setup and launch aliases under Unicode user paths. (#39971, #40570)
- Prevented Unix shutdown hangs caused by detached processes retaining a terminal or full terminal output buffers. (#40460)
- Fixed conversation compaction and multi-agent compatibility for Amazon Bedrock models. (#39804, #39825)

## New Features

- Vim mode supports `/` and `?` searches within drafts, highlighted matches, and repeat navigation with `n` and `N`. (#41586)
- Rate-limit banners offer actions for checking usage, managing credits, resetting limits, and managing plans. (#41742)
- The terminal UI and `codex exec` show credential-refresh progress, including Amazon Bedrock reauthentication. (#41239)
- MCP server names can contain `:`, `@`, `/`, and `.`, supporting package-style names throughout CLI commands and authentication. (#41700)
- Individual MCP tools support an `output_token_limit` setting, with consistent truncation across session resumes. (#41421)
- App-server clients can configure `thread/shellCommand` timeouts, including deadlines longer than one hour. (#41384)

## Bug Fixes

- Vim-enabled composers now start fresh drafts in Insert mode, including after submitting messages or dispatching slash commands. (#41921)
- Automatic approval reviews can retain longer messages and a larger conversation transcript. (#41931)

- Automatic approval reviews preserve user instructions, answers, and valid authorizations across history compaction. (#41660, #41846, #41852)
- Resumed threads restore their saved working directory when none is supplied, and client metadata updates preserve filesystem permissions. (#41567, #41464)
- MCP tools remain available through cache refreshes and remote plugin changes; authentication retries use refreshed helper-provided headers. (#41336, #41344, #41396, #41400)
- Opening the model picker refreshes available models without losing the highlighted choice. (#41467)
- Fixed Windows sandbox execution with Microsoft Store PowerShell, subprocess hangs on terminal queries, and cursor-related display corruption in older JediTerm terminals. (#41227, #41436, #41673)
- Cloud task requests reject untrusted backend URLs and disable redirects to protect saved credentials. (#41403)

## Chores

- The planning tool is disabled by default; enable it with `tools.update_plan.enabled = true`. (#41744)
- Plugin recommendations begin loading during startup, reducing delays before the first turn. (#41375)

## New Features

- Vim mode now supports undo with `u` and redo with `Ctrl+R`, preserving complete drafts including pasted content and attachments. ([#41941](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41941), [#42140](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42140))
- The plugin CLI can list, install, and remove plugins from remote marketplaces. ([#42150](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42150))
- Set `tui.auto_recap = false` to disable automatic recaps while keeping manual `/recap` available. ([#42101](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42101))
- TUI history shows complete patches, input sent to background terminals, and individual completed commands. ([#41893](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41893), [#42107](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42107))
- Plus and Team users receive an earlier warning when less than half of their allowance remains in an approximately five-hour usage window. ([#42142](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42142))

## Bug Fixes

- TUI sessions reconnect after an external app-server connection drops, preserving drafts and transcripts while keeping uncertain or queued submissions paused for review. ([#41911](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41911), [#41916](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41916), [#41918](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41918))
- Full Access skips Guardian reviews for confirmation-only actions. User approval mode skips background Guardian scoring and prewarming, while sensitive-action checks and requests for user input retain their existing handling. ([#42147](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42147), [#42256](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42256))
- Guardian review history survives compaction, restarts, and user-created forks while respecting rollback boundaries and isolating subagent history. ([#41879](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41879), [#42065](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42065))
- Remembered MCP tool approvals are scoped to the selected app account, and relative MCP executable paths start more reliably on macOS. ([#42133](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42133), [#42117](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42117))
- Rollout compression includes shared histories, `codex exec resume` handles compressed rollouts when selecting by working directory, and thread forks work with symlinked session roots. ([#42039](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42039), [#42135](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42135))

## Configuration and API Updates

- App-server thread metadata includes nullable `model` and `reasoningEffort` fields. Structured asynchronous questions are supported through `request_user_input_async` when enabled by the model catalog. ([#42151](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42151), [#42178](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42178))
- `tui.disable_paste_burst` replaces the top-level setting, which remains supported as a fallback. ([#41976](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/41976))
- Adds the disabled-by-default `features.context_management.experimental_mode` configuration. When enabled for eligible ChatGPT Plus, Pro, or Pro Lite sessions using the Codex backend, it activates token-budget context, history notes, and the `new_context` tool. API-key sessions, custom providers, and temporary structured threads remain excluded. ([#42385](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/42385))

releases.body: Release 0.154.0-alpha.6.1

## New Features

- GPT-6-Astra is now available in the model picker and Amazon Bedrock catalogs. (#42879, #42619)
- Experimental worktree support lets you create isolated checkouts for new or forked sessions using `--worktree` or `/worktree`, then browse and resume them. (#42652, #43069, #43120, #43286)
- Answer questions inline while Codex continues working, using suggested choices or custom text without losing your main draft. (#42891, #42894, #42897)
- Windows sessions can now share a background Codex server, with daemon lifecycle commands and managed updates. (#42405, #42392)
- Vim editing gains `R` replace mode with undo and dot-repeat, plus more reliable Escape handling in legacy terminals. (#42194, #42584)
- Copying responses preserves formatting in rich-text apps, and `/copy` can copy status output or individual session fields. (#42847, #43055)

## Bug Fixes

- Existing sessions pick up newly installed plugin tools and refresh skills and hooks after external plugin upgrades or rollbacks. (#42284, #42593, #42990)
- MCP connections coordinate OAuth token refreshes and surface login challenges when refresh fails, without automatically replaying rejected tool calls. (#42413, #42552)
- Startup avoids running workspace-controlled helpers before trust is established, and the macOS sandbox blocks terminal input injection. (#42324, #42590)
- Remote resume and fork operations preserve saved permissions; fresh sessions and forks respect server model defaults unless explicitly overridden. (#43330, #43177, #43355)
- Resuming a conversation open in another app now shows a read-only transcript with a retry option while preserving your draft. (#43253)
- Automatic approval reviews better preserve authorization context through compaction and reject approvals invalidated by new user instructions or answers. (#42844, #42852, #43442)

## Documentation

- Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs skill with GPT-6-Astra migration, compatibility, and prompting guidance. (#42931)

## Chores

- The deprecated `codex mcp-server` entry point is no longer available. (#42993)

releases.name: Python SDK 0.154.0
releases.body:
Install with `pip install --upgrade openai-codex==0.154.0` (Python 3.10 or later). This release includes the matching `openai-codex-cli-bin==0.154.0` runtime.

- Add `max` and `ultra` reasoning-effort values. [#39662](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/39662)
- Add `ExternalMessage` to synchronous and asynchronous `run()` and `turn()` calls. External content can start a turn or join an active regular turn with tool-level authority; it does not grant user authorization. Consumers receive independent event streams. [#44086](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/44086)
- Add `include_turns` on resume/fork, `turn_service_tier` for one newly started turn, and `source` metadata. History selection changes the returned response, not model context. Existing defaults are preserved when these options are omitted. [#44084](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/44084)
- Refresh generated protocol models and notifications, and preserve completion events that arrive before a turn-start response. [#44032](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/44032), [#44400](https://github.com/openai/codex/pull/44400)

Check these migrations when upgrading:

- `HookMetadata` wraps its handler in `.root`. Replace accesses such as `hook.command` with `hook.root.command`, checking `hook.root.handler_type` before reading handler-specific fields.
- Some previously unknown notifications now have typed payloads. Read named fields instead of `.params`; unknown or invalid payloads still use `UnknownNotification`.
- Manually constructed or late-joining turn handles receive events from their attachment point. Earlier output is not replayed, so collected results can be partial; attaching after completion can raise `TransportClosedError`. Use `thread.read(include_turns=True)` for saved history. Handles returned directly by `thread.turn(...)` retain events from when their request is sent.

Custom `codex_bin` overrides require CLI 0.151.0 or newer for `ExternalMessage` and the new history/per-turn options.

releases.name: Cygwin build inputs and matching source for Windows voice
releases.body:
CI-only build tools for native Windows voice releases. These archives are **not included** in Codex user packages.

- `cygwin-build-inputs.tar.gz`: 103 pinned Cygwin binary packages and the signed package index used by the offline build installer.
- `cygwin-build-sources.tar`: all 83 corresponding source package archives at the exact versions named by that index. It includes the upstream source, patches, and build recipes provided in Cygwin's `-src` packages.
- `cygwin-source-map.json`: each selected binary package mapped to its source archive and the source size and SHA-512 digest from the pinned index.
- `CYGWIN-SOURCE-NOTICE.txt`: source access and licensing notice.

The binary and source archive SHA-256 pins live in `.github/scripts/voice-cygwin-snapshot.json` in the Codex repository. Cygwin describes the licensing terms at https://cygwin.com/licensing.html. Licenses vary by package; consult the corresponding source and binary package archives for their notices.

## New Features

- Added experimental `/voice` conversations with live transcripts and microphone controls on supported builds, enabled through `/experimental`. (#43581, #43651, #44331)
- The TUI now shows live reasoning summaries in the status row and completion timestamps after successful turns. (#43558, #43921)
- Added task hiding, archiving, and deletion in the agents overview, plus worktree ownership details and confirmed deletion of clean managed worktrees. (#43942, #44424, #44433)
- Added Touch ID verification for MCP requests in local TUI sessions on supported Macs. (#43624, #43712, #43715)
- Added configurable daemon update schedules and `codex app-server daemon update`; saved threads and active goals can recover after daemon restarts. (#43542, #43562, #44314)
- Amazon Bedrock can now obtain AWS credentials from configured commands, with caching, expiration-based refresh, and authentication recovery. (#44028)

## Bug Fixes

- Accepted prompts are now saved even when compaction fails before a turn starts. (#44487)
- Fixed missed tmux resizes, transcript viewport restoration, and stale history appearing after switching threads. (#43603, #43889, #43994)
- MCP servers now report expired OAuth credentials accurately and provide reconnect guidance when token refresh fails. (#43947, #44359)
- Automatic approval reviews now preserve complete actions and authorization evidence more reliably, retry transient failures, and distinguish review failures from unsafe-action findings. (#44482, #44569, #44570)
- Switching accounts now invalidates remote-control sessions, cached WebSocket state, and model catalogs belonging to the previous identity. (#43906, #44341, #44489)
- Blocked Windows-process escapes from restricted WSL sandboxes and hardened brokered shell snapshots against credential exposure. (#44286, #43909, #44040)

## Chores

- Aligned Python SDK and runtime publishing with stable CLI releases, using matching versions and verifying runtime assets before SDK publication. (#44067)

## New Features

- Choose an optional fullscreen UI with `/tui` for your next launch, including transcript search, mouse selection, and right-click copying. (#46732, #46734, #46883, #46895)
- Voice conversations are enabled by default, with an F8 toggle, a `/voice settings` picker, and bundled audio runtimes for Linux and Windows. (#44921, #46071, #44622, #44714, #44922)
- Explore account usage, token totals, and plugin and skill activity through the `/usage` analytics dashboard. (#45764, #45769)
- Filter tasks by status and create worktree sessions from the agent command center; worktree support is now enabled by default. (#46839, #45276, #44870)
- Customize the terminal with six new themes and view supported Mermaid diagrams and display equations directly in responses. (#46504, #46054, #45612)
- Update the local background server through `/daemon`, or bypass it with `--no-daemon`. (#45854, #46088)

## Bug Fixes

- Preserve streamed answers and plans when turns fail, are interrupted, or receive subagent completion events. (#45549, #46867)
- Fix clipboard forwarding in tmux and SSH sessions and preserve tab indentation when terminals send pasted text as individual keystrokes. (#45457, #45454)
- Restore Plan mode when resuming sessions and preserve thread identity and settings when editing earlier prompts. (#45519, #45845)
- Recover login through system proxies and refresh MCP credentials when OAuth discovery returns a 503 error. (#46562, #44636)
- Prevent speech from being dropped during playback pauses or bursts of incoming audio. (#46880)
- Close sandbox isolation gaps involving inbound Windows connections, privileged Linux/macOS sockets, and writes through read-only macOS file handles. (#44639, #45984, #46500)

## Documentation

- Clarify that deprecated `friendly` and `pragmatic` personality settings no longer select response styles. (#45809)
- Explain how `?` matches a single character in network proxy allow and deny patterns. (#46027)

## Chores

- Update bundled TLS dependencies, including OpenSSL 3.6.4 for Linux musl builds. (#45149, #45489)

releases.body: Release 0.158.0-alpha.12

## New Features

- Added GPT-6 Sol and Luna, including Amazon Bedrock support and migration prompts for older models. (#47332, #47347)
- Enabled fullscreen transcripts by default and added Shift-click to extend text selections. (#47178, #47414)
- Enabled automatic background-server startup for eligible interactive sessions, with recovery choices when server settings are incompatible. (#47179, #47318)
- Added an `f` shortcut to fork conversations open in another app, preserving drafts and queued prompts. (#47185)
- Made `/import` available in remote sessions and local background-server sessions. (#47317)
- Improved terminal rendering with Unicode bullets, checkboxes, aligned equations, and optimization notation. (#47191, #47322)

## Bug Fixes

- Preserved active voice conversations when switching threads. (#47381)
- Recovered unsent question answers into the composer when turns end, without disrupting active history searches. (#47422, #47423)
- Respected tmux mouse settings and restored native scrollback for Terminal.app over SSH in automatic screen mode. (#47399, #47417)
- Fixed configured proxy routing for realtime connections and standalone web search, including search redirects. (#47101, #47142, #47204)
- Added retries for transient file-upload failures and increased the upload timeout to five minutes. (#47122, #47393)
- Enforced network restrictions across redirects and ongoing HTTP and WebSocket traffic, including cancellation when policy changes revoke access. (#47389, #47407)

## New Features

- Configure copy-on-select and right-click paste in the fullscreen TUI. Copied transcript selections now preserve Markdown formatting. (#47639, #47896, #48118)
- Connect to MCP servers that require pre-registered OAuth client secrets, including through `codex mcp add --oauth-client-secret`. (#47891)
- Secure direct exec-server WebSocket connections with bearer tokens, including connections configured through app-server. (#47601, #47648)
- Image generation and editing can explicitly request transparent backgrounds, and edits now accept file-backed conversation images. (#47484, #47956)
- Terminal input approval is enabled by default for commands running with elevated permissions; runtime-only grants no longer cause unnecessary reviews. (#47799, #48073)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed Windows sandbox failures involving ordinary Windows 10 paths, rejected stored credentials, and large permission policies. (#47672, #47695, #47919)
- Fixed Linux sandbox startup with nested writable roots and preserved Git metadata protections across writable roots on Linux and macOS. (#47623, #47974)
- macOS patch operations now recognize system path aliases covered by existing permissions, avoiding unnecessary approval prompts. (#47879)
- Approval reviews now retry when new user input arrives, so a status question does not automatically abort a pending action. (#47819)
- Mermaid flowcharts now render quoted labels and ampersands; unsupported diagrams explain why they fall back to source. (#47572, #47678)
- Command completion events now include early output and report process-launch failures to clients. (#47529, #47665)

## New Features

- Opt-in `instant_interrupt` lets new input steer Codex during model responses or long-running code-mode calls. (#48135, #48141)
- New sessions get a compact welcome screen and consistent headers, with occasional tips during and after turns. (#48513, #48562, #48352)
- The warnings viewer dismisses reviewed warnings when closed; press `k` to keep one for later. (#48205, #48206)
- You can scroll the transcript while deciding whether to implement a plan. (#48805)
- Native Mermaid rendering supports more flowchart edges, labels, and node groups. (#48814, #48895)
- App-server clients can paginate thread history from a specific item. (#48151)

## Bug Fixes

- Windows launches avoid stray console windows for MCP servers, code-mode hosts, and piped commands; restrictive launchers can fall back to embedded mode. (#48138, #48238, #48483, #48491)
- Copying transcript selections preserves Markdown tables, formatting, and significant whitespace. More terminals now copy automatically on selection. (#48548, #48549, #48469)
- Blank sessions retain drafts when switching tasks, and threads can be archived and listed before their first turn. (#48628, #48828, #48199)
- Local ChatGPT sign-in opens the browser reliably; onboarding also provides a shortcut to copy the login link. (#48502, #48544)
- Approved commands retain explicit filesystem denials, and `.aws` directories are protected by default under writable roots. (#48155, #48176)
- Fixed macOS TLS access in network-enabled sandboxes and remote environments that require proxy access. (#48565, #48198)

## Chores

- Removed automatic follow-up prompt suggestions and the `tui.prompt_suggestions` setting. (#48621)
- Removed the bundled `plugin-creator` skill. (#48604)

## New Features

- Browse older tasks in the agent command center with a keyboard-accessible “Show more” action. (#49106)
- Select transcript text and paste with middle-click in fullscreen mode on supported local Linux X11 terminals. (#49112)
- Start sessions outside a project with workspace defaults when policy permits, and restore saved permissions when resuming. (#49160)
- Added opt-in Guardian review capabilities to retrieve earlier user instructions and include context from agent handoffs. (#49036, #49057)

## Bug Fixes

- Unsent queued messages now resume after reconnection once uncertain submissions are resolved, avoiding duplicate sends. (#49105)
- The terminal UI now preserves server provider, reasoning-summary, and verbosity settings and shows the correct sessions in resume and fork history. (#49144, #49161, #49171)
- Fixed Windows sandbox PowerShell fallbacks and long-path permission repairs, and suppressed unwanted console windows from background helpers. (#49019, #49058, #49098, #49164, #49386)
- Subagents now retain environments that are still starting and receive their configuration or preparation failure. (#49075)
- Prevented SQLite stalls during connection setup and logging, and surfaced initialization errors instead of masking them as timeouts. (#49032, #49102)
- Explicit provider model catalogs no longer include unsupported bundled models or reuse stale entries after refresh failures. (#49135)

## Documentation

- Clarified how provider credentials use the configured storage backend and how `env_key` identifies the API-key environment variable. (#49118)

## Chores

- Reduced repeated plugin-loading work by caching parsed manifests and reusing HTTP connections for remote plugin requests. (#49099, #49100)
- Added background reclamation of unused log database space to reduce disk usage. (#49069)

## New Features

- GPT-6.1 Sol is now the default model in the bundled and Amazon Bedrock catalogs. (#49318, #49339)
- Amazon Bedrock supports multi-agent V2 and Ultra reasoning on compatible models; Bedrock Mantle also accepts AWS GovCloud regions. (#49345, #49813)
- Sign in to MCP servers from an active terminal session with `/mcp login <name>`. (#49290)
- Choose your microphone, speaker, and microphone input channels for voice conversations, with preferences saved locally. (#49437, #49836)
- Daybreak is opt-in through `--enable cli_daybreak` or `features.cli_daybreak=true`; `daybreak=true` alone is insufficient. By default, controls and indicators are hidden, `/daybreak` is unavailable, and automatic Cyber routing is omitted—even for saved Daybreak threads. Saved preferences remain intact. Opt-in routing requires eligible ChatGPT sign-in, the OpenAI provider, and advertised model/program support. (#49856, #49858, #49859, #49861, #51207)
- Select a Cyber access program per turn with `codex exec --cyber-access-program` or the TypeScript SDK’s `cyberAccessProgram` option. The explicit exec override remains available with `cli_daybreak` disabled and leaves the saved choice unchanged. (#49939, #51207)

## Bug Fixes

- Approved filesystem escalation can now grant broader write access while preserving denied reads and network restrictions. Background tasks retain their originating turn’s permissions. (#49353, #49880)
- Explicit launch permissions survive terminal reconnects and new sessions, while implicit client settings no longer overwrite server or saved-thread web-search settings. (#49809, #49799)
- Elevated Windows terminal sessions can start using an embedded server, and sandboxed PowerShell preserves relative paths beneath protected user profiles. (#49855, #49690)
- Enter correctly submits buffered input after paste detection expires, including in Vim insert mode. (#49810)
- Thread resume includes the latest committed history. Startup detects recoverable SQLite corruption earlier and preserves damaged databases as backups. (#49599, #49701)
- Responses retries and WebSocket-to-HTTP fallback honor server retry guidance, reducing premature failures during overload. (#49441)

## Documentation

- Authentication guidance now accounts for keyring storage instead of implying credentials always reside in `auth.json`. (#49361)

## Chores

- Publishing an older alpha or hotfix no longer moves npm alpha tags backward. (#49704)

## New Features

- Add tools for creating and listing managed Git worktrees from trusted local projects when the worktrees feature is enabled. (#50148)
- Pin tasks in the agent Command Center with `p` and keep them in a shared Pinned group when supported by the server. (#51500)
- Navigate and copy transcript blocks with `/copy`, use `Ctrl+Insert` to copy selections, and tune mouse-wheel scrolling with `tui.mouse_scroll_speed`. (#50434, #50215, #50209)
- Make URLs clickable in approval headers, questions, MCP prompts, warnings, banners, and verification prompts, including when links wrap across lines. (#51439, #51449, #51450, #51451, #51452, #51458)
- Configure live web access and remote compaction capabilities for custom Responses-compatible model providers. (#50459)
- Add JavaScript helpers for streaming promise results as they settle, plus opt-in ranked tool search in Code Mode. (#51126, #51209)

## Bug Fixes

- Respect server model and reasoning-summary defaults for new TUI threads while retaining explicit launch overrides. (#50013, #50811, #50913)
- Preserve existing CRLF line endings in `apply_patch` updates without requiring an opt-in. (#51203)
- Fix Linux sandbox startup with multiple denied files, reject writable sandbox-construction executables, and keep ripgrep configuration from weakening deny-glob masks. (#50059, #51211, #51407, #51527)
- Restore ordinary drive-letter file access on Windows 10 and match Windows sandbox temp permissions to the child process environment. (#51511, #51512)
- Honor server `Retry-After` advice for retryable Responses and WebSocket failures. (#50418, #51440)
- Fix archive checksum verification when installing through Windows PowerShell with PowerShell 7 module paths present. (#51257)

## Chores

- Publish a signed PowerShell installer with Windows releases. (#51158)
- Keep older stable releases and prereleases from replacing newer stable download targets or installer aliases. (#51186, #51425)

## New Features

- Open `/config` to search preferences across categories, change supported settings immediately, and see which changes require a restart. (#52990, #53429)
- Send a follow-up while Codex is responding to steer it immediately. Interrupting a turn also stops active Code Mode cells and their nested tool calls. (#51812, #51835)
- Configure a leader key in `/keymap`. The default is `Ctrl+X`, shortcut hints stay open until you choose or cancel, and voice mute moves to `F9`. (#52273)
- Restart a managed background server from `/daemon`. Codex warns about work the restart could interrupt, then reconnects automatically. (#53173)
- Codex can run independent read-only tools in parallel, including skill, memory, and conversation-history lookups. (#52245)
- Daybreak is enabled by default for eligible accounts. `codex exec` can also select it with an OpenAI API key when the server offers access. (#53701, #53717)

## Bug Fixes

- Resuming a saved thread restores its permissions and network approvals, while respecting explicit overrides and current managed policy. (#53150, #53419, #53424)
- The network proxy now checks permission before a DNS lookup, rejects duplicate `Host` headers, and prevents credential aliases from bypassing inspection hooks. (#51650, #52661, #53506)
- Return to an existing side conversation with `/side` after switching threads. Answers to pending prompts also go back to the thread that asked. (#52184, #53436)
- On Windows, `Ctrl+V` and `Shift+Insert` paste text as well as images. On WSL, repeated pastes reuse the clipboard reader, and copy attempts time out instead of hanging. (#53224, #52967, #53453)
- Local commands finish promptly when a child keeps an output pipe open. Remote commands preserve late-arriving output so the final poll can still collect it. (#52652, #53331, #53622)
- `codex exec` no longer prints the same file diff again after an unrelated command. (#53444)

## Documentation

- Updated the bundled OpenAI Docs guidance for migrations to the GPT-6 family, including model-specific reasoning, tool use, and data residency considerations. (#51768)
- Clarified how the Linux sandbox uses bubblewrap for filesystem isolation and seccomp for syscall filtering. (#52610)

## Chores

- Codex now uses its standard shell executor and no longer bundles a patched `zsh`. Configurations using the retired shell flags receive a migration notice. (#52160, #52213)
- Reduced Linux and macOS release package size by stripping symbols from packaged binaries while preserving them in the original build outputs. (#52178)

## New Features

- Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered `/presets` slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access. (#54380, #54381)
- Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline `/model` and `/permissions` arguments. (#54378, #54383)
- Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics. (#54216)
- Authenticate enterprise MCP connections using eligible Codex account grants or dedicated sign-in, including OAuth clients requiring secrets. (#55334, #55859, #56001)
- Mask credentials during supported remote Bash commands and Zsh snapshot sessions, including credentials from custom providers. (#54309, #54432, #56049)
- The Amazon Bedrock setup wizard is now enabled by default, with API key entry grouped alongside other AWS sign-in methods when credentials are detected. (#56033, #56023)

## Bug Fixes

- Failed compaction no longer leaves partial summaries in conversation history, and background compaction failures fall back without panicking. (#53932, #55581)
- Resuming sessions now finds compressed histories and restores saved thread settings instead of replacing them with global defaults. (#54008, #55923)
- Windows HTTPS and WebSocket connections now handle proxy authentication challenges using the signed-in user’s Negotiate or NTLM credentials. (#55994, #56000)
- CLI configuration overrides are preserved when `-c` or `--config` appears at multiple subcommand levels. (#56022)
- Queued prompts now wait for pending permission selections to resolve before continuing. (#55682)
- Hardened sandbox checks for case-variant metadata paths on macOS and replaceable symlinks used to locate executables. (#54273, #55384)

## Chores

- Reduced disk usage by pruning unused installations, cleaning abandoned marketplace checkouts, and bounding daemon logs. (#53827, #55149, #55689, #55690, #55856)
- Updated the embedded JavaScript runtime with safety checks for optimized `Array.sort` operations. (#54519)

## New Features

- Added a built-in Google Cloud Vertex AI provider, configured with `model_provider = "gcp"`. (#56265)
- Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the model catalogs. (#57337)
- Added a repository filter to the session picker and directory grouping to the agent command center, making it easier to navigate sessions across linked worktrees. (#56308)
- Added experimental attached thread forks to the app-server API. (#56351)
- Enabled reasoning effort changes during a conversation by default for supported models. (#56163)
- Enabled memory v2 by default for fresh profiles and added support for importing external-agent memories into it. (#56211, #56414)

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed fresh TUI sessions to honor the server’s default approval reviewer when no explicit override is provided. (#56090)
- Kept TUI preferences editable and immediately applicable when execution settings are invalid. (#56091)
- Cancelled remote MCP tool requests when their local response futures are dropped. (#56132)
- Prevented queued agent messages from restarting work after an interrupt or a switch to Plan mode. (#56330)
- Stopped retrying when a provider reports that a model was not found, preserving its error message. (#56445)
- Closed a marketplace URL validation gap that could allow Git to connect to a different host than the one checked against allowed patterns. (#56263)

## New Features

- Added keyboard-driven transcript selection with word, line, and page motions, integrated search, and configurable shortcuts. (#57221, #57222, #57223, #57224)
- Rendered Markdown consistently in async questions, choices, answers, and transcript replies. (#57259, #57292)
- Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock model catalogs. (#57293)
- Added `codex queue --resume` to resume unloaded threads after queueing a message. (#57232)
- Added clearer safety-block explanations and selectable safer follow-up prompts in the TUI. (#57363, #57365)
- Added `codex doctor --network-only` for focused configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket diagnostics. (#57606)

## Bug Fixes

- Preserved acknowledged approval and permission settings when resuming or forking threads. (#57227)
- Preserved local image attachments when restoring killed composer text. (#57502)
- Fixed standalone release cleanup on macOS when installations are in use or paths contain non-ASCII characters. (#57503)
- Restored spawned descendant threads when unarchiving their parent. (#57635)
- Fixed app-server thread startup and shutdown races and released completed runtimes promptly. (#57787, #57788)
- Improved TUI reconnection recovery, including offline `/quit` and `/exit` handling. (#57820)
- Preserved reasoning-token accounting across resume and fork to avoid premature compaction. (#57839)

## Chores

- Switched Bazel to source-built V8 with target-matched Rust bindings and native Windows MSVC archive support. (#57164, #57269, #57644, #57832)
- Shipped the standalone executor in canonical CLI and app-server release packages. (#57837)
- Standardized development and release builds on Node.js 24.22.1 and Rust 1.95.0. (#57168, #57373)

## New Features

- Open the agent command center with `codex agents --no-daemon`. The command center and session picker now mark unread results (#58238, #58239, #58263, #58264).
- Switch between connected backends from the terminal session picker and keep your drafts when switching (#58280, #58457).
- Preview local image attachments while composing on supported terminals, and open viewed local images from clickable transcript paths (#58261, #58446).
- Find API key and cloud provider options under “Sign in another way.” Enable `gcp_setup_wizard` to set up Google Cloud Vertex AI with Application Default Credentials or a credential file (#57857, #58427).
- Opt into macOS or Windows system proxy settings from `/experimental` (#58157).
- Expand patch details directly in the transcript while an approval prompt is open (#58281).

## Bug Fixes

- Saved chats stay visible after you switch model providers. If a chat can’t resume, you can read its transcript and prepare an editable prompt to continue in a new chat (#58202).
- `Ctrl+L` clears the terminal display while keeping earlier messages available through `Ctrl+T` (#58266).
- Deleting text that exposes a leading `!` keeps an ordinary draft in chat mode (#58412).
- Network approval prompts close when their requests end. Concurrent requests to the same endpoint prompt one at a time (#58350, #58351).
- Long realtime V3 conversations save completed speech to chat history as the transcript grows (#58221).
- Automatic context compaction now accounts for retained output from failed responses and responses with missing token usage data (#58404).

## Documentation

- The app-server README covers managed network constraints under `[permissions.network]` and `prompt-user` command rules that require fresh human approval (#58045, #58182).
- The `openai-docs` skill recommends the documented replacement when migrating away from a deprecated model (#58134).

## Chores

- DotSlash manifests now reference the Cargo packages shipped with the release (#58717, #58757).
- Linux musl builds use fewer allocator arenas to reduce idle memory after conversations unload (#58399).

releases.name: Desktop v0.0.10
releases.body:
- Remote MCP servers can now authenticate with OAuth from Settings → MCP — authorize a server, see its auth status, and cancel or retry a pending authorization. Servers that require a pre-registered OAuth client (client ID/secret) instead of dynamic registration are now supported, and stored tokens are invalidated when a server's client configuration changes.
- MCP errors are now shown on the individual server rather than as a page-level error, and a server with invalid configuration is surfaced with its error instead of silently disappearing from the list.
- Failed turns no longer fail silently. Sending a message with no model credentials — or any queued turn that fails — now shows an error in the transcript, enriched with the underlying cause and a pointer to Settings → Models.
- Fixed the first message of a chat (and some queued messages) rendering twice.
- Fixed the composer getting stuck on "Agent is working…" after a turn already finished.
- New "Connect a model" notice on the welcome screen when no provider has credentials, with one click to onboarding or model settings. It reacts live as you add credentials, and correctly recognizes Bedrock/Vertex and keyless local endpoints as already connected.
- Added "Get an API key" links for popular providers in onboarding and Settings → Models, plus a link to the Cline dashboard from the Cline API key form.
- The onboarding welcome step now explains what Cline is.
- The stop button is now actually visible and clickable, Esc stops the current turn, and new shortcuts: Cmd/Ctrl+N for a new session, Cmd/Ctrl+, for settings.
- Reasoning controls now resolve consistently across AI SDK providers, including Ollama, so effort levels and thinking on/off are honored wherever the provider supports them.
- Vertex AI: credential refreshes now use the configured fetch, fixing ADC authentication behind proxies and custom networking.
- Refreshed the bundled provider and model catalog.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/desktop-v0.0.9...desktop-v0.0.10

releases.name: SDK v0.0.72
releases.body:
- Prompts queued during a turn now survive being interrupted: they are preserved across user-initiated aborts, drained after a turn aborts itself, and edits made to the queue inside the abort window are applied rather than lost. Stopping a session now has consistent full-stop semantics across hosts
- Session context stays durable across aborts and hub restarts, so an interrupted session resumes with the state it had rather than a reset one
- Queued turns that fail are now reported as `run.failed` instead of completing silently
- A hung MCP server no longer takes down session creation, and stdio servers that were never configured get a 30-second initialize budget instead of blocking indefinitely
- Remote SSE MCP servers now surface an OAuth authorization prompt on a 401 instead of failing outright, and remote MCP supports pre-registered OAuth clients for setups where dynamic client registration isn't available
- LiteLLM requests route through Chat Completions instead of the Responses API, fixing calls against LiteLLM proxies
- Network interruptions that happen mid-stream but before any model output are retried instead of failing the turn
- Vertex ADC token refreshes use the configured fetch, so they work behind proxies and custom transports
- Checkpoint diffs now include files that were untracked when the snapshot was taken, and checkpoints are picked up when git is initialized part-way through a session
- Plugin settings and contributions are centralized in the hub, with host-aware snapshots and atomic host plugin toggles; a source host no longer runs a foreign compiled plugin-sandbox bootstrap
- Scheduled run reports carry execution context — readable headers, schedule metadata, durations, and lifecycle error details

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cline/cline/compare/sdk/sdk/v0.0.71...sdk/sdk/v0.0.72
