releases.name: v7.8.7 (pre-release)
releases.body:
## VS Code

### Minor Changes

- [#14797](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14797) [`ecb450b`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/ecb450b9bea49dd099037933d9852dfdd5e05224) - Make multi-project Agent Manager available by default, with the current workspace project first, and remove the experimental toggle and old single-project view.

  Keep restored tabs, background sessions, and branch defaults with their project, and restore the remaining project after removing the active project.

- [#14806](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14806) [`b85a1ab`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b85a1ab93bb4b3466cdfba5b898e85f0bea1bf6d) - Show one keyboard shortcut hint in the prompt that fits what you do now: how to add selected code to the chat, return to the prompt, stop a run, jump to a session that needs you, or review changes and the pull request in Agent Manager. Empty Agent Manager sessions list the main shortcuts, the mode picker shows its shortcut on hover, and all shortcut labels follow your custom keybindings. Turn hints off in Display settings.

- [#14836](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14836) [`760048d`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/760048d906857bc1637189c6386d43bb4bb11ae5) - Open the Integrated Browser in an editor tab for any session, not only Agent Manager. Run the Open Integrated Browser command, or let the browser_open tool reveal the tab automatically. Each session gets its own browser tab.

- [#14781](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14781) [`fffcf0e`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/fffcf0e2ac3ae821a953e1956cc316d35b4a24ce) Thanks [@eborjaa](https://github.com/eborjaa)! - Choose a separate model for automatic project memory saves with the new `memory_model` setting in `kilo.jsonc`. When it is unset or unavailable, memory keeps using the session model.

- [#14632](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14632) [`fc3910b`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/fc3910b608e90eeb1eccf4145e123dd65bf5e366) Thanks [@brunoagatao](https://github.com/brunoagatao)! - Add an experimental "Per-Conversation Prompt History" setting that keeps prompt input history separate for each conversation

- [#14751](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14751) [`829f621`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/829f6214f5c39558d94e5eafff72e37adbe2c89d) - Show the GitHub organization avatar next to each project in the Agent Manager project list, with a letter tile when the project has no GitHub remote.

- [#14813](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14813) [`8b144bb`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/8b144bbf9188799a371b59c4d16a06cbe720b79f) - Show to-do progress in the session dock above the prompt. A small progress chip shows how many items are done and the current item, next to the working indicator, background agents, and the goal. Click it to see the full list. The to-do bar under the session title is removed.

- [#14837](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14837) [`94c0514`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/94c0514063a17b924af049d720da7c605c7d766d) - Add search to the Kilo Settings sidebar. A search field at the top of the left rail filters every setting, with results grouped by category in the panel so matching settings stay visible; select one to jump to its tab and setting. The field shows the shortcut as a keycap and focuses with `Ctrl+F` (`Cmd+F` on macOS).

- [#14855](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14855) [`2049b82`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/2049b821f7d1a1d569c7c1e65af4302ca8943bb4) - Pin and unpin session tabs with Shift+click in the sidebar and Agent Manager. The tab context menu now shows the gesture next to Pin and Unpin.

- [#14724](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14724) [`72fa65f`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/72fa65fb323a8da067694dbc3460ce8f5860af3e) - Support OAuth sign-in for MCP servers: open authorization links through VS Code, prompt to sign in after installing an OAuth-protected server from the Marketplace, surface servers that need sign-in from the chat prompt with recovery actions, and configure a pre-registered OAuth client when a server requires one.

### Patch Changes

- [#14853](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14853) [`b0820ac`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b0820ac2cf6513de98c5079686c8268328845bf9) - Show the keyboard shortcut hints in an empty Agent Manager session with the same VS Code keycap style used in the prompt input, so the shortcut keys look consistent in both places.

- [#14721](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14721) [`b299b97`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b299b9779abaa3e2951c9141a36b9df46cf2f9c2) - Keep pre-warmed Agent Manager worktrees outside the project folder. `.kilo/worktrees/` is now only created when you create a worktree, so build tools, test runners, and file watchers that scan the project no longer find an extra checkout. Pre-warmed worktrees left in `.kilo/worktrees/` by earlier versions are removed automatically. Projects on a different drive than your home folder are no longer pre-warmed.

- [#14712](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14712) [`4c09359`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/4c09359103883b6904732310b50f57b941dce31e) - Run the Agent Manager worktree setup script for a new worktree even when the setup script of another worktree is still running in the VS Code terminal, and show an error when the setup task cannot start.

- [#14828](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14828) [`652cd51`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/652cd51c184fd371a50dd8b8e1cf89b2c2e006c1) - Make dragging, hovering, and scrolling in the Agent Manager integrated browser follow the pointer without a growing delay on high refresh rate displays.

- [#14827](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14827) [`6c79db2`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/6c79db2b80e6a96ceb35750b32a96c795d1e17f6) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Update DOMPurify to 3.4.16 to fix an XSS vulnerability flagged by Dependabot in markdown sanitization.

- [#14833](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14833) [`c918730`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/c918730f724002b51be6288f08ce9893a1c94a1f) - Keep local sessions visible and New Session recent lists isolated when switching Agent Manager projects.

- [#14736](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14736) [`d894e65`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/d894e6535336ce3d4dae48a9c39d0e479aee767b) Thanks [@brunoagatao](https://github.com/brunoagatao)! - Keep Agent Manager peer messages visible in later typed turns so the prompt cache stays warm

- [#14780](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14780) [`716f722`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/716f722dc506c61f81c70520e5e867440380bd8e) Thanks [@ykakade](https://github.com/ykakade)! - Show the actual Grep search target instead of its parent directory, including searches within a single file, and show tool paths relative to Windows workspaces.

- [#14791](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14791) [`3e4c6dd`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/3e4c6dd51bf6c54ef8cea471680cc2c207ca10bb) Thanks [@mardausdennis](https://github.com/mardausdennis)! - Stop the hidden working spinner from animating after a session finishes, which kept the chat view redrawing on every frame while idle.

- [#14848](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14848) [`643cfc3`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/643cfc39a040f86fffd987d597651762077ab4fb) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Update KaTeX to 0.19.0 to fix a security issue flagged by Dependabot in math rendering.

- [#14803](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14803) [`21164ba`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/21164ba0b058d1db59b8682f51f811d0407b461d) - Reduce CPU use of the workspace scan for marketplace suggestions. The scan now respects `.gitignore` and other ignore files, searches all file patterns in one pass, and no longer follows symbolic links out of the project. Creating a file no longer starts a new scan unless the file or folder can match a suggestion.

- [#14798](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14798) [`b8d0cf1`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b8d0cf1acfa8ea45ec69aa0ffc58d88ef6c1ce9a) - Scroll wide MCP tool input and output horizontally instead of clipping it, and keep words in MCP output tables from breaking into single letters.

- [#14783](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14783) [`227a8de`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/227a8de8fb2bf7b40324bca0f73c189b8b723229) Thanks [@sylwester-liljegren](https://github.com/sylwester-liljegren)! - Show the full path of files and folders when hovering them in the @-mention list.

- [#14723](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14723) [`958f1c4`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/958f1c4fff35f6ac200521819229b7da77617a97) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Fix model precedence so mode-configured models win over remembered picks in new sessions. Manual model picks now apply per agent within each session or draft, reopened sessions immediately show the agent and model they last ran with, and the plan follow-up "Start new session" keeps the planning session in Plan mode. The model picker recovers on its own after a Kilo catalog failure and says when Kilo models are unavailable.

- [#14775](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14775) [`0883558`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/088355899dd03821d69dab203bf2d3072b0a6184) Thanks [@LEN5010](https://github.com/LEN5010)! - Preserve staged renames and the staged/unstaged split when continuing a session in a worktree.

- [#14810](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14810) [`3df1371`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/3df13713bd2e8b88895f9b90c68aa31ea6708965) - Show the shortcut in the prompt hint as keycaps, so the keys are easier to see.

- [#14808](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14808) [`b3e22e7`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b3e22e72dbd43b73608440ac343f297b19348567) - Keep Agent Manager session switching responsive when visible edit diffs are expanded.

- [#14750](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14750) [`bf40cc7`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/bf40cc7cb221d7d161a378eeaf522bb1b9070553) - Make `semantic_search` available in VS Code when codebase indexing is enabled for the project, also when the indexing config switch is not set.

- [#14834](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14834) [`4e0131e`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/4e0131e41c4f41b612c11910845f5d7b9a4e4c35) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Update simple-git to 4.0.2 to fix command execution vulnerabilities flagged by Dependabot in Git operations.

- [#14852](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14852) [`7ab5061`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/7ab5061177bef42438eb67d00c6a874b176e06ac) - Allow scrolling while selecting browser elements, refresh element highlights after scrolling, and batch trackpad input without losing scroll distance or direction changes.

- [#14802](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14802) [`64a9192`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/64a9192819b55a289e70bce279b8f4a7689fd83f) - Show the model and reasoning effort of a subagent in the header of its session view, in the Agent Manager subagent panel and in the subagent editor tab.

- [#14829](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14829) [`ab04799`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/ab047999c7aa94d63d9743831d5d3a3a44862dee) - Open Settings directly without loading chat, unused previews, model-picker lists, or unselected language dictionaries.

- [#14821](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14821) [`e80e1a6`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/e80e1a61bc75a393ff8db64d236d5fb6b0b6b3dd) - Fix cloud session history rendering prompts and replies in the wrong order by preserving parentID and sorting messages by creation time

- Updated dependencies [[`07b18a1`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/07b18a1a250ac7b1b257e4571e7b6050e3abd092), [`ab04799`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/ab047999c7aa94d63d9743831d5d3a3a44862dee)]:
  - @kilocode/kilo-gateway@7.8.4
  - @kilocode/kilo-ui@7.8.4
  - @opencode-ai/core@7.8.4
  - @kilocode/kilo-indexing@7.8.4
  - @opencode-ai/ui@7.8.4

## CLI

### Minor Changes

- [#14724](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14724) [`c9632e4`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/c9632e495115ec9f4592842b02335c2a61149645) - Support client-driven MCP OAuth authorization, preserve credentials when cancelling sign-in, and classify recoverable authentication failures as requiring sign-in.

- [#14781](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14781) [`fffcf0e`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/fffcf0e2ac3ae821a953e1956cc316d35b4a24ce) Thanks [@eborjaa](https://github.com/eborjaa)! - Choose a separate model for automatic project memory saves with the new `memory_model` setting in `kilo.jsonc`. When it is unset or unavailable, memory keeps using the session model.

- [#14701](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14701) [`d627b31`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/d627b3185589fe671748b0b651d7a1c61bbb7795) Thanks [@calebnorman](https://github.com/calebnorman)! - Press Esc twice in a subagent view to stop that subagent and anything it started while the parent session keeps working, the same as Stop on a VS Code task card. The parent is told the user stopped it, so it no longer starts a replacement subagent right away. Leaving the TUI from a subagent view now needs a second press of the exit key.

- [#14702](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14702) [`f1e766d`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/f1e766d339830af0649f3dbe0da67fe73d495ca6) Thanks [@calebnorman](https://github.com/calebnorman)! - Steer a running subagent directly from its TUI view. The steer runs as the subagent's own agent and model, and the parent agent is notified over the shared agent board.

### Patch Changes

- [#14800](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14800) [`b45cbdf`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b45cbdf5ce3a2a085ccfde17791c707692508286) - Build the CLI with Bun 1.4.2 to fix intermittent subprocess failures.

- [#14794](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14794) [`2792c70`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/2792c704edd485768fceb2c51ecd330fa872f596) Thanks [@qingshungLI](https://github.com/qingshungLI)! - Keep valid custom provider models available when another model entry is malformed.

- [#14805](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14805) [`f54e713`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/f54e713dd25596abbdd3f17cb477a31e6aa2fcef) Thanks [@abdulhusainahk](https://github.com/abdulhusainahk)! - Preserve provider error messages when commit-message generation fails, including context-limit errors returned during streaming.

- [#14723](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14723) [`07b18a1`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/07b18a1a250ac7b1b257e4571e7b6050e3abd092) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Recover worktree models after transient Kilo catalog failures without falling back to another account's catalog.

- [#14803](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14803) [`21164ba`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/21164ba0b058d1db59b8682f51f811d0407b461d) - Reduce CPU use of the workspace scan for marketplace suggestions. The scan now respects `.gitignore` and other ignore files, searches all file patterns in one pass, and no longer follows symbolic links out of the project. Creating a file no longer starts a new scan unless the file or folder can match a suggestion.

- [#14723](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14723) [`958f1c4`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/958f1c4fff35f6ac200521819229b7da77617a97) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Fix model precedence so mode-configured models win over remembered picks in new sessions. Manual model picks now apply per agent within each session or draft, reopened sessions immediately show the agent and model they last ran with, and the plan follow-up "Start new session" keeps the planning session in Plan mode. The model picker recovers on its own after a Kilo catalog failure and says when Kilo models are unavailable.

- [#14722](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14722) [`54eacd5`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/54eacd5ff640c3ef67e27f1dba7c94c332f313e2) - Prevent thinking indicators from remaining active after a model response is retried.

- [#14733](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14733) [`6711533`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/671153394545757324ecda671363e3ad1002d596) - Fix `write` and `edit` tools on Linux when the sandbox allows specific network hosts. Before, these tools failed with "Filesystem worker returned an invalid response".

- [#14750](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14750) [`bf40cc7`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/bf40cc7cb221d7d161a378eeaf522bb1b9070553) - Make `semantic_search` available in VS Code when codebase indexing is enabled for the project, also when the indexing config switch is not set.

- [#14834](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14834) [`4e0131e`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/4e0131e41c4f41b612c11910845f5d7b9a4e4c35) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Update simple-git to 4.0.2 to fix command execution vulnerabilities flagged by Dependabot in Git operations.

- [#14787](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14787) [`b0aeda5`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b0aeda50beb315169f64f69d28cf98f71e228502) Thanks [@ykakade](https://github.com/ykakade)! - Keep every project skill available when one Kilo server handles several folders, such as Agent Manager worktrees. Skills whose frontmatter has an unquoted colon (for example `description: Use when: ...`) no longer go missing with "Skill not found" after the first folder loads.

- [#14799](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14799) [`1b9c1ab`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/1b9c1abb1812b7e4357040a3a3e0dc1f41344707) Thanks [@L4XB](https://github.com/L4XB)! - Keep the time of day when reading date cells from XLSX and ODS spreadsheets, and read time and duration cells as the sheet shows them instead of as dates in 1899 or 1900.

- [#14860](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14860) [`2d209e6`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/2d209e6d3ea3b7f20d1f36013eca8f21a663dbec) - Fix the TUI starting up to a permanently blank screen. A request sent to the TUI's worker before it finished starting was dropped, and the TUI then waited for a reply that never came, with no error and no timeout. Worker requests are now queued until the worker is ready, worker-side failures are reported instead of silently swallowed, and a worker that never answers fails with a clear message.

- Updated dependencies [[`07b18a1`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/07b18a1a250ac7b1b257e4571e7b6050e3abd092)]:
  - @kilocode/kilo-gateway@7.8.4
  - @kilocode/kilo-indexing@7.8.4
  - @kilocode/kilo-telemetry@7.8.4
  - @opencode-ai/server@7.8.4
  - @opencode-ai/tui@7.8.4
  - @opencode-ai/ui@7.8.4

releases.name: v7.8.8 (release)
releases.body:
## VS Code

### 7.8.8

#### Minor Changes

- [#14891](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14891) [`ce9a04b`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/ce9a04b0f91531b26d37a0f514621396f85311e8) - Pin worktrees in the Agent Manager sidebar with Shift+click or the context menu. Pinned worktrees stay at the top of the list, get the first jump shortcuts, and keep their section for when you unpin them.

- [#14885](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14885) [`0abb254`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/0abb2543204636b59be9afc22b7f380b5177fdd2) - Open chat web links in-app by default when the experimental Integrated Browser is enabled: sidebar chats use a browser tab and Agent Manager uses its browser panel. Choose "System browser" under "Open links in" to opt out. In-app links show a browser icon, and links no longer open in two browsers.

#### Patch Changes

- [#14890](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14890) [`3453059`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/34530596230a4614cb7c6c089ab8a2f1a264d9ca) - Reduce the height of Agent Manager section headers so more sessions fit in the sidebar.

- [#14884](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14884) [`d6b3b21`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/d6b3b214d22e81cbe9b05ec2ec90735d050292bc) - Make the integrated browser preview feel more like a native browser. Page loads and client-side route changes keep the current page visible until the next page paints, instead of showing a blank preview. Route changes in single-page apps no longer drop input. The preview now updates while you resize its panel, and it does not stretch the page during the resize.

- [#14886](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14886) [`8781c16`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/8781c165ccfbc23d1135bb556936009d896e3ff2) - Show a clear warning when the Integrated Browser is opened without an active session, and disable its address bar until a session is selected.

- [#14888](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14888) [`35da0f1`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/35da0f1814fefbfbab3c41a75b93e3cdd2485ca4) - Make the session header more compact to save vertical space, and keep the scroll-to-bottom button clear of the prompt rail.

- [#14889](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14889) [`7f64374`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/7f6437435e3886a4753c87aa79fd2e0d43844035) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Keep MCP OAuth credentials bound to the authorization server that issued them, so a server that switches authorization servers can no longer receive stored refresh tokens or client secrets.

- [#14887](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14887) [`248e9ae`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/248e9ae468efdbd31e34ef3ca863c05be8800337) - Switch between session tabs in the sidebar and Kilo editor tabs with `Cmd+Alt+Left` / `Right` (`Ctrl+Alt+Left` / `Right` on Windows and Linux), with shortcut hints on the tabs and in the prompt.

- [#14854](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14854) [`2c85991`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/2c859919d8e4c420bed3abd9872da2cc0b5bcc8c) - Use installed Playwright Chromium in WSL when Chrome is missing and no browser preference is set. Document manual browser setup without installing software automatically.

- Updated dependencies [[`35da0f1`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/35da0f1814fefbfbab3c41a75b93e3cdd2485ca4)]:
  - @kilocode/kilo-ui@7.8.8

### 7.8.7

#### Minor Changes

- [#14797](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14797) [`ecb450b`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/ecb450b9bea49dd099037933d9852dfdd5e05224) - Make multi-project Agent Manager available by default, with the current workspace project first, and remove the experimental toggle and old single-project view.

  Keep restored tabs, background sessions, and branch defaults with their project, and restore the remaining project after removing the active project.

- [#14806](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14806) [`b85a1ab`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b85a1ab93bb4b3466cdfba5b898e85f0bea1bf6d) - Show one keyboard shortcut hint in the prompt that fits what you do now: how to add selected code to the chat, return to the prompt, stop a run, jump to a session that needs you, or review changes and the pull request in Agent Manager. Empty Agent Manager sessions list the main shortcuts, the mode picker shows its shortcut on hover, and all shortcut labels follow your custom keybindings. Turn hints off in Display settings.

- [#14836](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14836) [`760048d`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/760048d906857bc1637189c6386d43bb4bb11ae5) - Open the Integrated Browser in an editor tab for any session, not only Agent Manager. Run the Open Integrated Browser command, or let the browser_open tool reveal the tab automatically. Each session gets its own browser tab.

- [#14781](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14781) [`fffcf0e`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/fffcf0e2ac3ae821a953e1956cc316d35b4a24ce) Thanks [@eborjaa](https://github.com/eborjaa)! - Choose a separate model for automatic project memory saves with the new `memory_model` setting in `kilo.jsonc`. When it is unset or unavailable, memory keeps using the session model.

- [#14632](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14632) [`fc3910b`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/fc3910b608e90eeb1eccf4145e123dd65bf5e366) Thanks [@brunoagatao](https://github.com/brunoagatao)! - Add an experimental "Per-Conversation Prompt History" setting that keeps prompt input history separate for each conversation

- [#14751](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14751) [`829f621`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/829f6214f5c39558d94e5eafff72e37adbe2c89d) - Show the GitHub organization avatar next to each project in the Agent Manager project list, with a letter tile when the project has no GitHub remote.

- [#14813](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14813) [`8b144bb`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/8b144bbf9188799a371b59c4d16a06cbe720b79f) - Show to-do progress in the session dock above the prompt. A small progress chip shows how many items are done and the current item, next to the working indicator, background agents, and the goal. Click it to see the full list. The to-do bar under the session title is removed.

- [#14837](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14837) [`94c0514`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/94c0514063a17b924af049d720da7c605c7d766d) - Add search to the Kilo Settings sidebar. A search field at the top of the left rail filters every setting, with results grouped by category in the panel so matching settings stay visible; select one to jump to its tab and setting. The field shows the shortcut as a keycap and focuses with `Ctrl+F` (`Cmd+F` on macOS).

- [#14855](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14855) [`2049b82`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/2049b821f7d1a1d569c7c1e65af4302ca8943bb4) - Pin and unpin session tabs with Shift+click in the sidebar and Agent Manager. The tab context menu now shows the gesture next to Pin and Unpin.

- [#14724](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14724) [`72fa65f`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/72fa65fb323a8da067694dbc3460ce8f5860af3e) - Support OAuth sign-in for MCP servers: open authorization links through VS Code, prompt to sign in after installing an OAuth-protected server from the Marketplace, surface servers that need sign-in from the chat prompt with recovery actions, and configure a pre-registered OAuth client when a server requires one.

#### Patch Changes

- [#14853](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14853) [`b0820ac`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b0820ac2cf6513de98c5079686c8268328845bf9) - Show the keyboard shortcut hints in an empty Agent Manager session with the same VS Code keycap style used in the prompt input, so the shortcut keys look consistent in both places.

- [#14721](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14721) [`b299b97`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b299b9779abaa3e2951c9141a36b9df46cf2f9c2) - Keep pre-warmed Agent Manager worktrees outside the project folder. `.kilo/worktrees/` is now only created when you create a worktree, so build tools, test runners, and file watchers that scan the project no longer find an extra checkout. Pre-warmed worktrees left in `.kilo/worktrees/` by earlier versions are removed automatically. Projects on a different drive than your home folder are no longer pre-warmed.

- [#14712](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14712) [`4c09359`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/4c09359103883b6904732310b50f57b941dce31e) - Run the Agent Manager worktree setup script for a new worktree even when the setup script of another worktree is still running in the VS Code terminal, and show an error when the setup task cannot start.

- [#14828](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14828) [`652cd51`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/652cd51c184fd371a50dd8b8e1cf89b2c2e006c1) - Make dragging, hovering, and scrolling in the Agent Manager integrated browser follow the pointer without a growing delay on high refresh rate displays.

- [#14827](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14827) [`6c79db2`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/6c79db2b80e6a96ceb35750b32a96c795d1e17f6) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Update DOMPurify to 3.4.16 to fix an XSS vulnerability flagged by Dependabot in markdown sanitization.

- [#14833](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14833) [`c918730`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/c918730f724002b51be6288f08ce9893a1c94a1f) - Keep local sessions visible and New Session recent lists isolated when switching Agent Manager projects.

- [#14736](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14736) [`d894e65`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/d894e6535336ce3d4dae48a9c39d0e479aee767b) Thanks [@brunoagatao](https://github.com/brunoagatao)! - Keep Agent Manager peer messages visible in later typed turns so the prompt cache stays warm

- [#14780](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14780) [`716f722`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/716f722dc506c61f81c70520e5e867440380bd8e) Thanks [@ykakade](https://github.com/ykakade)! - Show the actual Grep search target instead of its parent directory, including searches within a single file, and show tool paths relative to Windows workspaces.

- [#14791](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14791) [`3e4c6dd`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/3e4c6dd51bf6c54ef8cea471680cc2c207ca10bb) Thanks [@mardausdennis](https://github.com/mardausdennis)! - Stop the hidden working spinner from animating after a session finishes, which kept the chat view redrawing on every frame while idle.

- [#14848](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14848) [`643cfc3`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/643cfc39a040f86fffd987d597651762077ab4fb) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Update KaTeX to 0.19.0 to fix a security issue flagged by Dependabot in math rendering.

- [#14803](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14803) [`21164ba`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/21164ba0b058d1db59b8682f51f811d0407b461d) - Reduce CPU use of the workspace scan for marketplace suggestions. The scan now respects `.gitignore` and other ignore files, searches all file patterns in one pass, and no longer follows symbolic links out of the project. Creating a file no longer starts a new scan unless the file or folder can match a suggestion.

- [#14798](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14798) [`b8d0cf1`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b8d0cf1acfa8ea45ec69aa0ffc58d88ef6c1ce9a) - Scroll wide MCP tool input and output horizontally instead of clipping it, and keep words in MCP output tables from breaking into single letters.

- [#14783](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14783) [`227a8de`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/227a8de8fb2bf7b40324bca0f73c189b8b723229) Thanks [@sylwester-liljegren](https://github.com/sylwester-liljegren)! - Show the full path of files and folders when hovering them in the @-mention list.

- [#14723](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14723) [`958f1c4`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/958f1c4fff35f6ac200521819229b7da77617a97) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Fix model precedence so mode-configured models win over remembered picks in new sessions. Manual model picks now apply per agent within each session or draft, reopened sessions immediately show the agent and model they last ran with, and the plan follow-up "Start new session" keeps the planning session in Plan mode. The model picker recovers on its own after a Kilo catalog failure and says when Kilo models are unavailable.

- [#14775](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14775) [`0883558`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/088355899dd03821d69dab203bf2d3072b0a6184) Thanks [@LEN5010](https://github.com/LEN5010)! - Preserve staged renames and the staged/unstaged split when continuing a session in a worktree.

- [#14810](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14810) [`3df1371`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/3df13713bd2e8b88895f9b90c68aa31ea6708965) - Show the shortcut in the prompt hint as keycaps, so the keys are easier to see.

- [#14808](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14808) [`b3e22e7`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b3e22e72dbd43b73608440ac343f297b19348567) - Keep Agent Manager session switching responsive when visible edit diffs are expanded.

- [#14750](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14750) [`bf40cc7`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/bf40cc7cb221d7d161a378eeaf522bb1b9070553) - Make `semantic_search` available in VS Code when codebase indexing is enabled for the project, also when the indexing config switch is not set.

- [#14834](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14834) [`4e0131e`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/4e0131e41c4f41b612c11910845f5d7b9a4e4c35) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Update simple-git to 4.0.2 to fix command execution vulnerabilities flagged by Dependabot in Git operations.

- [#14852](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14852) [`7ab5061`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/7ab5061177bef42438eb67d00c6a874b176e06ac) - Allow scrolling while selecting browser elements, refresh element highlights after scrolling, and batch trackpad input without losing scroll distance or direction changes.

- [#14802](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14802) [`64a9192`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/64a9192819b55a289e70bce279b8f4a7689fd83f) - Show the model and reasoning effort of a subagent in the header of its session view, in the Agent Manager subagent panel and in the subagent editor tab.

- [#14829](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14829) [`ab04799`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/ab047999c7aa94d63d9743831d5d3a3a44862dee) - Open Settings directly without loading chat, unused previews, model-picker lists, or unselected language dictionaries.

- [#14821](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14821) [`e80e1a6`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/e80e1a61bc75a393ff8db64d236d5fb6b0b6b3dd) - Fix cloud session history rendering prompts and replies in the wrong order by preserving parentID and sorting messages by creation time

- Updated dependencies [[`07b18a1`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/07b18a1a250ac7b1b257e4571e7b6050e3abd092), [`ab04799`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/ab047999c7aa94d63d9743831d5d3a3a44862dee)]:
  - @kilocode/kilo-gateway@7.8.4
  - @kilocode/kilo-ui@7.8.4
  - @opencode-ai/core@7.8.4
  - @kilocode/kilo-indexing@7.8.4
  - @opencode-ai/ui@7.8.4

## CLI

### 7.8.8

#### Patch Changes

- [#14889](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14889) [`7f64374`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/7f6437435e3886a4753c87aa79fd2e0d43844035) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Keep MCP OAuth credentials bound to the authorization server that issued them, so a server that switches authorization servers can no longer receive stored refresh tokens or client secrets.

### 7.8.7

#### Minor Changes

- [#14724](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14724) [`c9632e4`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/c9632e495115ec9f4592842b02335c2a61149645) - Support client-driven MCP OAuth authorization, preserve credentials when cancelling sign-in, and classify recoverable authentication failures as requiring sign-in.

- [#14781](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14781) [`fffcf0e`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/fffcf0e2ac3ae821a953e1956cc316d35b4a24ce) Thanks [@eborjaa](https://github.com/eborjaa)! - Choose a separate model for automatic project memory saves with the new `memory_model` setting in `kilo.jsonc`. When it is unset or unavailable, memory keeps using the session model.

- [#14701](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14701) [`d627b31`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/d627b3185589fe671748b0b651d7a1c61bbb7795) Thanks [@calebnorman](https://github.com/calebnorman)! - Press Esc twice in a subagent view to stop that subagent and anything it started while the parent session keeps working, the same as Stop on a VS Code task card. The parent is told the user stopped it, so it no longer starts a replacement subagent right away. Leaving the TUI from a subagent view now needs a second press of the exit key.

- [#14702](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14702) [`f1e766d`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/f1e766d339830af0649f3dbe0da67fe73d495ca6) Thanks [@calebnorman](https://github.com/calebnorman)! - Steer a running subagent directly from its TUI view. The steer runs as the subagent's own agent and model, and the parent agent is notified over the shared agent board.

#### Patch Changes

- [#14800](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14800) [`b45cbdf`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b45cbdf5ce3a2a085ccfde17791c707692508286) - Build the CLI with Bun 1.4.2 to fix intermittent subprocess failures.

- [#14794](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14794) [`2792c70`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/2792c704edd485768fceb2c51ecd330fa872f596) Thanks [@qingshungLI](https://github.com/qingshungLI)! - Keep valid custom provider models available when another model entry is malformed.

- [#14805](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14805) [`f54e713`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/f54e713dd25596abbdd3f17cb477a31e6aa2fcef) Thanks [@abdulhusainahk](https://github.com/abdulhusainahk)! - Preserve provider error messages when commit-message generation fails, including context-limit errors returned during streaming.

- [#14723](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14723) [`07b18a1`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/07b18a1a250ac7b1b257e4571e7b6050e3abd092) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Recover worktree models after transient Kilo catalog failures without falling back to another account's catalog.

- [#14803](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14803) [`21164ba`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/21164ba0b058d1db59b8682f51f811d0407b461d) - Reduce CPU use of the workspace scan for marketplace suggestions. The scan now respects `.gitignore` and other ignore files, searches all file patterns in one pass, and no longer follows symbolic links out of the project. Creating a file no longer starts a new scan unless the file or folder can match a suggestion.

- [#14723](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14723) [`958f1c4`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/958f1c4fff35f6ac200521819229b7da77617a97) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Fix model precedence so mode-configured models win over remembered picks in new sessions. Manual model picks now apply per agent within each session or draft, reopened sessions immediately show the agent and model they last ran with, and the plan follow-up "Start new session" keeps the planning session in Plan mode. The model picker recovers on its own after a Kilo catalog failure and says when Kilo models are unavailable.

- [#14722](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14722) [`54eacd5`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/54eacd5ff640c3ef67e27f1dba7c94c332f313e2) - Prevent thinking indicators from remaining active after a model response is retried.

- [#14733](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14733) [`6711533`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/671153394545757324ecda671363e3ad1002d596) - Fix `write` and `edit` tools on Linux when the sandbox allows specific network hosts. Before, these tools failed with "Filesystem worker returned an invalid response".

- [#14750](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14750) [`bf40cc7`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/bf40cc7cb221d7d161a378eeaf522bb1b9070553) - Make `semantic_search` available in VS Code when codebase indexing is enabled for the project, also when the indexing config switch is not set.

- [#14834](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14834) [`4e0131e`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/4e0131e41c4f41b612c11910845f5d7b9a4e4c35) Thanks [@WebReflection](https://github.com/WebReflection)! - Update simple-git to 4.0.2 to fix command execution vulnerabilities flagged by Dependabot in Git operations.

- [#14787](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14787) [`b0aeda5`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b0aeda50beb315169f64f69d28cf98f71e228502) Thanks [@ykakade](https://github.com/ykakade)! - Keep every project skill available when one Kilo server handles several folders, such as Agent Manager worktrees. Skills whose frontmatter has an unquoted colon (for example `description: Use when: ...`) no longer go missing with "Skill not found" after the first folder loads.

- [#14799](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14799) [`1b9c1ab`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/1b9c1abb1812b7e4357040a3a3e0dc1f41344707) Thanks [@L4XB](https://github.com/L4XB)! - Keep the time of day when reading date cells from XLSX and ODS spreadsheets, and read time and duration cells as the sheet shows them instead of as dates in 1899 or 1900.

- [#14860](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14860) [`2d209e6`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/2d209e6d3ea3b7f20d1f36013eca8f21a663dbec) - Fix the TUI starting up to a permanently blank screen. A request sent to the TUI's worker before it finished starting was dropped, and the TUI then waited for a reply that never came, with no error and no timeout. Worker requests are now queued until the worker is ready, worker-side failures are reported instead of silently swallowed, and a worker that never answers fails with a clear message.

- Updated dependencies [[`07b18a1`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/07b18a1a250ac7b1b257e4571e7b6050e3abd092)]:
  - @kilocode/kilo-gateway@7.8.4
  - @kilocode/kilo-indexing@7.8.4
  - @kilocode/kilo-telemetry@7.8.4
  - @opencode-ai/server@7.8.4
  - @opencode-ai/tui@7.8.4
  - @opencode-ai/ui@7.8.4

releases.name: JetBrains 7.1.9-rc.2
releases.body:
### Added

- Add a prompt navigator to the chat transcript for jumping between your own prompts.
- Add MCP OAuth sign-in support, including recognizing recoverable auth failures and refreshing auth after a reset.
- Show a combined MCP and Skill badge for marketplace servers that include companion skills.

### Fixed

- Submit chat dialogs with Command+Enter from any focused dialog control.
- Refresh a worktree's pull request status when its agent stops.
- Prevent a rejected attachment from discarding the prompt you were composing.

### Changed

- Bump the bundled Kilo CLI pin from 7.8.1 to 7.8.8.
- Pin the Bun runtime and types to 1.4.2 for reproducible builds.

releases.name: JetBrains 7.1.9
releases.body:
### Added

- Added a prompt navigator to the chat transcript for jumping between your sent prompts.
- Added MCP OAuth sign-in support, including recovery flows for expired or failed authorizations.
- Combined MCP and skill badges in the chat UI.
- Added a core settings reload action.
- Rendered agent board messages as markdown.

### Fixed

- Fixed hidden session questions not surfacing in the chat UI.
- Made chat dialogs submit with Cmd/Ctrl+Enter.
- Fixed spreadsheet date/time handling when reading xlsx and ods files.
- Finalized reasoning output before stream retries to avoid lost context.
- Kept storage usable after an interrupted first access.
- Prevented a rejected attachment from discarding the in-progress prompt.
- Gated prompt cache breakpoints to first-party OpenAI providers.

### Changed

- Renamed JetBrains workflows to commands.
- Split agent guidance documentation into skills.
- Bumped the bundled Kilo CLI pin to v7.8.8 (via v7.8.3 and v7.8.7 intermediate bumps).

releases.name: v7.8.9 (pre-release)
releases.body:
## VS Code

### Minor Changes

- [#14928](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14928) [`6522b4a`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/6522b4a57c7e8128c64f1991608088e8b51b097e) - Reorder projects in the Agent Manager sidebar with drag and drop. The order is kept after a restart.

- [#14919](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14919) [`69ec588`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/69ec588a5ba89ee0856d724255b6651d26963b0f) - Open chat links in the system browser with Shift-click when the Integrated Browser handles link clicks

- [#14900](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14900) [`9b8a58f`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/9b8a58f2c01bc6b8f9a34ae3bb302d0fbddbbce9) - Support opening the current Integrated Browser page in the external default browser

- [#14927](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14927) [`a023122`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/a023122851a2320826bb91b213e5ff9398c04931) - Show the agent, model, and reasoning selectors as one split control in the prompt toolbar and the Agent Manager New Worktree dialog. While one picker is open, move the pointer to another part to switch to it, or use the Left and Right arrow keys. The reasoning level shows only when it is set and there is room. Otherwise it collapses into the trailing arrow, and a changed level shows for a moment. On narrow sidebars, less used actions move into a "More actions" menu one at a time, while voice input and send stay visible. The toolbar always stays one row, so a long model name truncates and does not hide actions.

### Patch Changes

- [#14896](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14896) [`064bb13`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/064bb13fb9dbc45f960eab9326b2dc75bea33c8e) - Align the loading spinner with the subagent identicon. The spinner now uses the same 5x5 dot grid as subagent avatars, so loading and subagent indicators share one cell layout. The four corner cells stay empty and the same twinkle animation is kept.

- [#14899](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14899) [`7cf9fdc`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/7cf9fdc0b8d542c213838d21d579b423d472fcae) - Move the agent board button next to the background agents above the prompt. It shows the latest posts and marks new ones, and stays available after agents are cleared or the window reloads.

- [#14898](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14898) [`5afa419`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/5afa4197f9fad64ccd2741da13beb6c507017508) - Match the Integrated Browser color scheme to the current IDE theme so pages that support `prefers-color-scheme` render in dark or light to match the editor.

- [#14893](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14893) [`3249118`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/32491185e9f9afcaf36a830718124162d22b2ce7) Thanks [@madrugado](https://github.com/madrugado)! - Retry provider connection resets (`Connection reset by server`) through the normal retry path with backoff instead of pausing the session waiting for network reconnection. Connection resets are transient server-side failures when the error is marked retryable; only genuine network disconnections still trigger the offline wait.

- [#14738](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14738) [`d9f9d72`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/d9f9d72e58ad680bff9bd9dd1416d296ee5b09da) Thanks [@brunoagatao](https://github.com/brunoagatao)! - Fix permission prompts from subagents failing with "Failed to update permissions" and getting stuck

- [#14519](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14519) [`46428e7`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/46428e7183cf9eabd0d1d8b2dc0430d5d8550bb5) Thanks [@jsilvermist](https://github.com/jsilvermist)! - Fix backend startup when a Windows drive root is opened as a workspace.

- [#14932](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14932) [`f852d17`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/f852d1717dc3b2bedc1dd4959a1f41cfd7c9955a) - Show page cursor feedback in the Integrated Browser, including text fields, resize handles, and drag controls, without changing page scrolling or compositing.

- [#14934](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14934) [`6e033dc`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/6e033dc593de472a1c547c27826ed068da2ec1b9) - Use the standard open-in-browser icon for the Agent Manager PR panel's external link button, so it matches the open-in-browser affordance used elsewhere in the app.

- [#14734](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14734) [`1ecce5a`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/1ecce5a79371b496cdd25b9da8898acf3222891d) Thanks [@brunoagatao](https://github.com/brunoagatao)! - Label scheduled cron and wakeup prompts in the chat instead of showing them as user messages

- [#14901](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14901) [`2c25217`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/2c252174913be4defd4e91aef350f517bbba10fc) - Fix a thin line of diff content showing above the sticky file header in the Agent Manager diff panel and review when VS Code is zoomed.

- [#14930](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14930) [`0988371`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/0988371425927d97319d9bb07ceb5f0e1f964acc) - Add a tooltip to the subagent open button in the chat transcript. It shows whether the subagent opens in an editor tab (sidebar) or in the Agent Manager panel.

- Updated dependencies [[`0a5c6df`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/0a5c6df3486d897d142752173545a1d153b8cdaa)]:
  - @kilocode/kilo-indexing@7.8.9
  - @opencode-ai/core@7.8.9
  - @kilocode/kilo-ui@7.8.9
  - @opencode-ai/ui@7.8.9

## CLI

### Patch Changes

- [#14528](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14528) [`6f90fe1`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/6f90fe19ffbd472435b415e1ad855c528f1c2ee2) - Tune the `agent_manager` and `task` tool instructions so agents only start new Agent Manager sessions or worktrees when the user explicitly asks, or after confirming with the user first.

- [#14524](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14524) [`adf5026`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/adf502643b195d22fe0275ddc1833919f44b4a26) Thanks [@kimnamu](https://github.com/kimnamu)! - Keep Amazon Bedrock GPT-6 and GPT-5.6 sessions working after a tool returns an image.

- [#14192](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14192) [`4290338`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/4290338d85d4b854da16aabb27ae4bca038cd47e) Thanks [@maphew](https://github.com/maphew)! - Cloud sessions: the bash tool now advertises a session-scoped temp dir covered by the injected permission rules instead of the denied shared temp dir.

- [#14064](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14064) [`1ed91ed`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/1ed91edf798a7626b9a4eaf4c42ed13d05ce028e) Thanks [@cpruijsen](https://github.com/cpruijsen)! - Stop reporting a false frontmatter parse error when saving command markdown files

- [#14537](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14537) [`b9e4b1e`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b9e4b1e9863f9b42e6c42bb8d450ff134aa37e3f) - Report an error instead of silently keeping the old value when a config change is overridden by a higher-priority file such as `opencode.json`. Config validation and write failures now return the file and issue details instead of an opaque server error.

- [#14757](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14757) [`f01c7dd`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/f01c7ddb0ace8a8944a08257ba16138dee4bc737) Thanks [@thomasbrugman](https://github.com/thomasbrugman)! - Avoid enabling thinking automatically for custom providers whose names contain zai or zhipuai.

- [#13593](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/13593) [`1f093ff`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/1f093ffed0ae99d91bbbc949eac6d4f180d39cfc) Thanks [@maphew](https://github.com/maphew)! - Log structural diagnostics (message part sequences, tool-call/result pairing, schema issue paths) when the AI SDK rejects an assembled request, instead of failing with a bare `ModelMessage[] schema` error.

- [#14809](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14809) [`3b0be76`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/3b0be767c7a05cd85f0c38ce0abeca804c557cda) Thanks [@kr1shna-exe](https://github.com/kr1shna-exe)! - Stop MCP servers from piling up when a request is cancelled while they are still starting. Servers that had already started are now shut down, and the next request starts MCP again instead of failing until the backend restarts.

- [#14812](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14812) [`b4b51f2`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b4b51f25269027451c293a665471095a43300b6b) - Keep slash commands working when a plugin or your config defines a command named `goal`. Such a command clashes with Kilo's own `/goal` and used to hide every slash command, including `/init`, `/review`, and your own, leaving autocomplete empty. releases.name: JetBrains 7.1.10-rc.3
releases.body:
### Added

- Let the glob tool search an opt-in allowlist of ignored paths.

### Fixed

- Track Windows background processes with a job object instead of polling PowerShell.
- Stop Windows background runners from adopting unrelated processes.
- Keep Windows stop requests until a trustworthy process walk confirms exit.
- Name a surviving leader in the unconfirmed stop warning.
- Keep Windows stop responsive during exit confirmation.

### Changed

- Bundled Kilo CLI pin remains v7.8.9.

releases.name: JetBrains 7.1.10-rc.4
releases.body:
### Added

- Opt in to the JetBrains Marketplace error handler so crashes and freezes attributed to the plugin are reported on the plugin's Marketplace page.
- Fork a remote session from a specific message, branching the conversation at that point.

### Fixed

- Show an inline notice in the chat when an attached file cannot be read.
- Expand transcript blocks only while a block is in the actively streaming turn, so opening a session no longer auto-expands history.
- Recover a session stuck on "Considering next steps" by re-reading the pending prompt when the session view misses it.
- Keep the prompt draft in step with the transcript and restore the prompt text and attachments when reverting a message.
- Keep MCP sign-in from resetting, sync the authentication warning across all open sessions, and stop the MCP stream probe from rewriting OAuth metadata.
- Stop glob and grep include patterns from bypassing `.gitignore`.
- Handle non-UTF-8 ripgrep matches in grep without failing.

### Changed

- Bundled Kilo CLI pin updated to v7.8.10.

- [#14809](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14809) [`3b0be76`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/3b0be767c7a05cd85f0c38ce0abeca804c557cda) Thanks [@kr1shna-exe](https://github.com/kr1shna-exe)! - Stop MCP servers from piling up when a request is cancelled while they are still starting. Servers that had already started are now shut down, and the next request starts MCP again instead of failing until the backend restarts.

- [#14812](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14812) [`b4b51f2`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b4b51f25269027451c293a665471095a43300b6b) - Keep slash commands working when a plugin or your config defines a command named `goal`. releases.name: JetBrains 7.1.10
releases.body:
### Added

- Show and edit agent models from the agents list.
- Configure transcript display, with a live preview and localized settings.
- Reuse the Core submenu in the prompt bar menu.
- Opt in to the Marketplace error handler.
- Fork a remote session from a message in the CLI.
- Let glob search an opt-in allowlist of ignored paths.
- Bundle Kilo CLI v7.8.12.

### Fixed

- Restore session lists after a CLI reconnect.
- Stop overriding the user permission config.
- Clear MCP sign-in state when the server is removed.
- Make the model reset forget the saved per-mode pick.
- Navigate to transcript parts from the session timeline, and jump to a step when its timeline bar is clicked.
- Auto-expand transcript blocks only while live.
- Recover a missed pending prompt from backend activity.
- Surface unreadable attachments as an inline chat notice.
- Use the primary brand yellow for logos.
- Keep RC builds on the production session database.
- Report why a provider failed to load instead of hiding it.
- Preserve custom agents and edit permissions during delegation.
- Stop automatic MCP OAuth reset and sync auth badges.
- Handle non-UTF-8 ripgrep matches in grep.
- Stop glob and grep include patterns from bypassing `.gitignore`.
- Track Windows background jobs and runner identity natively, and reject stale parent links when stopping them.
- Require explicit user intent before starting Agent Manager sessions or worktrees.
- Expose a reserved command-name clash as `/goal:command`.
- Point cloud sessions at a permitted temp directory.
- Resolve bare model names for task subagents.
- Surface terminal compaction failures.
- Limit Z.ai thinking defaults to built-in providers.
- Avoid false frontmatter errors when saving command files.
- Bound serve shutdown after signals.
- Send tool-result images as user content for Bedrock GPT-6 models.
- Reuse the loaded transcript when pruning large payloads.
- Clean up MCP servers when their startup is interrupted.
- Improve the missing-binary error message for Windows ARM64.
- Retry retryable connection resets through the normal backoff path.
- Start the backend in Windows drive-root workspaces.

### Changed

- Route gateway traffic via `KILO_AI_GATEWAY_URL`.

- [#14942](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14942) [`b7672ae`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/b7672ae502af111048191119d61cea62157291f5) - Show why a provider failed to load — such as rejected credentials or a network error — instead of silently hiding it from the provider list. The CLI, TUI, and VS Code model picker now surface the reason and offer to sign in again when credentials were rejected.

- [#15124](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15124) [`a85b9a8`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/a85b9a8ba4b16f328ad624f20c7b6f6bb4ff95b8) - Preserve session status timing for accurate overnight activity and blocker reporting.

- [#15180](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15180) [`ec376c5`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/ec376c55b35fd6d8cfb261909c5738c0b9a596e0) - Keep stray console output from dependencies out of the TUI. Warnings written straight to the terminal by libraries running in the session worker — for example the MCP SDK's notice about OAuth tokens saved without an `issuer` — used to land on top of the rendered screen and stay there until a redraw, leaving the splash screen or chat view shredded. Those writes now go to the log file instead.

- [#13260](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/13260) [`8d5c126`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/8d5c126dc5ed9626fcb861a3a51f3566b73addb6) Thanks [@waewoo](https://github.com/waewoo)! - Allow OpenAI-compatible providers that require string content for tool calls to opt in without changing the default request format.

The CLI, TUI, and VS Code model picker now surface the reason and offer to sign in again when credentials were rejected.

- [#15124](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15124) [`a85b9a8`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/a85b9a8ba4b16f328ad624f20c7b6f6bb4ff95b8) - Preserve session status timing for accurate overnight activity and blocker reporting.

- [#15180](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/15180) [`ec376c5`](https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/commit/ec376c55b35fd6d8cfb261909c5738c0b9a596e0) - Keep stray console output from dependencies out of the TUI. releases.name: JetBrains 7.2.1-rc.1
releases.body:
### Added

- Added hosted Kilo Cloud sessions to Agent Manager. Cloud workspaces now share the same editor chrome as local and worktree sessions, including session rows, date groups, badges, busy spinners, and refresh from the row menu.
- Cloud discovery now pages through every workspace for a repository, reports the canonical status vocabulary instead of showing healthy workspaces as unknown, and shows the hourly compute price in the workspace header.
- Linked custom router entries to platform benchmarks.
- Indexing now prunes ignored directories and bounds LanceDB index growth.

### Fixed

- Cloud sessions recover their streams after reconnects without leaving tools running or hiding wake progress, and preparation failures are surfaced with sanitized error details.
- Kept hosted stream ownership across restarts and retained transcript subscriptions when the first attachment fails transiently.
- Kept large Cloud repositories from bursting the CLI with concurrent workspace status reads.
- Aligned hosted prompts with the Cloud input contract.
- Established a session's event subscription before startup returns so early updates are not missed.
- Compaction now runs at the configured threshold and stops compaction loops, and chunked compaction gets the normal output budget.
- Scheduled tasks fire once across processes sharing a data directory.
- Kept a reply that another Kilo process is still writing, and preserved the real exit code of a failed background job.
- Restricted browser and MCP OAuth URLs to HTTP(S), and scoped the MCP SSE probe to its own request and redirects.
- Blocked compromised eMudhra certificates.
- Preserved the parent user-agent when loading npm config.

### Changed

- Bundled Kilo CLI pin updated to v7.8.22 (via v7.8.20).
- Updated commonmark to 0.30.1.

releases.name: v2.2.0
releases.body:
### Highlights

- Create, install and share [Desktop plugins](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/build/plugins/gui) (experimental) ([#55246](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/55246), [#59469](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59469), [#59489](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59489))
- Refreshed the desktop app experience ([#56898](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/56898), [#58865](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58865), [#55838](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/55838), [#57962](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/57962))
- Add experimental image and decision generation APIs to plugins and sdk, allowing image generation or decision model (think typesafe, clef, etc) workflows. ([#59190](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59190), [#59380](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59380), [#58758](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58758))
- Plugins can now attach and update keyed session instructions with ctx.session.instructions.entry.put/list/remove. Instead of editing the system prompt and busting the prompt cache, each change is added as a small update at the next step. The entries also survive compaction and reverts, and they don't start an extra model turn. ([#56550](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/56550))
- Restored the Todo tool in desktop via opt-in ([#59092](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59092))
- Add configurable prompt cache TTLs per provider/model ([#59157](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59157))

### Breaking changes

#### `@opencode/ai` root is now the Promise API

`@opencode/ai` now works like `@opencode/sdk` and `@opencode/client`: the package root exports the Promise API, and the Effect API moved to `@opencode/ai/effect`. `@opencode/ai/promise` is removed, and the wildcard subpath export is replaced with an explicit list of provider and protocol entry points. ([#58847](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58847), [#59183](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59183))

```diff
-import { AI } from "@opencode/ai/promise"
-import { LLM } from "@opencode/ai"
+import { AI } from "@opencode/ai"
+import { LLM } from "@opencode/ai/effect"
```

#### The OpenCode GitHub Action is removed

The OpenCode GitHub Action is no longer published. Remove it from your workflows. ([#59032](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59032))

#### TUI plugins require OpenTUI 0.7

`@opencode/plugin` now requires `@opentui/core` and `@opentui/solid` 0.7.0, up from 0.6.8 or later. Plugins that depend on OpenTUI 0.6 fail to install until they upgrade. In OpenTUI 0.7, custom renderables read their hooks from their class at construction: assign `renderBefore`, `renderAfter`, and `onLifecyclePass` in the constructor instead of as class fields, call `refreshHooks()` after adding a hook by reflection, and replace `defineNativeIntegration()` with a `static nativeIntegration` declaration. See the [OpenTUI 0.7.0 release notes](https://opentui.com/docs/releases/0.7.0). ([#59295](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59295))

### Core

#### Improvements

- Add experimental image and decision generation API endpoints. ([#59190](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59190))
- Add image and decision entrypoints for catalog providers. ([#59380](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59380))
- Improve integration rebuild performance. ([#59402](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59402))
- Let custom model configuration set a model type. ([#59388](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59388))
- Let model-list API requests filter by type. ([#59355](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59355))
- Make external-directory permission checks use the project's filesystem. ([#59089](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59089))
- Reduce memory use when code search finds very large lines. ([#59205](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59205))
- Let plugins filter event subscriptions by type. ([#58864](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58864))
- Add configurable prompt-cache TTLs. ([#59157](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59157))
- Move image resizing off the main process and release idle image memory. ([#58820](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58820))
- Reduce repeated session-history loading during a step. ([#59091](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59091))
- Add an experimental API for session media and opt-in media URI support. ([#59103](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59103))
- Add the machine hostname to `/api/info`. ([#59090](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59090))
- Add experimental content-addressed blob storage for session media behind `experimental.media_blob`. ([#58656](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58656), [#58741](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58741))
- Start session history from the latest completed compaction. ([#59020](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59020))
- Reduce work encoding durable event payloads that are not persisted. ([#58923](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58923))
- Expose MCP server titles from `serverInfo`. ([#58950](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58950))
- Apply OpenCode Console workspace configuration as a configuration layer. ([#57703](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/57703))
- Replace experimental evaluations with Decision APIs in the AI pkg, including OpenAI Decisions, System One, and Cloudflare Run models. ([#58758](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58758), [#58382](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58382), [#58379](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58379), [#58381](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58381))
- Convert tool schemas once to speed up tool execution. ([#58798](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58798), [#58848](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58848))
- Make Git project discovery faster while recognizing repository changes. ([#58616](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58616))
- Show OpenCode Console budget limits and Go usage where they block you. ([#58694](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58694), [#58714](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58714))
- Record provider-reported session costs. ([#58562](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58562))
- Find Git more reliably on macOS. ([#58602](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58602))
- Resolve model details once per prompt step. ([#58601](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58601))
- Let plugins manage session instruction entries for subsequent model requests. ([#56550](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/56550))
- Add GPT-6.1 Terra and GPT-6.1 Terra Fast to Sign in with ChatGPT. ([#59359](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59359))

#### Bug fixes

- Wait for plugins to finish reloading before each session step and tool call. Thanks [@kernel-oops](https://github.com/kernel-oops) and [@Tarquinen](https://github.com/Tarquinen). ([#51133](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/51133))
- Size session compaction from the provider's reported token count to preserve usable context. ([#59441](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59441))
- Skip unavailable models.dev API entrypoints instead of failing model catalog updates. ([#59475](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59475))

([#57449](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/57449), [#58013](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58013), [#58577](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58577), [#57944](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/57944), [#58052](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58052), [#58494](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58494), [#58073](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58073), [#58114](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/58114))

releases.body:
### Highlights

- **Keep Working Toward a Goal**: Run `/goal <objective>` in the TUI or Desktop to let the session continue until a reviewer confirms the objective is met. Use `/goal pause`, `/goal resume`, or `/goal clear` to control it. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))
- **Generate Images**: Enable `experimental.image_generate` to let agents create or edit images with the new `image_generate` tool. You can optionally set its default model with `experimental.image_generate.model`. ([#59939](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59939), [#60096](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60096))
- **Inspect Background Shells**: Click a running shell in the Desktop activity pill to see its live output and stop it without leaving the menu. ([#59496](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59496))
- **New Default Model Picker**: Search favorites, recent models, providers, and variants from the redesigned model picker, which is now the default in Desktop. ([#59997](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59997))

### Breaking changes

#### `@opencode/ai` provider removals and renames

These changes affect code that imports `@opencode/ai` directly. They don't change the CLI, Desktop, or the HTTP API.

- The fal, Black Forest Labs, Replicate, and Stability providers are removed, along with their `./providers/fal`, `./providers/black-forest-labs`, `./providers/replicate`, and `./providers/stability` entry points. ([#59977](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59977))
- Five legacy entry points are removed. Import the nested paths instead, which 2.2.0 already exports: `./providers/amazon-bedrock-mantle` → `./providers/amazon-bedrock/mantle`, and `./providers/google-vertex-chat`, `-interactions`, `-mistral`, and `-responses` → `./providers/google-vertex/chat`, `/interactions`, `/mistral`, and `/responses`. ([#59506](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59506))
- Each provider's `configure()` input type is now named `Config`, for example `Groq.LanguageModelOptions` → `Groq.Config`, and `model()` settings are optional when every setting is optional. ([#59765](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59765))

### Core

#### Improvements

- Add `/goal <objective>` with pause, resume, and clear controls, plus automatic progress review until the objective is met. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))
- Add opt-in scheduled prompts through `/schedule`, agent tools, and `experimental.schedules`. ([#59401](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59401), [#59457](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59457))
- Add the opt-in `image_generate` tool for background image creation and editing, with automatic or configured model selection. ([#59939](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59939), [#60096](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60096))
- Offer GPT Image 2 after Codex sign-in and add MiniMax and Meta Muse image generation support. ([#60085](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60085), [#59929](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59929), [#60081](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60081))
- Add Responses API support for OpenRouter, DigitalOcean, and Venice, including freeform tools. ([#59991](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59991), [#59963](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59963))
- Improve snapshot performance by coalescing captures and avoiding repeated ignore-file work. ([#59419](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59419))

#### Bug fixes

- Preserve more context headroom when fitting tool output into the context window. ([#59934](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59934))
- Retry provider throttling correctly instead of reporting it as context overflow. ([#59649](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59649))
- Send image-edit references and image sizes in the formats expected by OpenRouter, Google, and Vercel Grok. ([#60067](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60067), [#59927](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59927))
- Keep credential metadata and prompt-cache settings out of model settings and variants. ([#60057](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60057), [#59500](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59500))
- Keep Git snapshots working in repositories that use a split index. ([#59417](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59417))
- Expose Console web search only when the workspace enables it. ([#59592](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59592))
- Improve Code Mode diagnostics for parse errors, stalled awaits, and promise-like search results. ([#59834](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59834), [#59749](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59749), [#59981](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59981))

### TUI

#### Improvements

- Show `/goal` status below the prompt and provide a dialog for pausing, resuming, or clearing it. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))

#### Bug fixes

- Show execution failures that occur before the first model step. ([#60079](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60079))
- Keep the activity spinner visible while a continued subagent runs. ([#59950](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59950))
- Send pasted image and PDF paths correctly when connected to a local server. ([#59833](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59833))
- Improve spacing in an empty `/usage` dialog. Thanks [@Tarquinen](https://github.com/Tarquinen). ([#59918](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59918))

### Desktop

#### Improvements

- Add `/reload` to reload configuration without restarting. ([#59887](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59887))
- Make the redesigned searchable model picker the default, with dedicated Favorites and Recent sections and keyboard-accessible provider controls. ([#59997](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59997))
- Show live output and a Stop action when you select a background shell from the activity pill. ([#59496](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59496))
- Show `/goal` state and actions in a composer pill. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))
- Redesign the integrations dialog and always include OpenCode free models in the model picker. ([#59976](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59976), [#60047](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60047))
- Add project, worktree, open-in-app, and terminal actions to the session location menu. ([#59607](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59607))
- Refine project and worktree selection, command search, prompt-history focus, composer model labels, and artifact preview controls. ([#59397](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59397), [#59604](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59604), [#59626](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59626), [#59735](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59735), [#59657](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59657))
- Highlight quoted timeline content while you write its first comment. ([#59286](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59286))
- Keep draft attachment bytes local when using experimental media URIs. ([#59104](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59104))

#### Bug fixes

- Follow each plugin server’s configured endpoint when connecting to its event stream. ([#60087](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60087))
- Treat the reachable scroll boundary as the end when Desktop zoom is active. ([#60034](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/60034))
- Prevent shell text from showing through copy buttons and avoid restyling the transcript when closing a side panel. ([#59901](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59901), [#59878](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59878))
- Keep rendering malformed tool metadata instead of crashing the timeline. ([#59736](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59736))
- Make dropdowns open immediately and keep the new-session location shortcut working after tooltip interactions. ([#59268](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59268), [#59680](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59680))
- Remove edge halos from macOS application icons. ([#59900](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59900))

### SDK

#### Improvements

- Add `client.experimental.schedule.{create,list,get,pause,resume,delete}` for managing scheduled prompts. ([#59457](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59457))
- Group experimental generated-client methods under `client.experimental`; previous locations remain as deprecated aliases until the next minor release. ([#59072](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59072))
- Expose compaction through the Promise AI client. ([#59987](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59987))
- Add freeform tool support and Responses routes for OpenRouter, DigitalOcean, and Venice. ([#59963](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59963), [#59991](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59991))

### Extensions

#### Improvements

- Add the experimental `experimental.idle` Session hook so plugins can continue work before a session goes idle. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))
- Let Code Mode extension globals return Effects and declare required services. ([#59948](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59948))
- Add custom composer-pill popovers for GUI plugins. ([#59437](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/pull/59437))
