## 2026.10.5-beta.2

### Highlights

- **Updates finish and recover:** `openclaw update` settles stale handoff leases, completed receipts, and legacy 2026.9.8 recovery records instead of stopping on `update-recovery-pending`, keeps the service heap limit and webhook listeners, handles Windows short-name paths, and no longer reports accepted handoffs or successful updates as failures. (#169038, #169027, #168388, #168889, #169035, #169292, #168927, #168993, #169037, #169454, #168905) Thanks @mkdelta221, @waynegault, @chedong, @k94118, @bluet, @sirius1024, @RomneyDa, @sayitfast, and @hannesrudolph.
- **Doctor keeps your plugins and data:** Doctor preserves installed plugins' configuration when path safety checks block them, leaves malformed UTF-8 root memory files untouched, and recovery copies capture Canvas and Memory Core files before migrations move them, including on installs with no configured agents. (#168111, #169029, #169436, #169516) Thanks @obviyus, @wangmiao0668000666, and @RomneyDa.
- **Approved tool calls stay as approved:** hooks can no longer change tool arguments after a trusted inline approval; plugins that transform arguments must request approval for their final arguments. (#142700) Thanks @giodl73-repo and @giodl73.
- **Subagent message provenance:** inter-session messages keep their `[Inter-session message]` safety envelope from the first request and through replay, so parent-sent instructions are never presented to a child as direct user instructions. (#169130, #169238) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Control UI turns keep running:** chat turns from paired devices survive ordinary pairing activity such as node heartbeats, other devices' updates, and tab reconnects; real revocations still stop them. (#169457, #169134) Thanks @Oldrich333.

### Changes

- **Tool approval hooks:** ordinary hooks can no longer rewrite trusted-inline-approved tool arguments without another approval, and transforming plugins must request separate approval for their final arguments or the call is blocked; see `docs/plugins/hooks/tool-policy.md` for migration. (#142700) Thanks @giodl73-repo and @giodl73.
- **Codex runtime compatibility:** plugin admission rejects official Codex runtimes below 2026.9.7 with update and repair guidance, and incompatible plugins stay inspectable without being imported. (#168930, #168748, #168749, #168977) Thanks @ezimerman.
- **Session notices:** creating many sessions gives the main session one summary of new sessions instead of separate notices that crowd out reminders and wakes. (#168239)
- **Update performance:** updates stop rehashing unchanged runtime files while retaining the running updater and publishing the candidate, reducing update I/O. (#168958)

### Fixes

- **Tool Search provenance:** network results reached through Tool Search and Code Mode now taint the turn the same way direct network tool calls do. (#169560, #169332) Thanks @RomneyDa and @farisoftfry.
- **Subagent provenance:** child sessions keep the inter-session safety envelope on every replayed turn, and inter-session turns keep a stable provider prompt prefix across later turns and Gateway restarts. (#169130, #169238) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Node commands and approvals:** approved node commands replay when their prepared plan omitted session identity, Windows node shell commands keep quoted arguments, safe-bin commands accept trailing whitespace, and the Linux node service keeps its PATH when the login shell resets it. (#161980, #151622, #158160, #142847, #168120, #136677, #134354) Thanks @Program-123, @gaojian125, @Dimitri-lcht, @igs-rogenlo, @yetval, @harjothkhara, and @abacha.
- **Private reasoning:** unfinished model reasoning stays private when a reply hits a token limit or content filter after a tool call. (#168294)
- **Doctor data safety:** Doctor keeps blocked plugins' authored entries, enablement, policy, and slots; refuses to merge malformed UTF-8 root memory; captures Canvas and Memory Core files in new recovery copies (and works on installs with no configured agents); skips redundant cron backups for unchanged one-shot jobs; and honors Windows permissions for SQLite recovery snapshots. (#168111, #168066, #169029, #168567, #169436, #169516, #168938, #168838, #169397) Thanks @obviyus, @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, @harshitgupta31415, and @WG-Mojo.
- **Memory:** daily-note flushes reject copied saved content instead of repeating blocks, and correcting an embedding provider's endpoint or credential refreshes cached index managers without a Gateway restart. (#168123, #151263, #151055) Thanks @ruel225 and @Mirksen.
- **Restart recovery:** main sessions that were mid-turn during a Gateway restart resume on the next boot, interrupted completion replies are delivered instead of lost, and new replies wait for their agent to finish starting instead of failing with `prepared reply dispatch runtime owner was not published`. (#168651, #167814, #167766, #168826, #157814) Thanks @goutamadwant, @marknilsn, and @xiaozishan.
- **Reply routing:** WebChat task completions stay in WebChat, mirrored external sends no longer change a transcript's reply destination, and Reef carries GitHub commit links without flagging their revision IDs as credentials. (#168248)
- **Prompt caching:** conversations whose first message ends in whitespace keep a byte-stable prompt prefix, and OpenAI-compatible and local endpoints keep runtime context in a user-role message. (#168725, #168546, #164791) Thanks @flanker-stack.
- **Compaction:** sessions skip a redundant host compaction after native-only compaction, safeguard compaction keeps configured AGENTS.md sections, and memory-flush runs keep provider-native compaction off. (#168051, #168015, #168446, #168131, #168164) Thanks @ruel225, @xydigitLybnnnn, @robertoronderosjr, @jakeaadams, and @obviyus.
- **Control UI:** chat turns survive unrelated pairing activity, typed `/stop` also cancels queued turns for the session, and open chats recover after a Gateway update or recovery reload instead of sticking on **Server updated → Retry now**, keeping their place. (#169457, #169134, #167860, #167859, #168941, #169194) Thanks @Oldrich333 and @masatohoshino.
- **Telegram:** polling connects again when the ingress worker runs from a source checkout or packaged plugin build, and tables next to quotes or lists keep their boundaries and values. (#154286, #154180, #168383, #168366) Thanks @xydt-juyaohui, @markfietje, @dhruv1220, and @barry-ssb.
- **Channels and voice:** channels start again after a stopped-Tailscale failure, the Matrix probe stops its client after checking identity, and `openclaw voicecall steer` keeps stdout machine-readable JSON. (#162266, #168587) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Agent turns:** scheduled and ordinary turns reach the configured fallback after a provider timeout, queued follow-ups that switch model clear the auto-fallback probe, cancelled queued CLI work never runs, empty stream heartbeats no longer count as model progress, malformed tool calls whose argument length is 401 or 403 are not reported as auth failures, valid tool argument union values keep their type, and plugin completions keep working after another plugin reloads. (#168605, #160440, #160428, #169303, #145850, #168500, #168450, #158974, #168916, #156026) Thanks @hxy91819, @changeroa, @RileyJJY, @TYY-2005, @r3n3x, @Shenrui-Ma, and @jalehman.
- **Claude CLI:** Claude CLI models stay listed after another plugin's config changes, exec-completion turns keep their native and MCP tools, and saved session MCP server selections apply on the next turn. (#168315, #168670, #168342, #168393, #168207) Thanks @obviyus, @Oldrich333, and @dprev.
- **OpenRouter prompt caching:** cache-TTL context pruning now arms for Grok and Gemini 2.5+ models on OpenRouter. (#169548, #169133) Thanks @RomneyDa and @gregb100.
- **Models and providers:** API-key sign-in discovers the provider's models immediately, shared OAuth credentials refresh with historical agent stores, switching back to an OpenAI model works without the Codex plugin, timed-out Codex discovery clients are reaped, LM Studio waits for slow model loads instead of overflowing a fresh session, and credential removal during a model reload no longer leaves a restart warning. (#168617, #168957, #169412, #168365, #168044) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Model catalog memory:** a long-running Gateway's model-catalog worker evaluates an unchanged installed native ESM plugin once per workspace instead of retaining another copy of its module graph on every config change, and a failed native refresh re-registers the requested config on the next request. (#169272, #169321, #159662) Thanks @obviyus, @mcooks-cmd, @RomneyDa, and @svdinu-jpg.
- **MCP computer control:** computer control is released with its run, so later calls no longer fail with `COMPUTER_HOST_BUSY`. (#151127, #147420) Thanks @ylcn91 and @vovarbv.
- **Automations:** cron target and payload validation errors are reported as invalid requests, and Workboard fallback runs stay active until the overall outcome settles. (#169102, #168215, #167574) Thanks @obviyus, @skyzhao1223, and @asikorskiy.
- **Agents API sessions:** saved remote sessions continue with the same session ID across binding upgrades. (#168150)
- **Large Gateways:** large fleets reserve session stores without stack overflows, and process-owning Gateway stops no longer wait on native skills watcher cleanup. (#168354, #168160, #168273) Thanks @609NFT and @obviyus.
- **Updates and recovery:** managed updates settle eligible stale package recovery after a lost or replaced handoff lease database and archive completed receipts before the next preparation; `--dry-run` only reports the planned settlement. (#169038, #167506, #167771) Thanks @mkdelta221 and @waynegault.
- **Legacy update records:** 2026.9.8 package recovery records settle by identity and version after metadata drift, completed-receipt identity drift no longer blocks updates, and public repair exits nonzero with guidance when a journal stays pending. (#169027, #168856, #168388, #168092) Thanks @chedong, @k94118, and @RomneyDa.
- **Update outcomes:** accepted Gateway update handoffs are not reported as failures, recorded successes stay successful with a warning about stopped channels, original failures survive unavailable cleanup reporting, repaired migrations stop producing stale warnings, package verification tolerates clock jumps, and migrated-state failures point to `openclaw update repair`. (#168993, #168870, #169037, #169454, #169004, #168835, #168905) Thanks @sayitfast, @hannesrudolph, and @WG-Mojo.
- **Update memory and webhooks:** update children inherit the managed service's heap limits so Doctor finishes on large agent databases, and official webhook plugins deferred during candidate Doctor keep their listeners, including Teams' historical port 3978. (#168889, #168729, #169035, #168872) Thanks @bluet and @sirius1024.
- **Update runtimes:** updater workers stay on the retained runtime and `openclaw doctor --fix` reclaims retained runtimes when the install path uses a Windows short (8.3) name or different casing, and updates no longer copy unrelated dependencies into the retained runtime. (#169292, #168927) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Update diagnostics:** an unsealed original-state capture warning names the affected database, and a candidate config read failure warning includes its reason. (#169282, #169259, #169284, #169261) Thanks @DonnieFi.
- **Codex Ultrafast:** ChatGPT sign-in sessions keep Ultrafast on resumed turns instead of dropping to Fast after the first turn. (#169265, #169264) Thanks @SanderHelgesen.
- **npm-global updates:** the updater runtime keeps only OpenClaw's own dependencies instead of every unrelated package in the global `node_modules`. (#169551, #169373) Thanks @RomneyDa and @holgergruenhagen.
- **Update exit handling:** a completed update whose result reporting fails exits with its warning instead of opening interactive failure triage. (#168587)
- **Doctor maintenance:** Doctor and update repair enter maintenance on a running systemd Gateway even when checking a large state database is slow. (#168161, #168031) Thanks @obviyus and @Tosko4.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.5-beta.1..8ed6123845921594f4643c1914e8ceb8cfb42c07 history: 91 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 91 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.5-beta.3

### Highlights

- **Updates leave the Gateway running:** pnpm 12 installs keep their Gateway service and `openclaw` launcher on the durable install path, Windows updates accept qualified Scheduled Task accounts and their own verified driver, macOS accepts protected Bun service commands, and clean service-install refusals no longer leave the Gateway stopped. (#170003, #169059, #170131, #169244, #169481, #169563, #170006, #169662, #169658, #169915) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @RomneyDa, @jokerman1302-eng, and @vincentkoc.
- **Stuck updates recover:** updates settle package-activation journals after filesystem remounts or device-number drift, ride out a briefly locked state database, stop reporting false post-install failures after migration, and reclaim retained updater runtimes that blocked npm recovery. (#169410, #170046, #169050, #169352, #168210, #170130, #169422, #170170, #169463) Thanks @patrickschiller, @RomneyDa, @SergeiAug, @angeliti999, and @Warhangel.
- **Doctor keeps credentials and data:** Doctor no longer deletes an OAuth profile when the legacy auth store is unreadable, refuses retired state before migrating the database, imports retained ACP metadata, and restores a stopped Gateway when cleanup fails. (#170256, #168959, #170051, #169918, #169759, #169783) Thanks @Yolo521-bot, @bautrey, and @RomneyDa.
- **Turns survive restarts:** interrupted turns, subagent work, automation turns, steered sessions, and node-hosted turns resume after a Gateway restart, and streamed replies from a killed worker stay in history. (#168650, #169144, #170162, #170252, #170161, #170223)
- **Telegram never replays old updates:** the first start after updating no longer re-dispatches months-old Telegram updates from the legacy spool as new owner instructions. (#170068, #169784) Thanks @angeliti999.
- **Codex and provider replies complete:** Codex replies keep their last tokens and accept follow-ups after a failed thread preparation, ChatGPT turns retry a mid-stream WebSocket close, and DeepSeek tool markup no longer leaks into messages. (#168400, #169431, #167512, #167345, #169728, #159665) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jjjhenriksen, @ericcurtin, @obviyus, @mightyx, and @TOMUIV.
- **Meta Muse Wonder:** Meta users can select `meta/muse-wonder-1.0` with tools, image input, streaming, reasoning controls, and a 1M-token context window. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Plugin SDK compatibility:** plugins built against 2026.10.1 and 2026.10.2 can import `createSessionHeaderLink` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/control-ui` again. (#169746) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- **Meta Muse Wonder:** adds `meta/muse-wonder-1.0` with text and image input, tools, streaming, encrypted reasoning replay, and a 1,048,576-token context window; Spark remains the onboarding default. (#170232) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Device joins:** the CLI and Control UI join command now installs a background node service that can host agent sessions (`--service --session-host`), with a command-only service alternative, and already-paired devices get a working command to enable session hosting. (#168623) Thanks @obviyus.

### Fixes

- **Telegram:** legacy spool updates older than 24 hours are imported as stale and never dispatched, so already-handled messages are not executed again after an update. (#170068, #169784) Thanks @angeliti999.
- **Plugin SDK compatibility:** `createSessionHeaderLink` is restored in `openclaw/plugin-sdk/control-ui` as a deprecated export for plugins built against 2026.10.1 and 2026.10.2. (#169746) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Reply delivery:** streamed text from a killed native worker stays in history with its real failure, steered messages behind subagent announcements are no longer dropped as interrupted, blocking questions from routed agent turns reach their conversation, live sends survive delivery recovery, WebChat no longer shows false attachment errors or duplicate file cards, Talk consultations no longer abort right after connecting, and deleting a session records its cancellation before draining retained replies. (#170223, #168077, #170039, #169010, #169093, #170083) Thanks @RomneyDa and @brokemac79.
- **Restart recovery:** turns interrupted while a session was still preparing resume after a restart, interrupted subagents return to their parent with their history, automation turns, steered sessions, and node-hosted turns resume instead of failing with an active turn claim, a Gateway restarts cleanly when a stored cloud worker's machine is gone, and symlinked state directories keep working after a restart. (#168650, #169144, #170162, #170252, #170161, #168907, #168361) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Nodes and channels:** node requests and events no longer fail with "pairing changed" during another device's pairing activity, and channel tools keep working after a config write restarts the account. (#169486, #169575, #159396) Thanks @ceckert and @RomneyDa.
- **macOS app:** fresh app installs authenticate to their app-hosted Gateway and finish setup faster, and the Gateway reconnects automatically after a trusted TLS certificate renewal. (#169403, #168151)
- **Codex and OpenAI:** Codex replies keep their final tokens when a stream drops the last delta, Codex follow-ups work after a failed thread preparation, ChatGPT turns retry a mid-stream WebSocket close with code 1000, and personal-account quota rechecks no longer abort replies. (#168400, #169431, #167512, #167345, #170065) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jjjhenriksen, @ericcurtin, @obviyus, and @mightyx.
- **Models and providers:** DeepSeek tool-call markup is recovered instead of leaking into messages, Claude CLI sessions call registered OpenClaw tools by their MCP names, providers that never send response headers time out, agent runs honor the provider's live thinking levels without reloading catalogs, LM Studio refresh discovers new models, llama.cpp setup keeps aliased models and fails when credentials cannot be saved, and guarded model requests fall back to IPv6. (#169728, #159665, #153032, #168282, #168566, #168039, #150262, #168232, #168973, #87763) Thanks @TOMUIV, @kiranvk-2011, @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @jb-lopez, @an2in, and @georgenaz.
- **MiniMax:** M3.1 models honor their thinking effort levels, and MiniMax OAuth sign-ins refresh expired tokens instead of failing about two hours after login. (#160089, #160037, #160459, #77467) Thanks @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @masatohoshino, and @rongtianhua.
- **ACP and compaction:** ACP agents keep plugin and OpenClaw tools when acpx is installed as a separate package, and the next turn after native compaction no longer fails while the transcript projection rebuilds. (#164272, #164211, #169583) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @obviyus, and @ajmtrz.
- **Automations:** manual runs keep tool access after the starting turn ends, cron no longer holds the state writer while waiting on the host so updates do not fail with a locked database, and a one-shot automation that fails terminally now sends a failure notice instead of disabling silently. (#168037, #168291) Thanks @obviyus.
- **pnpm and platform updates:** pnpm 12 Gateway services and `openclaw` launchers stay on the durable install link after updates, Windows updates accept qualified Scheduled Task account names and no longer roll back when Doctor re-checks ancestry, macOS updates accept protected Bun service commands, and clean service-install refusals stay recoverable. (#170003, #169059, #170131, #169244, #169481, #169563, #170006, #169662, #169658) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @RomneyDa, and @jokerman1302-eng.
- **Update recovery:** package-activation journals settle after filesystem remounts and device-number drift, retained updater runtimes outside `node_modules` are reclaimed and never hard-link recovery files, upgrades keep state ownership across the heartbeat transition, and update-time Doctor keeps its child identities after a failed custody binding. (#169410, #170046, #169050, #169352, #170170, #169463, #169915, #169665) Thanks @patrickschiller, @RomneyDa, @SergeiAug, @Warhangel, and @vincentkoc.
- **Update outcomes:** updates with a running Gateway no longer record false post-install failures after migration, unsafe Doctor recovery guidance is kept until settled, candidate bookkeeping no longer makes older updaters refuse their config repair, and Doctor cleanup during updates no longer fails with nested-effect errors. (#170130, #169422, #170207, #170195, #170070, #168750) Thanks @angeliti999, @hannesrudolph, and @ezimerman.
- **Update database contention:** updates ride out a briefly locked state database, update history writes no longer stall Gateway cron and cleanup, and Doctor recovery captures stay stable while shared-state workers remain open. (#168210, #169283, #170022) Thanks @DonnieFi.
- **Doctor data safety:** Doctor keeps OAuth profiles when the legacy auth store is unreadable, refuses retired state before migrating the database, imports retained ACP metadata after archiving legacy session stores, restores a stopped Gateway when cleanup fails, and removes the `(multiple)` store sentinel registered as an agent database. (#170256, #168959, #170051, #169918, #169759, #169783, #170043, #169764) Thanks @Yolo521-bot, @bautrey, @RomneyDa, and @ourcoms2018.
- **oc-path:** `openclaw path set` refuses malformed UTF-8 before writing, preserving the file's bytes. (#168491) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666 and @Takhoffman.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.5-beta.4

### Highlights

- **Updates finish more reliably:** macOS updates no longer time out on aliased temporary directories, systemd user installs reclaim abandoned runtimes, pacman and FreeBSD package installs are left to their package manager, snapshot failures are identified before activation with accurate recovery advice, and the success summary no longer repeats settled plugin upgrades as pending. (#169860, #171488, #169055, #171457, #170351, #170413) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, and @Pegorim.
- **ChatGPT models work on the default Codex runtime:** ChatGPT-listed models no longer fail before sending any request. (#168033) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Headless browser sign-ins stay usable:** headless pages keep accepting clicks and key presses while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.

### Changes

- **Context limits:** status shows corrected context limits after model discovery, Copilot honors reported context capacity when native limits are missing, and llama.cpp keeps live router model limits and tools on refresh. (#165991, #156636, #168309) Thanks @snotty, @saju01, and @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- **Gateway access:** local access keeps working when the tailnet denies Tailscale Serve, and lifecycle publications survive after the emitting producer drains. (#171509, #170231) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **macOS repair and recovery:** update recovery finishes repairing the bundled Gateway, the app keeps a compatible newer Gateway during recovery instead of downgrading it, LaunchAgent repair accepts verified bootstrap recovery, and Doctor allows offline state repair for app-owned Gateways. (#171508, #170766, #170740, #170768) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Update resilience:** updates keep moving when optional cron inspection or snapshot cleanup fails. (#170754) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Security:** Tlon never treats group DM authors as the owner. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- **Turns and replies:** Claude CLI sessions remember announced sub-agent results on the next turn, agent plugin reloads no longer wait on their own turn, interrupted turns are preserved when new messages arrive, ACP follow-up replies no longer disappear after the previous turn is stopped, context-engine advancement survives steering, visible sub-agent spawns try the primary model first, and launched agent turns no longer fail with writer claim errors. (#164175, #171257, #170647, #170883, #168394, #169984, #170077) Thanks @robertoronderosjr, @RomneyDa, @etzelm, and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Gateway lifecycle:** the Gateway stays responsive during reply-tagged streams and long quoted tool XML no longer triggers per-token Markdown parsing, blocked context-engine turns stop repeating in the Gateway log on every run, the Control UI no longer reconnects on delayed heartbeats, state reads stay closed until restart after a failed state cleanup, the Gateway recovers state ownership after sleep and clock changes, stalled transcript workers no longer block shutdown, database admission no longer blocks worker startup, shutdown joins lifecycle publication, forced descendant cleanup releases worker capacity, enabled standalone plugin files start with the Gateway, Gateway restart works from verified external macOS terminals, and Android/Termux gateways no longer fail with "shared-state database generation changed". (#166782, #171573, #167595, #171253, #171709, #170790, #170493, #170348, #170555, #168746, #171330, #170354, #167719) Thanks @aniruddhaadak80, @holgergruenhagen, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @yxshee, @grabowskidaniel359-design, @jjjhenriksen, @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, @Oldrich333, @residentb2b, @boeingchoco, and @jalehman.
- **Workers:** worker heap limits are enforced under process-wide Node flags. (#166581) Thanks @valkyriweb, @xydigitLybnnnn, @goslingmanagment, and @waynegault.
- **Channels and tools:** MCP OAuth login completes with portless loopback registrations, and each Feishu monitor start gets its own binding adapter registration. (#170876, #169226) Thanks @9fw2pq8sgb-art, @ruel225, @obviyus, and @junniar.
- **Update and Doctor:** update repair no longer fails after Doctor completes on busy macOS hosts, slow update admission no longer holds the database writer and disrupts Gateway work, update repair prepares its config before inference, metadata inventory survives progress-output backpressure, Docker upgrades stop retry loops on older Linux hosts, Doctor explains plugin migration backup coverage, and Doctor no longer logs spurious WAL maintenance warnings while repairing shared state. (#170779, #171493, #170276, #168493, #162305, #169295, #170783) Thanks @vincentkoc, @yxshee, @Ludwigtheo0815, @RomneyDa, and @DonnieFi.
- **Plugin publishing:** plugin npm publication no longer fails when artifact pagination repeats an entry. (#171044) Thanks @RomneyDa.

releases.body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of September 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.10.3](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.10.3)

## 2026.9.33

### Highlights

- **Safer September upgrades:** updates on the 2026.9 line keep state, plugin data, service ownership, and Windows state paths intact, and refuse automatic restore over unattributed Doctor writes. (#160167, #166755) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vyctorbrzezowski, @jalehman, @Alix-007, @jayzhou2309, @nitinjwadhawan, @SunnyShu0925, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @taihartman, and @DonnieFi.
- **Updates that finish on pnpm, npm, and Windows:** pnpm 12 Gateway services and launchers survive native updates, retained updater runtimes no longer block npm recovery, and Windows updates no longer roll back after Doctor rechecks driver ancestry. (#170003, #170131, #170170, #169563) Thanks @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **New model support:** run Meta Muse Wonder, use MiniMax M3.1 thinking effort levels, and stay signed in to MiniMax portal OAuth past token expiry. (#170232, #160089, #160459) Thanks @RomneyDa, @NianJiuZst, @Takhoffman, @php737, @masatohoshino, @rongtianhua, @DonnieFi, @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, @mightyx, and @ajmtrz.
- **More reliable model turns:** agent runs honor live thinking levels, local providers get response-header deadlines, ChatGPT WebSocket normal closes recover, and Codex replies keep their final tokens. (#168566, #168282, #167512, #168400) Thanks @obviyus, @ericcurtin, @mightyx, @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, @Takhoffman, @NianJiuZst, @masatohoshino, @jjjhenriksen, @sjf-oa, @ceckert, @jayzhou2309, @brokemac79, @xilopaint, @k-sekula, @Warhangel, @Yolo521-bot, and @ajmtrz.
- **Work survives Gateway restarts:** interrupted automation turns, steered sessions, cloud worker claims, and partial worker replies now resume or persist after a restart. releases.name: openclaw 2026.10.10-beta.1
releases.body:
## 2026.10.10-beta.1

### Highlights

- **Faster, steadier Gateway:** chat turns, session lists, startup, and idle Gateways do far less SQLite and main-thread work, with more database work moved onto worker threads, so busy hosts and large agent fleets stay responsive. (#167965, #168002, #168093, #169005, #169164, #171685, #170151, #169871, #168649, #170612, #171371, #171805, #168992, #169543) Thanks @obviyus, @609NFT, @Leon-SK668, @chelsealong, @RomneyDa, and @joshavant.
- **Updates that finish:** upgrades from 2026.10.1 and earlier betas complete, busy Gateways and slow Doctor steps no longer refuse or roll back a good update, failed updates no longer leave a half-installed version, and macOS, Windows, and Bun installs recover from their platform-specific failures. (#168849, #172249, #172196, #172151, #172247, #171101, #170519, #172640, #171936, #170940, #171077, #172494) Thanks @RomneyDa, @homeworld520, @Yolo521-bot, @giulianoaccorsi, @AntaresGG, @stop-time, @davidcittadini, and @SBC2016.
- **Restart-safe replies:** interrupted and unfinished replies resume after a Gateway restart, and watched child results, queued turns, accepted agent updates, and operator tasks survive restarts instead of disappearing. (#172234, #172412, #169489, #171717, #170697, #170858, #170384, #172356, #172023) Thanks @jeanmonet.
- **Cloud sessions:** move sessions between local and cloud from the session menu, organize cloud environments by repository with environment recipes and verified Node toolchains, and see snapshot progress while sessions start before the first snapshot finishes uploading. (#171690, #170892, #170862, #170796, #170875, #170895, #171729)
- **Local Gateway in the desktop apps:** the Windows desktop app and fresh Tauri installs can run a local Gateway, fresh macOS installs start in guided dashboard setup, and first-run setup chooses inference automatically. (#169522, #169512, #169568, #169628)
- **New models:** Gemini 4 Argon becomes the default Gemini model alongside Gemini 3.8 Flash, Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and xAI Imagine Image 2.0 arrive, Meta models run through Muse Code, and pickers stop offering retired models. (#171852, #172339, #172449, #172445, #170487, #171526, #171879) Thanks @nv-kasikritc, @jacobtomlinson, @JFLeonM, and @obviyus.
- **Newer Apple platforms required:** OpenClaw now requires macOS 26.2, iOS 26.2, and Safari 26.2 or newer. (#168595)

### Changes

- **Apple platform requirement:** require macOS, iOS, and Safari 26.2 or newer for the native apps and Control UI. (#168595)
- **Cloud sessions:** move sessions between local and cloud from session menus, organize cloud environments by repository, support repository environment recipes with verified Node toolchains, save suggested cloud profiles on first use, show snapshot startup progress, start sessions while the first snapshot uploads, ready workers for empty-workspace sessions, report slow dispatch phases, and keep cloud setup secrets behind scoped egress grants. (#171690, #170892, #170862, #170796, #170875, #170895, #171729, #170929, #171749, #171073, #170810) Thanks @VACInc.
- **Desktop apps and first run:** support local Gateways in the Windows desktop app, start fresh Tauri installs with a local Gateway, start fresh macOS installs in guided dashboard setup, guide missing native permissions in chat, and choose inference automatically during first-run setup. (#169522, #169512, #169568, #169635, #169628)
- **Local setup:** offer optional memory embedding setup, add managed llama.cpp OCR and vision setup, and allow non-interactive llama.cpp embedding-only setup. (#163693, #148193, #170153) Thanks @PollyBot13, @duyufansh2008, and @dh-js.
- **Bun runtime:** build standalone OpenClaw executables with Bun, add an opt-in pinned Bun runtime that rejects unpinnable paths before changing anything, and start the Gateway faster on Bun. (#172384, #168832, #168982, #169543) Thanks @vincentkoc.
- **Experimental PostgreSQL:** add an experimental PostgreSQL engine for the Workboard store, select the shared-state engine at its owner, generate PostgreSQL DDL from canonical SQLite schemas, add PostgreSQL migrations with capability admission and exact schema-drift checks, preserve PostgreSQL stores in backups and updates, and add verified offline database port tooling. (#169214, #171962, #168219, #169933, #172265, #170828, #170518, #171368, #171265, #170037, #170055, #170059, #171350, #171484, #171518, #171795, #172046, #171545) Thanks @vincentkoc and @joshavant.
- **Conversations:** organize and archive nested conversations explicitly, choose when sessions can send and receive messages, opt in to `sessions_send` thread targets, run sessions in existing folders on paired devices, and snooze sessions until a custom time. (#168076, #162316, #168846, #169722, #171255) Thanks @VACInc, @obviyus, and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Session personalization:** personalize session backgrounds, add per-session speech bubbles and prompt reactions, show session-specific previews for public links, and match public conversation pages to the chat design with copy buttons. (#168301, #168861, #169527, #168156) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski and @VACInc.
- **Control UI navigation:** organize personal navigation in a compact sidebar rail with real shortcut icons, filter sidebar users by online status, keep New conversation visible across sidebar modes, show session details beside wide conversations, make colored sessions easier to scan, inspect attached automations from session hovercards, put everyday session actions first, and make release updates discoverable from the account menu. (#168325, #168997, #172243, #170771, #170707, #170382, #172240, #168616, #172544, #100024) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev, @shakkernerd, and @VACInc.
- **Control UI chat:** group session context and task progress in Details, clarify the session details inspector, render assistant directives and an embed tag, show readable tweet preview cards, load older history in larger pages, shrink the composer in existing sessions, search emoji by name in the reaction picker, add manual code folding to session diffs, and show or hide values in secure entry prompts. (#161674, #172436, #64104, #168213, #170481, #171637, #172577, #172350, #169925, #172549) Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @obviyus, @Takhoffman, @Patrick-Erichsen, and @jacobtomlinson.
- **Languages:** add Swedish to the Control UI and docs, and include plugin catalogs in locale refresh. (#62063, #171496) Thanks @yeager and @vincentkoc.
- **Agents API:** choose Agents API hosted workspaces when starting sessions, isolate Agents API sessions from Gateway tools and MCP, and allow shared compaction tuning in hosted sessions. (#168259, #170728, #171813)
- **MCP apps and automations:** use MCP plugin apps across conversations and workspace files, trigger automations from MCP events, connect MCP apps through a principal-bound relay plugin, and support principal-bound remote Control UI for trusted plugins. (#161747, #165399, #168233, #170540)
- **Plugins and SDK:** allow per-run model fallback overrides, fork a session's live context for background side questions, let plugins steer a session's active run, support Solid Control UI views, add worker-owned keyed state and conversation binding APIs, join service and account scheduling at retirement, complete awaited SQLite compatibility migration paths, and show calm notices for deprecated SDK usage. (#168893, #170146, #170152, #168408, #168478, #168483, #162669, #171443, #171752) Thanks @obviyus, @dwty11, and @joshavant.
- **ClawHub:** expose published ClawHub packages to the Gateway and accept portable manifest categories. (#171622, #171532) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
- **Models and providers:** add Gemini 4 Argon as the default Gemini model with Gemini 3.8 Flash, replace Nemotron 3 Super with Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, add xAI Imagine Image 2.0 without silent image-model fallback, accept the Fish Audio Drama 3 preview, support endpoint-resolved custom model aliases, prefer a newer installed Codex for ChatGPT discovery, and prioritize shared private vLLM requests. (#171852, #172339, #172449, #172445, #170473, #170009, #168228, #129434) Thanks @nv-kasikritc, @jacobtomlinson, @JFLeonM, @xyrolle, @obviyus, @m888m, and @joshavant.
- **Muse Code:** run Meta models through the Muse Code CLI agent runtime, sign in to Muse Code from Model Setup and Provider Access, and run consented turns under a conversation tool policy. (#170487, #171526, #171790, #172361) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Usage and accounts:** show active auth subscription blocks, show Ollama cloud balance in status usage, add a ClawRouter sidebar dashboard for subscription pool headroom, show local provider processing with estimated wait time, and show every matched session in a paged usage overview. (#133087, #167474, #169514, #170041, #170369, #169660) Thanks @Leon-SK668, @vincentkoc, and @usimic.
- **Model recovery:** use model fallbacks after context-overflow recovery, compact ChatGPT sign-in sessions server-side, end runs after confirmed final source replies, and support typed OpenAI Decisions API evaluations. (#170141, #168401, #170653, #166320) Thanks @amirarenco-create, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @sunlit-deng, @jjjhenriksen, and @Kimiyu-186.
- **Labs Advisor:** add an experimental Advisor that steers agents away from avoidable work. (#169564) Thanks @obviyus.
- **CLI progress:** show progress while tool input is generated. (#167789) Thanks @ZengWen-DT, @obviyus, and @umeranjum17.
- **Skills:** show a Learned notice row with one-press Undo, make background review channel notices opt-in, and save only repeatable procedures from background reviews. (#167996, #170025, #170277) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Clearer messages:** simplify wording across Settings, Gateway and security diagnostics, CLI and Doctor, agent and command execution, browser and approval help, provider, messaging, workspace, and memory plugins, and the macOS, iOS, Android, and Linux apps. (#168703, #168704, #168705, #168706, #168707, #168709, #168710, #168711, #168713, #168714, #168715, #168716) Thanks @RomneyDa, @synthalorian, and @obviyus.
- **Mobile and devices:** add Android system, photos, contacts, calendar, and motion capabilities, add an authenticated iOS background presence beacon, and support multiple Microsoft Teams bot accounts. (#29398, #73330, #112811) Thanks @obviyus and @jimmypuckett.
- **Worker placement:** require configured worker placement for sessions and allow keyless Gateway selection for worker-local inference. (#158903, #170132) Thanks @sallyom, @RomneyDa, and @obviyus.
- **Diagnostics:** export turn prompts and final answers on message and run spans, attribute GC metrics by kind and worker, measure allocated bytes per RPC and turn, attribute native CPU samples to JavaScript callers, capture main-thread stall stacks, and expose SQLite worker delay phases. (#156603, #171923, #172486, #171686, #170904, #169535, #170932, #171082, #171062) Thanks @ryan-dyer-sp, @vincentkoc, and @joshavant.
- **More:** expose wrapped browser observations to Code Mode, allow pausing automatic team-report collection, and add scoped startup migration backups. (#164833, #171840, #171764) Thanks @alkor2000, @potterdigital, and @vincentkoc.

### Fixes

- **Content boundaries:** keep internal runtime context, serialized tool-call XML, split tool-call markers, raw background command notices, runtime prompts, and legacy requester guidance out of replies and chat history, and stop models that print tool-call text from reporting false success. (#163471, #138204, #169172, #171898, #168236, #166080, #163521, #168943, #168928, #170799, #137273) Thanks @RomneyDa, @obviyus, @consoleaf, @JacquesLFR8, @ericcaiwx-star, @ruiling-smartbear, @JasonBuildAI, @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, @rogeriochaves, @llmsommelier, @alkor2000, @Oldrich333, and @LiuwqGit.
- **Reply text:** keep trailing reply text after quoted closing tags, suppress punctuated and truncated silent placeholders, prevent thinking-only utility replies, and keep Ollama reasoning out of replies for manually configured models. (#149775, #168571, #170190, #169920, #169851, #171573) Thanks @bodapatisaikrishna, @liwenjie200543, @maliv2, @jacobtomlinson, @boeingchoco, and @vincentkoc.
- **Security and authority:** stop setup diagnostics repairing state without approval, reject project cache symlinks, bind Discord and Slack channel tool policy to resolved channel IDs, resolve Matrix room policy by room ID, never treat Tlon group DM authors as the owner, enforce exclusive Matrix crypto store ownership, separate exec approval ownership from node policy, isolate managed local provider auth, and align pairing setup with administrator scope. (#171960, #172079, #171829, #171828, #171645, #165801, #160707, #148612, #158108, #170988, #160982) Thanks @vincentkoc, @yetval, @eleqtrizit, @joshavant, @beenhero, and @ysumatta.
- **Private data:** stop logging inbound message content and spoken text, wait for explicit actions before reading Chrome data on macOS, honor ordinary permissions for voice requests, reject unknown WhatsApp login actions, disable unresolved hook ingress without blocking the Gateway, and reject oversized workspace document saves. (#170815, #170999, #171177, #159697, #158719, #165019, #171938) Thanks @brokemac79, @Alix-007, @mcaxtr, and @eleqtrizit.
- **State ownership:** keep secret, catalog, config, agent, plugin, backup, device, Memory, Matrix, and Workboard writes with the running Gateway, protect provider and MCP credentials from concurrent CLI writes, keep channel setup credentials out of config, and refuse local Claws, migration, and proxy writes while a Gateway owns the state. (#168108, #168135, #169732, #168417, #168757, #168466, #168471, #168457, #168586, #168419, #168459) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Restart recovery:** resume interrupted replies, aborted main turns, and requester-settle work after Gateway restarts, keep streamed answers when a restart aborts the run, settle replaced subagents and permanently rejected restart events, and resume sessions whose aborted run finished before recovery. (#172234, #172412, #170697, #170858, #170699, #171158, #170513, #172322, #171717, #169489, #170384, #172356, #172023, #170781) Thanks @jeanmonet.
- **Interrupted and queued input:** keep interrupted turns when new messages arrive, continue interrupted requests when asked, preserve queued work and inbound messages when preparation is cancelled or fails, let sends right after Stop succeed, stop Stop errors when a turn completes, and keep stopped Codex conversations ready. (#170647, #168279, #171718, #172080, #172421, #170542, #171656, #168906, #170652) Thanks @bitfroest.
- **Reply delivery:** preserve streamed answers across tools and reasoning, completed replies after invalidated reads, pending reply custody, follow-up errors and attachments, and committed CLI replies, stop outbound recovery from replaying sent replies, and avoid duplicate deferred tool results and false failure warnings after retries. (#169020, #169987, #170937, #170916, #170757, #99600, #169537, #170675, #170925, #172458, #151921, #165291, #101024, #169503, #169843) Thanks @VACInc, @elikampf, @zhangguiping-xydt, @TUARAN, @obviyus, @kseczhouyb, @Kimiyu-186, @shakkernerd, @amittell, @SunnyShu0925, @tiffanychum, @TheAngryPit, @CassieMei, @joshavant, and @vincentkoc.
- **Chat history:** keep delivered slash commands and Discord, Slack, and Mattermost native commands in history, return one history entry per user turn, keep channel messages when preflight compaction fails, show fallback and recovery in history, and keep visible failures out of later model requests. (#169026, #169200, #169236, #169255, #169434, #160462, #169773, #171327, #169369) Thanks @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @masatohoshino, @jacobtomlinson, and @joshavant.
- **ACP and CLI replies:** keep complete ACP answers after tool commentary, stop bound and long ACP turns losing replies, keep ACP follow-ups after a stopped turn, preserve the first acpx conversation after restart, keep rejected Claude CLI drafts out of final replies, and credit WebChat internal-sink sends as the source reply. (#168201, #168989, #171447, #170880, #170883, #166368, #168764, #167736, #168345, #168247) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @potterdigital, @fanmeng-felix, @alkor2000, @obviyus, @jhgaylor, @ruel225, @Oliver4Spot, and @Oldrich333.
- **Subagents:** wake parents when registry writes overlap, keep completion retries and recovered final replies, return visible child results to yielded guests, stop large completion batches overflowing the requester, keep stopped yielded tasks from restarting, and count and show waiting subagents accurately. (#163195, #169015, #171929, #171657, #171796, #172068, #169453, #167672, #168186, #169984, #169848, #155019, #164175, #171021, #150209, #172286, #171580) Thanks @ruel225, @Yolo521-bot, @fuller-stack-dev, @shakkernerd, @freeqaz-openai, @xydigitLybnnnn, @obviyus, @Oldrich333, @linhongyu510, @jerryliang122, @etzelm, @johan-eilertsen, @chelsealong, and @residentb2b.
- **Background work:** deliver background results to WebChat-only sessions, warn about dead-lettered deliveries, honor subagent concurrency for dreaming, cancel native descendants on session stop, release worker capacity after forced cleanup, keep child task custody for browser follow-ups, and stop agent deletion hanging on embedded runs. (#158067, #169932, #170273, #169700, #168746, #172017, #172511, #168199, #167368, #170855) Thanks @vincentkoc, @huyengiang101086-spec, @Yolo521-bot, @aniruddhaadak80, @obviyus, @jalehman, and @VACInc.
- **Shared and guest sessions:** let guest children start after parents yield, expose session publication in default sandboxes, let guests choose managed project worktrees and saved project choices, keep guest commands working during checkpoints, let guest readers open attachments, select an available checkout for new project sessions, and make saved web fetch output readable in sandboxes. (#171668, #171803, #171811, #171842, #172114, #172137, #172195, #172202, #172542, #172499, #168085) Thanks @shakkernerd.
- **Public conversations:** show complete public conversations with shared images and stop public-session chat reloads bouncing after deployment. (#169644, #171244) Thanks @VACInc.
- **Telegram replies:** redeliver saved final text after ambiguous network failures, avoid duplicate history replies, keep messages queued after handler timeouts, keep follow-up text behind photo albums, keep final replies linked after progress cards, honor first reply mode for message tools, prevent dropped replies on IPv4-first hosts, and stop retrying archived root-DM commands. (#168738, #169019, #169202, #170690, #171127, #171123, #171564, #171810, #169663, #166869) Thanks @obviyus, @diregoblin, @ooiuuii, @SanderHelgesen, @Dat1GUI, @dankarization, @VACInc, and @vincentkoc.
- **Telegram content:** keep dice rolls, shared contacts, voice durations, group voice mentions, tap timestamps, bare URLs, captions, and progress notes intact, and show native portraits in Home. (#137112, #144602, #142552, #163746, #170210, #171216, #171180, #171877, #171178, #168723, #168225, #168281, #168464, #170677, #171417, #166248) Thanks @adeepn, @obviyus, @JamesY023, @szafranski, @jewseppi, @maliv2, @zori7, @Irish-Joseph, @SanderHelgesen, @ruel225, @boeingchoco, and @vincentkoc.
- **Microsoft Teams:** paginate channel thread replies, include users in reactions, fix reactions on thread replies, keep DM progress rows separate, receive pasted DM images, and show fetched text in reads and searches. (#120824, #151128, #166582, #157704, #170437, #171153) Thanks @Linux2010, @obviyus, @qingminglong, @Leon-SK668, @ericcurtin, @yetval, @rdbartram, @RomneyDa, @EbulenConsult, and @ly85206559.
- **Discord, Slack, and Mattermost:** retry Discord edits, deletes, and pins after a lost response, keep consults and pending replies across voice changes, honor Slack silence for implicit thread follow-ups, render Slack control-sigil links and progress mentions safely, show Slack pinned messages, and render Mattermost agent buttons. (#169806, #171029, #172380, #164877, #168438, #169760, #171042, #168368) Thanks @ericcurtin, @obviyus, @ericcaiwx-star, @brainmonger, @shannon0430, @KhanCold, @yetval, @Takhoffman, @ooiuuii, @hannnnn-l, and @vincentkoc.
- **Other channels:** fix Feishu forwarded-message attribution, CardKit streaming fallback, monitor registration, and nested code fences; render Google Chat Markdown and deliver after truncated 404s; report LINE partial delivery; ignore IRC CTCP queries and report reconnecting accounts; fix Tlon reconnects, CRLF events, and nested code; stop Zalo polls; isolate Synology Chat accounts; and contain Matrix sync outages and stale room sends. (#150214, #152086, #169226, #171222, #141752, #168107, #100996, #168113, #171053, #169267, #170125, #171584, #169270, #144991, #62779, #163012) Thanks @chelsealong, @obviyus, @peach980, @kqtxmaster-boop, @Simon2256928, @ruel225, @junniar, @rudycelekli, @ericcaiwx-star, @pbreault, @ly85206559, @masatohoshino, @yetval, @ooiuuii, @zhangguiping-xydt, @Abhishek-B-R, @gumadeiras, @janstenpickle, and @vincentkoc.
- **Channel runtime:** keep hot restart working with disabled account credentials, report ingress claim refresh failures, keep progress titles within their line budget, keep ClickClack omissions on retries, stop thread replies misreading the current message, and fix WhatsApp audio actions. (#171734, #171365, #168312, #169509, #169817, #170889, #170500) Thanks @davidcittadini, @ynaamane, @obviyus, @Yolo521-bot, @yousan, and @SunnyShu0925.
- **X and A2A:** preserve X reply guidance and recover allowed mentions after authorization changes, recover mention profiles and background refresh, and stop A2A retried messages, task references, push errors, and queued host notices from stranding tasks or looping replies. (#169747, #171384, #170507, #170896, #167594, #167596, #170469, #172064) Thanks @obviyus, @clawSean, @rh7, and @Oldrich333.
- **Talk and speech:** keep macOS Talk replies from slow runs, fix iOS realtime Talk crashes and speaker output, preserve Anthropic Talk consult updates and custom Azure speech endpoints, honor configured speech in Control UI, keep speech-only and delayed speech replies, keep browser Gemini Live turns in history, and stop push-to-talk capture when the hold ends. (#164485, #168416, #171267, #151253, #170343, #170357, #171090, #171506, #143064, #137329, #171377, #167066, #170386, #166211) Thanks @PollyBot13, @rsaeks, @masatohoshino, @Takhoffman, @LiuwqGit, @marleyman5000-boop, @Leon-SK668, @obviyus, @mcfex, @mike-nott, @ericcurtin, @Twilight-Networks, @vincentkoc, @wangyan2026, @eiriktorheim, @jonathanlindsay, @hugenshen, @cursoragent, and @VACInc.
- **Media and attachments:** pass Whisper language hints, keep Windows-1252 accents, stop silent audio counting as a failure, avoid false busy-chat delivery warnings, stage WebChat images for file tools, let sandboxed agents reuse generated media, restore SSH sandbox reply attachments, and keep attachments through uncertain admission and steering. (#166581, #168946, #168862, #169273, #171233, #171415) Thanks @valkyriweb, @xydigitLybnnnn, @goslingmanagment, @waynegault, @alexph-dev, @Captain69G, @zhangguiping-xydt, @obviyus, @vincentkoc, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
- **Clock changes:** keep Codex, Gateway dispatch, MCP loopback, SSH worker retry, cron repair, Comfy, Crabbox, and remote restart deadlines on the monotonic clock so wall-clock changes do not cut them short or stall them. (#155801, #168144, #168298, #168731, #168736, #168771, #170495, #171094, #172256, #171097, #162779, #169908, #168087) Thanks @SunnyShu0925, @obviyus, and @altaywtf.
- **Streaming performance:** keep the Gateway responsive during reply-tagged streams and stop long streamed runs and citation replies rescanning earlier text on every delta. (#166782, #171361, #172470) Thanks @boeingchoco, @obviyus, and @JasonBuildAI.
- **Session and database performance:** keep cold session and memory SQL off the Gateway main thread, move transcript bookkeeping and target lookups into workers, reuse committed facts and admission snapshots across turns, retire idle transcript workers, and avoid repeated schema checks after clean shutdowns. (#169164, #169553, #169757, #169960, #167739, #168647, #169649, #171038, #171155, #171354, #170017, #171883, #169052, #171322, #168975, #169110, #172372) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen, @obviyus, @Kimiyu-186, @VACInc, and @joshavant.
- **Startup and idle performance:** listen before session projection, overlap startup preparations, admit agents before transcript repair, avoid database polling and maintenance wakeups in idle Gateways, park idle timers, and move fleet skill discovery and update schema publication off the main thread. (#170151, #169328, #170849, #169871, #170531, #171318, #170755, #170933, #171179, #169138, #170401, #171006, #171028, #171685, #170341) Thanks @synthalorian, @obviyus, and @vincentkoc.
- **Turn and prompt performance:** stabilize prompt prefixes across images, retries, tools, and runs, reuse tool descriptors and dynamic schemas between turns, initialize session tools once, and remove redundant streaming awaits. (#169091, #169237, #170050, #170282, #170516, #170610, #170673, #171924, #171874, #168848, #171696, #170185, #170262, #171574) Thanks @joshavant.
- **Control UI performance:** reduce cold-load chat rendering, sidebar churn, layout, and style recalculation on reloads, shrink session list payloads, load filtered sidebar rows first, and avoid reconnecting on delayed heartbeats. (#169707, #169680, #169288, #170629, #170648, #170637, #170082, #169062, #171671, #171253, #170047, #170024, #171534, #171610) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Worktree performance:** start first replies while checkouts finish, reuse templates and prepared bases, avoid eager partial-clone blobs, and bound repository housekeeping. (#169136, #169239, #169359, #169590, #168682, #171680, #169070, #171841, #171978)

releases.body:
## 2026.10.4

### Highlights

- The Gateway keeps running after the computer sleeps or the system clock jumps, instead of restarting itself because its ownership heartbeat looked stale. (#170790) Thanks @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway shutdown and restart no longer hang on a stalled transcript worker or in-flight session lifecycle events. (#170493, #170555) Thanks @Oldrich333.
- Tlon group DMs no longer treat other participants as the owner, closing an owner-impersonation path. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Headless browser pages keep responding to clicks while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.
- Manual `/compact` settles the active run before compacting instead of aborting it and dropping the pending request. (#166163) Thanks @holny and @alexph-dev.

### Changes

- Stability patch for 2026.10.3 with no new features or configuration changes. Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- Gateway: stays responsive during long reply-tagged streams, and long replies that quote tool-call XML no longer re-parse Markdown on every token. (#166782, #171573) Thanks @boeingchoco.
- Gateway: blocked durable context-engine turns are logged once instead of on every run. (#167595) Thanks @jalehman.
- Control UI: delayed application heartbeats no longer force a reconnect. (#171253)
- Gateway: recover state ownership after sleep and wall-clock changes, and allow `openclaw gateway restart` from verified external macOS terminals. (#170790, #170354) Thanks @AnvinaLI, @sgh6688, @waynegault, and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway: bound transcript-worker shutdown waits and wait for session lifecycle publication during shutdown. (#170493, #170555) Thanks @Oldrich333.
- Gateway: start enabled standalone plugin files with the Gateway, and keep worker heap limits enforced when the managed service sets a process-wide heap flag. (#171330, #166581) Thanks @holgergruenhagen, @valkyriweb, @xydigitLybnnnn, @goslingmanagment, @waynegault, and @obviyus.
- Agents: launched plugin turns no longer fail with writer-claim errors, and Claude CLI sessions no longer fork history across message routes. (#170077, #167241) Thanks @cmatrx0.
- Agents: manual compaction settles the active run instead of aborting it. (#166163) Thanks @holny and @alexph-dev.
- OpenAI: tool turns for reasoning models on api.openai.com Completions routes no longer fail with a 400. (#166182) Thanks @obviyus and @AsTutoAI.
- Updates: agent databases are no longer flagged as changed during snapshot capture, the success summary stops repeating settled plugin data/settings upgrades as pending, and metadata inventory keeps running under progress-output backpressure. (#170351, #170413, #168493) Thanks @DonnieFi, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
- Updates: slow host admission no longer holds the database writer and disrupts Gateway work, progress keeps reporting through temporary Doctor maintenance, snapshot failures get an accurate headline and recovery advice, and Linux updates can clean up abandoned runtime directories under protected systemd user managers. (#171493, #171454, #171457, #171488, #170783, #166335) Thanks @RomneyDa, @DonnieFi, and @vincentkoc.
- Updates: candidate validation no longer amplifies private SQLite snapshots on live installs, older drivers stop reading candidate-migrated state and stale restart verdicts clear, and optional cron inspection or snapshot cleanup failures no longer stall updates. (#167451, #170130, #170754) Thanks @angeliti999 and @RomneyDa.
- Updates: `openclaw update repair` turns no longer time out before running tools on slower hosts; nested authority checks reuse the current state snapshot instead of copying the database again. (#166847)
- Doctor: updates no longer refuse unreferenced retired OAuth sidecars, and offline state repair works for app-owned Gateways. (#165420, #170768) Thanks @obviyus and @RomneyDa.
- Tailscale: an interrupted start stops its serve process, local access stays available when the tailnet denies Serve, and Doctor checks configured Tailscale startup prerequisites. (#167514, #171509, #166947) Thanks @pandysp and @RomneyDa.
- macOS: app recovery keeps compatible newer Gateways instead of downgrading them, and repair accepts a verified LaunchAgent bootstrap that is already in progress. (#170766, #170740) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Sessions: equivalent POSIX path aliases such as `/tmp` and `/private/tmp` no longer restart channels. (#166462) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star.
- MCP: OAuth login completes when the authorization server registers loopback redirect URIs without a port. (#170876) Thanks @9fw2pq8sgb-art.
- Browser: headless pages accept clicks while a site waits for a passkey. (#170857) Thanks @trukhinyuri.
- Control UI: updated chats recover through the serving document. (#168941)
- Tlon: never treat group DM authors as the owner. (#165801) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Telegram: polling workers resolve in both source and package builds. (#154286) Thanks @xydt-juyaohui and @markfietje.
- Discord: agent consults keep working after voice changes. (#171029) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star and @brainmonger.
- Feishu: config hot-reload no longer orphans conversation bindings. (#169226) Thanks @ruel225, @junniar, and @obviyus.
- IRC: long non-ASCII replies are no longer lost when the server relays them. (#159730) Thanks @rodricksz4h5.
- Release: plugin npm publish tolerates repeated artifact pagination entries, Linux builds trigger after automatic requests with hosted-runner credentials, and ratchet checks read large Git baselines. (#171044, #167087, #167237, #164743) Thanks @RomneyDa and @shakkernerd.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.3..d58dd3ceef67f10eab31d93387d2c90866b3ec93 history: 61 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 61 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

## 2026.10.10-beta.2

### Highlights

### Changes

### Fixes

- Workspace safety: reject a multi-file `apply_patch` before changing files when a later update target is missing or its context does not match, preserving the original workspace for the next attempt. Commit-time I/O failures can still leave partial effects. (#160409; related #117742 and #127496) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, and @yetval.
- Tool policy: run plugin `before_tool_call` hooks in standalone `openclaw agent exec` sessions so plugin tool guards take effect. (#159333; fixes #158824) Thanks @joseairosa and @obviyus.
- Buzz: reconnect when a relay closes during NIP-42 authentication without terminating the Gateway or interrupting other channels and sessions. (#170591; fixes #147269) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @jarvis-modern-mail, and @RomneyDa.
- macOS downloads: save dashboard and conversation attachments through the native Save dialog while keeping the current page open. (#173654) Thanks @Patrick-Erichsen.
- OpenRouter onboarding: accept valid API keys with the default `openrouter/auto` model instead of rejecting setup with a route mismatch. (#173292; related #162798) Thanks @chandraveshchaudhari and @obviyus.
- macOS setup: let fresh native profiles start the Gateway and complete automatic setup, including when supervised startup needs a retry. (#173246)
- Gateway startup: follow a replacement model-runtime refresh instead of exiting when initial preparation is superseded. (#173366; related #173357) Thanks @Jackten and @RomneyDa.
- Gateway logging: keep serving and shut down normally when a deleted temporary-directory backing path makes daily log rollover fail. (#160433; fixes #130807) Thanks @masatohoshino, @obviyus, @WadeOwenWatts, and @Patrick-Erichsen.
- Gateway stability: stop session diff capture from opening live SQLite and hard-linked files, preventing SIGBUS crash loops when the shared-memory file is truncated. (#174017)
- Native app updates: let Doctor finish agent database upgrades on native-first profiles instead of reporting success while the Gateway refuses to start on an older schema. (#174297)
- Cron: plan history maintenance from run identities and load full payloads only for rows it updates, so large cron histories no longer exhaust the SQLite worker's memory and take channels down. (#174530; fixes #174078) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, and @asikorskiy.
- Windows Claude CLI: stop every turn with a stored Anthropic credential from stalling until the no-output watchdog when Claude Code never reads the credential pipe. (#174571; fixes #174204) Thanks @RomneyDa and @scalesmart.
- Plugins: restore the SDK facade exports that published external plugins still import, so those plugins load again. (#173777; fixes #173386) Thanks @RomneyDa and @FtlC-ian.
- Chat tools: keep the chat usable after removing a tool server that failed to start, cleaning up its failed startup before reporting the launch error. (#171397) Thanks @joelagnel.
- Updates: bound the post-activation Doctor step by the update's allowance instead of waiting indefinitely with the Gateway down. (#173862)
- Updates: keep Gateway-managed source updates from failing with missing backup modules after the runtime is replaced. (#173587) Thanks @vishnusenthil-16.
- Updates: make `openclaw update --no-restart` honest for npm, pnpm, and bun installs, which restart themselves after the package is replaced, record the update as successful, and keep a still-serving older build unverified. (#173409, #174649; fixes #171311) Thanks @RomneyDa and @mwbroxson.

- Nodes: synchronous node exec output is no longer repeated as a separate `Exec finished` wake after the waiting caller already received it. (#164511) Thanks @holgergruenhagen and @obviyus.

- Control UI: offer desktop setup instead of Retry when Host Desktop is off, model pickers refresh when the catalog changes mid-read, and locale refresh works again after adding a source-only locale. (#177888, #174812, #172689; related #174368) Thanks @etzelm, @RomneyDa, and @hannesrudolph.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.6

### Highlights

- **Patched Node runtime required:** OpenClaw now requires Node 24.22.1+ on the 24 line or 26.12.1+ on the 26 line, which reject TLS chains signed with the compromised certificate keys addressed in the October 2026 Node.js security releases. Docker images ship Node 24.22.1, installers select the patched runtimes, and `openclaw update` refuses with recovery guidance before installing on an older Node instead of breaking the running install. Source builds now pin pnpm 12.15.0. (#179992) Thanks @joshavant.
- **Safer updates and recovery:** package swaps now refuse unsafe service states, Windows and macOS package-manager updates recover from platform-specific failures, and frozen Gateway startup owners can be retired cleanly. (#171101, #170940, #171936, #171678) Thanks @RomneyDa, @homeworld520, @Yolo521-bot, @stop-time, @AntaresGG, and @TommyLei666.
- **Data-preserving migrations and backups:** Doctor and migration paths now refuse malformed or lossy workspace imports, preserve malformed Notes bytes, reject unsafe non-UTF-8 wiki rewrites, keep deeply nested SQLite backups, and retain staging evidence when restore inspection fails. (#172293, #172953, #172742, #174573, #168583, #170867, #172028) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, @Leon-SK668, @ericcurtin, @Yolo521-bot, @obviyus, and @altaywtf.
- **Reliable delivery across restarts:** queued turns, watched child results, dead-lettered deliveries, and streamed replies now survive recovery without disappearing, duplicating, or producing false missing-answer notices. (#170384, #169489, #169932, #173798) Thanks @RomneyDa, @huyengiang101086-spec, and @Yolo521-bot.
- **Provider and model resilience:** GPT-5.6 tool turns, OpenRouter DeepSeek tool calls, LM Studio overflow recovery, parallel OpenAI reasoning settings, and model retry/fallback budgets now behave consistently. (#176709, #175058, #169189, #169322, #164808) Thanks @RomneyDa, @Linux2010, @ZhimingQ, @xpeng5278-web, and @anyech.
- **Windows and mobile stability:** fresh Windows state stores, Proxy-backed environments, and stored Anthropic credentials no longer block startup, while iOS Talk and chat connectivity recover from first-reply and timeout failures. (#176174, #176194, #174571, #168416, #169912) Thanks @RomneyDa, @tjarrau-dev, @skyzhao1223, @easyteacher, @scalesmart, @masatohoshino, @Takhoffman, and @Solvely-Colin.
- **Agent and tool-call recovery:** unfinished tools now time out visibly, context overflow compacts after steered tool results, malformed calls continue after earlier refusals, large patch hunks avoid argument-limit crashes, and stopped yielded tasks stay stopped. (#172983, #172019, #170615, #174477, #169453) Thanks @RomneyDa, @budzation, @mirasrael, @r3n3x, @freeqaz-openai, and @obviyus.
- **Channel delivery correctness:** WhatsApp retries and stickers, Telegram albums and dual-stack replies, Slack relay recovery, and Discord voice-call replies no longer lose or duplicate messages. (#142434, #164210, #163926, #171564, #173407, #172380) Thanks @ashawwal, @RomneyDa, @andrewwbuilds, @abacha, @Dat1GUI, @brainmonger, @obviyus, and @vincentkoc.
- **Worker and worktree recovery:** hosts reclaim worker capacity after reboot, partial-clone worktrees repair missing objects, and child-result and exec-wake evidence survives Gateway restarts. (#168863, #168864, #169489, #169645) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- This patch release contains focused reliability fixes only; it does not introduce new user-facing features.

### Fixes

- **State and system-agent recovery:** restore access to agents held by affected upgrades, recover held system-agent databases after schema changes, and preserve live configuration when forensic snapshots fail. (#175007, #176783, #171217) Thanks @RomneyDa, @PennyVibe, and @Yolo521-bot.
- **Windows state and updates:** canonicalize schema ownership across path aliases, serialize Proxy-backed environments before inspection IPC, hide SQLite helper windows during update work, and recognize native Scheduled Task permission failures in every locale. (#176174, #176194, #174969, #178624) Thanks @RomneyDa, @tjarrau-dev, @skyzhao1223, @easyteacher, and @throwingbones.
- **macOS companion execution:** honor long command and approval deadlines across the companion socket, classify late or lost replies without replaying submitted commands, and preserve native permission details. (#172117) Thanks @holgergruenhagen, @RomneyDa, @ylcn91, and @Colton-Harris.
- **Doctor and managed plugins:** repair empty retired-plugin metadata, clear resolved migration warnings, and converge app-managed plugins onto the installed core version. (#173851, #177096, #174257) Thanks @RomneyDa, @fengfan201314-eng, @ScientificProgrammer, @yinx65588-boop, @jj5638521, and @kazuyuki-eguchi.
- **Update diagnostics:** preserve FRV blockers, explain package-journal identity and runtime-retention failures, and avoid cleanup stalls on shared recovery manifests. (#171186, #170385, #169280, #174249) Thanks @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @astapenkoav, @council10-kera, and @shoaibulhaque.
- **SQLite correctness:** preserve transaction outcomes when warning handlers throw, settle peer closes after shared-worker refusal, and prevent retired cache generations from taking worker ownership. (#157151, #173813, #172798) Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
- **Reply recovery:** preserve side-question and immediate fallback ordering, avoid repeated or missing answers after streamed delivery, and keep stopped yielded tasks from restarting. (#174869, #169305, #173798, #169453) Thanks @RomneyDa and @freeqaz-openai.
- **Codex and native sessions:** release stalled startup waits and completed subagents after cancellation or cleanup failures, preserve conversations across runtime restarts, keep workspace bindings across reply resets, and settle recovered child binding writes before session readiness. (#168347, #173547, #166368, #160549, #177564) Thanks @RomneyDa, @Kimiyu-186, @alkor2000, @jhgaylor, @vincentkoc, @jjjhenriksen, and @obviyus.
- **Gateway lifecycle:** retain restart custody, avoid stop-time lease deadlocks, recover worker capacity after reboot, and preserve suppressed-channel configuration across reloads. (#172852, #171308, #168863) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **CLI and process diagnostics:** preserve JSON output on Gateway command exits, report resource-disposal and PTY EOF failures, and surface failed diagnostic writes without crashing. (#176795, #173566, #176362, #174622) Thanks @vincentkoc and @RomneyDa.
- **Scheduled follow-ups:** same-conversation follow-ups scheduled from an authorized operator turn keep that operator's current authority when they run, and one-shot continuations can call `next_check` to check back later. (#176422)
- **Media and TTS:** time out slow hosted speech synthesis and report playback cache, probe, and quota failures rather than silently dropping cleanup errors. (#175614, #175634, #174668) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.5..bba7238a1be3a0d4e92c371988f94e81011a06b2 history: 293 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 293 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

releases.body:
## 2026.10.7

### Highlights

- **Replay-safe session recovery:** interrupted sessions now retain recovery provenance and unfinished tool outcomes, stopped conversations retire terminal recovery residue before accepting the next message, rejected Claude CLI drafts stay out of final replies, large child-completion batches stay within requester context, and Codex previews no longer block replies after a context refresh. (#153728, #168764, #172068, #177716, #176682, #176783, #176675, #159715, #181801) Thanks @zhangguiping-xydt, @ruel225, @Oliver4Spot, @jjjhenriksen, @enki, @PennyVibe, @mbelinky, @RomneyDa, and @krjcolby-svg.
- **Safer update activation and recovery:** verified activations remain successful through later maintenance or ledger errors, interrupted package updates resume safely, post-activation Doctor waits are bounded, stale receipts cannot veto a valid repair, and Windows deep or 8.3 state paths no longer abort onboarding or migration. (#181166, #181307, #173862, #167459, #172768, #172769, #181389) Thanks @najef1979-code, @agroman1993, @shanselman, @RomneyDa, @dor-sr, @wangmiao0668000666, and @brucemccurdy.
- **Database and worker continuity:** maintenance refusals preserve peer readers and borrowers, incompatible retained agent databases stay isolated, empty transcript deletions skip unnecessary archive materialization, Bun admission deadlines remain thread-local, and worker shutdown completes after inventory retirement. (#175987, #179320, #170122, #171372, #172756, #168862) Thanks @LifeViwer, @Captain69G, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @dor-sr, @wangmiao0668000666, and @brucemccurdy.
- **Backup and state durability:** snapshots retain supported legacy exec-approval policies, interrupted R2 verification and restores resume safely, config observation keeps the last-known-good snapshot during truncated writes, failed multi-file patches preserve earlier files, and Memory Wiki re-imports preserve human-authored notes. (#164297, #171292, #152565, #160409, #175707) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @davidcittadini, @LiuwqGit, @yetval, @masatohoshino, @YangManBOBO, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @dor-sr, @cristianoc, and @brucemccurdy.
- **Operator control continuity:** native computer control recovers after session expiry, late-attached GitHub operators can publish PRs, synchronous node output is not duplicated as a completion wake, cron announcements preserve CLI chats, and history maintenance reads identities before payloads. (#169385, #169400, #164511, #176218, #174530) Thanks @stackingrockss, @Gigaxel, @holgergruenhagen, @eliavb43, @wangmiao0668000666, @asikorskiy, and @RomneyDa.
- **Provider and plugin continuity:** model refresh, configured-account readiness, GPT-5.6 tool turns, OpenRouter onboarding, incremental plugin loading, and faster external TypeScript plugin startup retain current state instead of rejecting valid setup or discarding providers. (#176709, #178522, #173366, #173292, #162226, #161267, #168391) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @eduardonunesfreire-rgb, @chandraveshchaudhari, @netcrazed, @obviyus, @jakeaadams, and @RomneyDa.
- **Managed integration reliability:** saved Linux Gateway dashboards preserve pairing across restarts, slow macOS Talk runs retain their replies, app upgrades converge official plugins, Copilot setup verifies SDK-backed agents correctly, Claude CLI cache prefixes stay stable after child completion and retain context when caller-only tools appear or disappear, and passkey prompts no longer block headless browser clicks. (#158908, #164485, #174257, #163578, #172026, #178955, #170857) Thanks @dor-sr, @PollyBot13, @kazuyuki-eguchi, @lifuyue, @Marvinthebored, @VACInc, @trukhinyuri, @Peetiegonzalez, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @wangmiao0668000666, @brucemccurdy, and @rsaeks.
- **Cross-platform app-managed upgrades:** native state repair, recovery snapshots, Gateway runtime admission, and post-upgrade service recovery now converge without losing agent access across macOS and Windows. (#171508, #174297, #175007, #176174, #178155, #178779, #180010, #180576, #180769) Thanks @tjarrau-dev, @DonnieFi, @jayzhou2309, @lostsock1, @sglion777, @Almost-Certified-ops, @billpang1-sketch, and @RomneyDa.

### Changes

- **Google models:** add Gemini 4 Argon support. (#171852) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- **Update guidance:** avoid irrelevant database-repair advice when a package manager is missing, and remove superseded warnings after a successful update. (#173293, #173395) Thanks @DonnieFi, @RomneyDa, @wangmiao0668000666, @sunlit-deng, and @bhedanikhilkumar-code.
- **macOS onboarding:** allow fresh profiles to start the Gateway and complete automatic setup. (#173246) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Gateway logging:** prevent a deleted or stale temporary log directory from wedging the Gateway at full CPU during date rollover. (#160433) Fixes #130807 Thanks @masatohoshino, @WadeOwenWatts, and @RomneyDa.
