releases.name: v0.51.0
releases.body:
# v0.51.0 — Ouroboros is Loop Engineering

> Prompt engineering asks *"what do I say to the model?"*
> Context engineering asks *"what does the model see?"*
> **Loop engineering asks: "what structure guarantees the loop converges to *done* — and can't be gamed along the way?"**
>
> This release is the answer taking its final shape. The loop now hides its own
> answer key, verifies against declared contracts instead of claims, feeds
> execution traces back as hints, and repairs itself when it stalls — on any
> runtime kernel you drop underneath it.

## Why "Loop Engineering" is now complete

A loop is engineered — not just *run* — when four properties hold at once:

1. **The worker cannot see the grader's answer key.** With the new
   hidden-checklist convergence loop (#1916), acceptance-criteria details are
   unconditionally withheld from the executing agent. The agent works toward the
   goal; the evaluator judges against the full checklist. Teaching-to-the-test is
   structurally impossible, not just discouraged.
2. **Success is a contract, not a claim.** Since v0.50.0, an acceptance
   criterion declares in machine-checkable terms what counts as done
   (`verify_command` / `expected_artifacts` / `output_assertion`), and the
   executor, evaluator, and verify gate all judge against that declaration —
   grounded in what actually executed. This release keeps tightening it:
   match-anything regexes are refused as verification evidence (#1837), unreadable
   extractions are no longer remembered as answers (#1915), and verified evidence
   survives across lifecycle steps (#1913).
3. **Failure feeds back as structure, not vibes.** When an evaluation falls
   short, trace-grounded hints — what the run actually did versus what the hidden
   checklist wanted — flow into the next generation. `run → evaluate → evolve` is
   now a single chain, and as of this release `ooo auto` rides that same chain
   instead of its own hardcoded detour.
4. **The loop survives its own environment.** Generation ownership is a durable
   lease (#1891), signals reach detached evolve runs (#1921), transient provider
   deaths are retried instead of terminal, and concurrency adapts to live provider
   feedback (#1851). Zero-time job snapshots hold under load (#1936); checkpoints
   are integrity-validated on save (#1896).

Every piece above is deterministic machinery — schema, gate, lease, chain — not a
prompt asking the model to behave. That is the discipline we mean by **loop
engineering**, and with this release the core structure is complete.

## The lineage — March to August 2026

Ouroboros didn't arrive here in one step. Each era solved the failure mode the
previous one exposed:

| Era | Releases | What the loop learned |
|---|---|---|
| **The parts exist** | v0.26 (late Mar) | Socratic interview redesign, first reward-hacking detection in evaluation, runtime-agnostic execution (Codex joins Claude). The stages work — but run separately, and evaluation still trusts prose. |
| **The loop opens outward** | v0.27–v0.29 (Apr) | MCP Bridge brings external tools into seeds; OpenCode and Hermes join as runtimes; capability-aware orchestration (`SandboxClass`) teaches the engine what tools *mean* before scheduling them. |
| **The loop becomes observable** | v0.30–v0.32 (Apr–May) | `ooo resume`, in-run lateral recovery, control directives; then the Agent OS kernel: every LLM and tool call journaled, and `spawn / pause / resume / cancel / replay` as a real process lifecycle. You can't engineer what you can't see. |
| **The loop closes** | v0.33–v0.37 (May) | `ooo auto` is born — a bounded supervisor that drives Interview → Seed → Execute → Evaluate on its own, with usage-limit pause & replay, provenance-tagged state, DomainProfiles, and automatic RUN→RALPH chaining. |
| **The loop learns to verify and recover** | v0.38–v0.39 (May) | The orchestrator stack: typed evidence schemas, an external verifier loop, a failure taxonomy with recovery policies, adaptive routing. Plus a high-severity `.env` trust-boundary RCE fix — the loop's own front door gets locked. |
| **Goal in, product out** | v0.40–v0.41 (late May–Jun) | `ooo auto` crosses the line from demo to machine that finishes work — then hardens both ends: an advisory panel interrogates the goal at the input, a typed, audited verdict guards the output. |
| **Any kernel underneath** | v0.42–v0.44 (Jun–Jul) | GJC joins eight runtime kernels; the reasoning-effort dial makes cost a per-stage decision; ourocode runs Claude with no SDK; the plugin path goes to production. |
| **Contracts, not claims** | v0.50 (Jul) | The Verifiable Loop: acceptance criteria become machine-checkable contracts, and executor, evaluator, and verify gate all judge against what actually executed. |
| **Loop Engineering** | **v0.51 (Aug)** | The answer key goes hidden, the feedback becomes trace-grounded, `auto` joins the unified chain, and the loop self-repairs under real-world failure. The structure is complete. |

## What's new in v0.51.0

### Features

- **Hidden-checklist convergence loop** (#1916) — the headline. Acceptance-criteria
  details are unconditionally hidden from the executing agent (no configuration to
  turn it off), evaluation shortfalls come back as trace-grounded hints, and
  `run → evaluate → evolve` runs as one chain.
- **Adaptive concurrency from provider feedback** (#1851) — the orchestrator
  widens and narrows parallelism based on live provider signals instead of a
  static cap.
- **Multi-run live kanban picker** (#1904) — the web dashboard now handles
  multiple concurrent runs with a live picker.
- **Native `ooo update` self-update command** (#1859) — upgrade the CLI and
  plugin in one step, from the CLI itself.
- **Bash artifact provenance** (#1931) — artifacts claimed as evidence are bound
  to the accepted commands that produced them.
- **Disposable artifact lifecycle** (#1855) — scratch artifacts are tracked and
  cleaned up instead of accumulating.

### Reliability & correctness

- Signals now reach detached evolve runs (#1921); generation ownership is a
  durable lease instead of an in-memory flag (#1891).
- Seed handoff survives an accepted-receipt failure (#1940); convergence
  composition ownership is preserved (#1932); zero-time job snapshots hold under
  load (#1936).
- Verification hardening: match-anything regexes refused as evidence (#1837),
  unreadable extractions not remembered as answers (#1915), verified evidence
  preserved across lifecycle steps (#1913), interview JSON parsing routed through
  the hardened extractor (#1876).
- Runtime truthfulness: probe failures distinguished from executable drift
  (#1945), degraded ourocode turns no longer reported as clean (#1895), empty
  OpenCode error frames stay terminal (#1893), Codex setup made truthful with
  nested LLM children isolated (#1920), Windows Codex setup writes atomically
  (#1910).
- Persistence: EventStore's SQLite-only contract made explicit (#1897),
  checkpoint state snapshotted and integrity-validated on save (#1896), persisted
  Linux owner identity stabilized (#1924).
- Packaging & CLI: Claude CLI and SDK packaging profiles split (#1928), saved
  `logging.level` actually applied (#1956), ambiguity score from `ouroboros init`
  persisted (#1903), Claude reserved command names avoided (#1919), test
  isolation no longer leaks proxy/token vars into `os.environ` (#1858).

### Docs & maintenance

- zh-CN and Korean quick-start brought to parity with English (#1949); superseded
  planning snapshots archived (#1950); shipped session-signal modes clarified
  (#1925); PyPI project metadata filled in (#1952).

---

## What's Changed

### Security
- **Breaking:** MCP network transports (`sse`, `streamable-http`) now refuse to bind beyond loopback without an auth token and explicit `--allow-remote` (#2019). releases.name: v0.51.6
releases.body:
## v0.51.6

Four tracks moved in this release. One opens a market, one was carried almost entirely by people outside the core, one gave the team back its afternoons, and one continued the long work of making the loop stop overstating what it finished.

---

## Track 1 — DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`): the door to a market we could not previously enter

There is a version of this project's history in which Ouroboros only ever spoke one vendor's language. It would have been easier, and it would have quietly decided on the user's behalf which models were allowed to think.

`dsh` — alias `deepseek_harness` — is now a first-class completion backend (#2143). It drives [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)'s automation ACP server for the entire in-process completion path: **interview, seed, QA, evaluate**. Everything the Socratic loop needs to converge a specification can run on DeepSeek.

This is a go-to-market change, not only an integration. A developer working where DeepSeek is the practical default — where Anthropic and OpenAI endpoints are not a realistic dependency — can now run the full specification-first loop end to end on infrastructure they already have, and pay for it in a currency they already use. Specification-first development should not require a particular passport.

What landed:

- **`DshAcpClient`** subclasses the existing ourocode ACP client through three narrow launch seams. dsh speaks the same ACP wire Ouroboros already implements, so this reuses proven machinery instead of growing a second protocol stack — the ourocode suite passes byte-identically.
- dsh's `session/new` indexes `params.mcpServers.length` unconditionally and rejects a non-empty list, so the client always sends `mcpServers: []`. Documented, not papered over.
- **`DshLLMAdapter`** reports an honest `dsh-composition` sentinel rather than fabricating a model id in audit metadata. The ACP wire carries no model parameter — dsh's Cordis composition file owns provider and model selection — and an audit trail that invents a value it cannot observe is worse than one that admits the gap.
- **Security.** `OUROBOROS_DSH_CLI_PATH` and `OUROBOROS_DSH_CONFIG_PATH` both join the untrusted `.env` denylist. The config path selects which Cordis composition a spawned Node process loads, and composition rows execute arbitrary plugin code — so it gets the treatment an executable path gets, not the lesser treatment a "config file" would normally receive.
- **Verified against the real binary.** A from-source build of deepseek-harness completed spawn → `initialize` → `session/new` → `session/prompt` dispatch into dsh's LLM layer, failing only at the expected terminal point: no API key on the verification machine. Everything short of the paid model call is proven, and we are stating that limit plainly rather than rounding it up.
- The full adoption analysis — what dsh has, what is worth borrowing, how to collaborate upstream — is in `docs/research/deepseek-harness-adoption.md`.

---

## Track 2 — Contributors

Six people outside the release author shipped into this version, and between them they closed most of the gap between "Ouroboros is installed" and "Ouroboros is actually going to work on your machine."

**[@tmdgusya](https://github.com/tmdgusya) — zcode model-config readiness (#2147, closes #2148).** `setup` and `status health` used to report every check green on a machine where the first workflow step would then fail mid-execution, because the ZCode CLI resolves its model from a config file the desktop app never writes. The new probe mirrors the CLI's own acceptance rules and names the exact gap — including the case where an object-form `model.main` is silently dropped by the CLI's parser, which is how an apparently complete config keeps failing.

**[@lee3Q](https://github.com/lee3Q) — installation surface doctor (#2034).** `ouroboros doctor install` reports every active surface: Python package, Codex plugin and cache, Claude Code plugin and cache, user-level MCP config, ZCode bridge. It repairs nothing, by design. `ooo --version` was never proof that every client integration was current, and now there is a read-only command that says so with paths and versions instead of vibes.

**[@sumin220](https://github.com/sumin220) — update nudge reachability (closes #2066), and the legacy identity seam (#1899).** The plugin MCP descriptor is now version-pinned and synced by the same release-prep pass as `plugin.json`, so a plugin update deterministically changes the uvx cache key; the SessionStart notice moved to stdout, the channel that actually enters agent context; and `mcp serve` appends the cached notice to its server instructions, so Codex, OpenCode, Kiro and every other MCP host finally receives it. The notice reads only the local cache, never the network, and can never delay or fail server startup. Separately, #1899 moved the pre-anchor project-identity path behind one observable seam with a finite, dated support window — sessions started before the Project Map anchor keep their resume authority, one decision point emits a structured local event when the legacy path activates, and removing the seam after the window requires a documented breaking change naming the last identity-compatible release. Log absence never authorizes deletion.

**[@bokjk](https://github.com/bokjk) — native Windows Codex Desktop HTTP task persistence RFC (#2101).** Backed by preflight evidence gathered on real Windows 11 rather than assumed from documentation: `RestartOnFailure` did *not* relaunch on exit code 7 or on `0xC0000005`, while `RegistrationTrigger` with one-minute repetition did. The RFC therefore promises evidence-backed periodic launch attempts instead of claiming failure-aware restart — and replaces HKCU Run with one explicit opt-in, least-privilege Scheduled Task contract.

**[@dj-wishket](https://github.com/dj-wishket) and John — hooks fail-open and trust boundaries (#2111 and follow-ups).** Hooks now fail open when the plugin cache root disappears, align Codex development fail-open behavior, and reject untrusted packaged fallback roots. A hook that hard-fails on a missing cache directory blocks the user from working; a hook that trusts an arbitrary fallback root is worse. Both edges are now closed.

---

## Track 3 — Test and CI performance

The suite had grown expensive in a way that taxes every contributor on every push. Eleven changes went after it, and none of them weakened a contract: every retry count, every degradation path, every ratio assertion still holds. What was removed was waiting.

**CI shape (#2142).** Every PR previously ran the full suite three times — 3.12, 3.13, 3.14 — with coverage instrumentation, roughly 15 minutes and three runners per PR. PRs now gate on the 3.12 floor without coverage; pushes to `main` keep the full matrix, the litellm-free dependency profile, and Codecov upload. **PR gate ~15 min → ~4–6 min, three runners → one.** Version-specific regressions move from PR-time to merge-time detection, still strictly before release.

**Wall-clock in the suite itself:**

- `install.sh` runtime-selection tests were the largest CPU sink at ~80s, because macOS charges a ~0.3s system scan on the first exec of every newly created executable and the harness wrote fresh stubs per test. Caching the stubs took the worst test **7.59s → 0.64s** and the file **~80s → ~33s** (#2134).
- The codex help-probe contract tests stalled a real 5s each on the probe budget; injecting `HELP_PROBE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS` took **5.01s + 5.01s + 3.02s → all sub-second**, with the production default unchanged. The contract under test was that an overrun means uncertainty, not how long the overrun lasts (#2136).
- Retry-ladder tests slept through the real production backoff. Mocking only those sleeps took each affected test **~3.0s → ~0.01s** while still asserting the retry attempt counts (#2137).
- The picker projection budget benchmark — the single largest time block in the unit suite, two parametrizations alone at 16.6s and 15.9s — halved its bulk event count to 50k. It asserts ratios, not absolutes (#2133).
- Fingerprint tests stub git identity and version probes (#2138); conftest renders logged exceptions with plain tracebacks instead of rich ones (#2132); `api_retry` backoff is overridable for shell tests (#2135).

**And tests that stopped breaking for the wrong reason.** Documentation contract tests now assert durable anchors — section headings, command and tool invocation strings — instead of verbatim prose, some of which had been pinned to specific line-wrap positions (#2131). Removing a documented command still fails the suite; rewording around it no longer does. `test_detached_auto_docs.py` shrank 969 → 518 lines while keeping every behavioral test. Copy-paste variants in the orchestrator and auto suites were folded into parametrized tables (#2139, #2140, #2141), and the install one-liner test now checks every documented one-liner rather than only the first (#2130).

---

## Track 4 — `auto` stops overstating what it finished

The loop's account of its own work is load-bearing. Four changes made it more honest.

- The Seed QA gate is advisory rather than a dead end (#2119), and now carries a bounded, normalized transport diagnostic in the durable advisory event so a transient evaluator failure leaves evidence instead of silence (#2144).
- Retired persisted phases explain their migration path *before* the production watchdog can rewrite the result as a generic timeout (#2145). A migration notice reported as "timed out" sends the operator to the wrong problem.
- `run` successors are delegated to the run job's own chain (#2120), and `auto` no longer calls a Seed complete when it never ran a verified product (#2127).

---

## Toward 1.0.0

The remaining distance is not measured in features. It is measured in how many claims this system makes that it cannot back — and this release retired several: in the install surface, in the health report, in the audit metadata, and in the loop's own account of what it finished. Meanwhile the door widened, and more of the work now arrives from outside this desk.

That is what 1.0.0 requires. There is less of it left than there was.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/compare/v0.51.5...v0.51.6

releases.name: v0.51.7
releases.body:
## Ouroboros now installs into DeepSeek Harness in one command

Ouroboros already spoke to DeepSeek in one direction: `--llm-backend dsh` points the interview/Seed/QA pipeline at DeepSeek's own models. This release answers the other direction — how a DeepSeek Harness user mounts Ouroboros — and replaces the hand-copied `--patch` overlay with a real, installable bundle:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add "github:Q00/ouroboros#main&path:integrations/dsh-plugin"
```

Type `ooo interview <goal>` or `ooo auto <goal>` in a dsh chat afterward and the model finds the matching tool on its own — all 36 Ouroboros MCP tools register as `mcp__ouroboros__*`. The bundle ships no plugin code: it is one `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row spawning `uvx --from 'ouroboros-ai[mcp]' ouroboros mcp serve` over stdio, so `uv` on `PATH` is the only prerequisite.

Three boundary facts the bundle gets right, each traced into a running dsh rather than assumed:

- **Credentials do not travel implicitly.** dsh scrubs every credential-shaped name (`/KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN/i`) out of a child process by design, and a plugin's explicit `env` layer merges after that scrub. The bundle names a short allowlist (`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`) instead of a wildcard passthrough, and documents how to forward one more from your own profile.
- **`OUROBOROS_LLM_BACKEND=dsh` is not a one-variable switch.** Ouroboros spawns its own `dsh-acp-demo` child, which fails closed unless `OUROBOROS_DSH_CONFIG_PATH` names an absolute composition. Both prerequisites now reach the child, and the full procedure is documented rather than implied.
- **Startup recovery is honest.** A machine without `uv` still boots dsh with every other plugin working — but the published mcp-client has no reconnect loop, and the current one gives up after a bounded attempt budget, so the README says "reload the plugin or restart dsh" instead of promising backoff.

## `ooo update` refreshes both hosts together

`--runtime all` upgrades the Ouroboros Codex marketplace and refreshes the Claude plugin in one pass, then runs `ouroboros setup refresh` for the installed artifacts. Your configured execution backend is preserved rather than silently reassigned to whichever host was refreshed last. The restart contract is documented too: Claude reloads plugins in place, while an active Codex session has to restart.
## What's Changed

releases.body:
This patch is mostly about the install path and about runs that tell you the truth when they go sideways.

The DeepSeek Harness integration gets a real installer story: `install.sh` now installs the dsh plugin when DSH is present, and — after two rounds of hardening — prints profile names you can actually paste back into a shell. The second round matters more than it sounds: the escaping added for terminal-control safety was delegating to `printf %q`, which on macOS's bash 3.2 escapes only part of a multibyte character. A profile named with an RTL override printed as invalid UTF-8 with the override half-neutralised. It now escapes byte-wise into printable ASCII, byte-identical on bash 3.2 and 5.3, and every quoted word round-trips.

On the run side, dirty worktrees no longer bleed into each other and observer handoffs survive; the CLI now asks the question its own ambiguity score implies rather than a generic one; and disposable artifacts moved into SQLite instead of loose files.

### Features
- Store disposable artifacts in SQLite (#2171)
- Install the dsh plugin when DeepSeek Harness is present (#2165)
- Let an advisory lane answer from what was recently found here (#2154)

### Bug Fixes
- Quote dsh profile names without bash 3.2's broken `printf %q` — macOS emitted invalid UTF-8 and only half-escaped RTL overrides
- Isolate dirty runs and preserve observer handoffs (#2178)
- Ask the question the ambiguity score implies (#2176)
- Preserve DSH profile names in recovery output (#2170)
- Say the advisory findings body is a list, because it is (#2162)

releases.name: v0.51.12 — Verification Must Never Rewrite Reality
releases.body:
# v0.51.12 — Verification Must Never Rewrite Reality

> PR #1916 and RFC #1917 closed the hidden-checklist convergence loop: the worker could no longer see the answer key, and rejected results could continue through evaluation and bounded evolution. This release closes the remaining verification boundary.
>
> Machine verification is now monotonic. It may add evidence. It may reject a genuinely failed check. It may never erase a worker failure, manufacture a success, or retry completed work merely because the verifier itself is unavailable.

## What's Changed

### Monotonic verification
- Separate worker execution facts from machine-verification facts.
- Preserve successful completed work when Bash, command startup, timeout handling, or transcript verification is unavailable; report the result explicitly as unverified instead of rewriting it as failure.
- Keep genuine `verify_command` failures authoritative when rejecting otherwise successful work.
- Add `VerifierStatus.UNAVAILABLE` without retry or redispatch authority.

### Monotonic evidence
- Keep `files_touched`, `commands_run`, and `tests_passed` obligations even when a `verify_command` exists.
- Prevent a passing verifier command from recovering a failed worker execution.
- Preserve the Seed authoring warning and explicit `verify_exemption_reason` for criteria without a machine command.

### Trusted verification boundary
- Execute verification only through a resolved, absolute, real Bash implementation across POSIX and Windows Git Bash environments.
- Never substitute `cmd.exe`, WSL launchers, `sh`, or shell emulation.
- Strip environment controls capable of bending a verdict, including Bash startup hooks, exported functions, preload hooks, and pytest, Python, and Node controls.
- Contain timed-out and cancelled verifier process trees.

### Deliberate simplification
- Remove the shell-free Bash interpreter, constant-verdict proof machinery, workspace baseline probes, verdict tiers, and durable prototype policy.
- Leave sandboxed discrimination research outside the critical `ooo run` path rather than pretending an unsandboxed verifier can prove more than it observed.

## Why this release matters

A convergence loop is trustworthy only if its judge cannot rewrite the work it judges. #1916 and #1917 gave the loop secrecy, independent judgment, and recurrence. #2187 gives that judgment its final invariant: verification can strengthen the record, but never reverse history.

This is the closing movement of that loop-engineering line: not a larger loop, but a harder boundary around truth.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/compare/v0.51.11...v0.51.12


## What's Changed

releases.body:
## Hardening pass

No new surface in this patch — it closes the ways the engine could quietly stall, lie, or break outside a POSIX shell.

**Nothing hangs forever.** Every subprocess wait is now bounded (#2239), transient classifier contexts are capped (#2256), and retries got precise transient matching with default jitter and logging (#2240). File locks release independently of `ContextVar` reset (#2235), so a lock no longer outlives the task that took it.

**Guards fail closed.** `is_on_protected_branch` now refuses rather than guesses (#2236). The Seed schema closed four validation gaps (#2238) and rejects empty reference-aware contracts (#2226). Constant verification reads *every* occurrence before declaring a constant verified (#2220). The orchestrator stopped emitting drift measurements it already knew were wrong (#2233).

**Windows and non-ASCII paths.** Git output in the worktree layer (#2248) and the CI module-size source (#2251) decode as UTF-8; test evidence wrapped by PowerShell is accepted (#2245).

**Interactive bridge.** `/ooo` argument completion (#2204) and native system-prompt + tool allow-list delivery (#2203) landed, plus reusable fanout provenance for interviews (#2260).

releases.name: v0.53.0
releases.body:
## v0.53.0 — Proof over trust, and an install path that needs no Python

Two milestones land in this release.

### The verify gate now demands evidence

Until now an agent could *say* it touched the files and *say* the tests passed,
and the orchestrator largely took it at its word. In 0.53.0 every one of those
claims is either backed by an independent observation or re-run:

- `files_touched` is checked against a harness workspace observation (#2312)
- unprovable `tests_passed` claims are re-run inside the harness (#2313)
- `verify_command` is **replayed** at final settlement instead of being rejected
  on a stale digest (#2314)
- transcript-proven functional verification is admitted as first-class evidence
  under the verify-gate authority, so honest work is no longer punished (#2333)

Net effect: a green run means something now. The gate withholds credit it cannot
prove, and grants it where the proof exists.

### Install without Python

Ouroboros no longer assumes a working Python on the machine:

- a native **PowerShell installer for Windows** (#2309)
- macOS/Linux installs bootstrap `uv` themselves when nothing else can (#2323)
- the **Homebrew formula is bumped automatically** on every stable release (#2321)

### Lifecycle: fewer zombies, quieter serves

- `mcp serve` gets a hard-exit backstop and a stdin dead-peer watchdog, so a
  serve whose client is gone actually dies (#2331)
- idle network serves are bounded and job polling is incremental (#2328)
- GJC reclaims broker-owned worker sessions on terminal turns and on
  termination (#2327)

### Less friction

- Seed QA is **advisory**: the blocking QA-until-PASS loop is retired (#2329)
- the orchestrator preflights the runtime before dispatch and stops retrying
  auth failures and provider 5xx (#2316)
- codex selects the `workspace-write` sandbox explicitly after `exec` dropped
  `--full-auto` (#2324), and main-repo-root automatic trust is exempted from
  config-drift rejection for worktree cwds (#2332)
- the dead `.claude-plugin/skills` copy is gone; its Claude gate was ported to
  the live tree (#2330)

---

releases.name: v0.54.0
releases.body:
## v0.54.0 — Claude Code can connect again, plus a new runtime

### Upgrade now if you are on 0.53.0

0.53.0 shipped a zombie-prevention watchdog (#2331) that accidentally made the
MCP server exit ~5 ms after `initialize` whenever its stdin is a UNIX socketpair.
That is how every Node/libuv client wires child stdio, so **Claude Code and any
other Node-based MCP host saw `Connected · tools fetch failed — Connection
closed`** and never loaded a tool. Python clients (ordinary pipes) were unaffected,
which is why it slipped through.

The cause was one call: `setblocking(False)` on a *duplicate* of fd 0. `O_NONBLOCK`
lives on the open file description the duplicate shares with the original, so the
SDK's blocking `readline` read EOF the moment the socket went idle. The probe now
peeks with `MSG_PEEK | MSG_DONTWAIT` and touches no shared descriptor state (#2351,
refs #2337). Thank you to the reporter for a repro script that ran unchanged.

If you applied the `sh -c "cat | uvx ... ouroboros mcp serve"` workaround, remove
it after upgrading. `.mcp.json` runs `uvx` unpinned, so most installs pick up
0.54.0 automatically.

### New: OMP (Oh My Pi) runtime

Ouroboros can now drive OMP as both a worker runtime and an LLM backend (#2299).

### Lateral thinking grounds its decisions

`ooo lateral` gains a grounded decision-advisory mode with web evidence and an
ADR bridge, and Seeds can be produced without a full interview when the decision
is already grounded — RFC P1–P4 (#2336).

### Also fixed

- **workflow-ir**: `{criterion, semantic_ac_key}` entries keep their persisted AC
  identity instead of being rehashed (#2352, refs #2338). Thanks to
  @wjswlgnsdlqslek for the report and the loader fix.
- **run**: verify-gate mutations are attributed to their cause, run failures name
  their root cause, and concurrent codex trust writes from a second terminal no
  longer take a run down (#2342)
- **codex**: mid-run drift of frozen authority inputs is observed instead of
  failing the run (#2343); `renameat2` without `RENAME_NOREPLACE` degrades
  gracefully (#2274)
- **auto**: the grade-gate `stop_reason_code` is typed (#2341); the ambiguity gate
  override rate is surfaced (#2286)

---
## What's Changed
* feat(lateral): grounded decision advisory + interview-less seed — RFC P1–P4 by @Q00 in https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/pull/2336
* feat(runtime): add OMP (Oh My Pi) runtime and LLM backend by @noizbuster in https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/pull/2299
* fix(codex): degrade when renameat2 rejects RENAME_NOREPLACE by @bjkim95 in https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/pull/2274
* feat: surface ambiguity gate override rate by @kuilinggg in https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/pull/2286

releases.body:
## Highlights

**Verifier false-rejection stack (#2376, #2377, #2378).** Three independent
ways the evidence gate rejected work that had actually been done, now closed:
transcript-proven functional checks of sibling artifacts are admitted, named
`files_touched` claims on harness-witnessed verification-only runs are admitted,
and command matching peels nested shell wrappers instead of failing on them.
Measured on the codex bench: 3/9 → 10/10 successful runs.

**CLI workflow outcome telemetry (#2382, #2383).** CLI runs now record their
workflow outcome, including non-success terminations — the first pass counted
only successes because the emitter's sender was torn down before flush on the
`typer.Exit` path.

**Seed origin stamping (#2375).** Seeds carry their origin, so interview-less
adoption is visible in telemetry rather than indistinguishable from the
interview path.

## Highlights

**Run failures are named, not `unknown` (#2387).** 42% of failed `run`
outcomes on 0.54.x reached telemetry as `unknown` with no `failure_cause`,
because three paths never went through the failure-cause derivation: runs
rejected before launch (dirty-checkout workspace, seed validation, resume
blocks, config, prepare), job terminals recovered after a restart from linked
execution evidence, and background evaluate jobs. A single typed
`JobWorkError` carrier now lifts a closed cause into the failed terminal
payload; pre-launch rejections report one of six `launch_*` causes, recovered
terminals derive the same cause as the live path, and evaluate jobs carry the
branch-level `failure_reason_code` the direct path already reported. The
client-visible error text of the synchronous `ouroboros_execute_seed` tool is
unchanged.

releases.name: v0.54.5
releases.body:
## Security fix release

**GHSA-7j6g-gw2r-mw48 (High, CWE-94)** — an untrusted project `.env` could inject `PYTHONPATH` (and `PYTHONHOME`, `PYTHONSTARTUP`, `NODE_PATH`, ...) into every child process Ouroboros spawns, including the detached job worker. The worker's interpreter then imported an attacker-controlled `sitecustomize` before any Ouroboros code ran: arbitrary code execution when running Ouroboros inside a malicious repository. Incomplete fix of CVE-2026-66065; reported by 0xRomSec via coordinated disclosure.

**Fix (#2404)** — the untrusted-`.env` denylist now covers the Python and Node runtime-loader controls and the `NPM_CONFIG_`, `YARN_`, `PNPM_`, `COREPACK_` and `GIT_` families, plus seven same-class keys found by the accompanying threat-model scan. Trusted sources (`~/.ouroboros/.env` and the real process environment) are unchanged.

**Upgrade**: run `ouroboros update` (or `ooo update` from Claude Code / Codex). Advisory: https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/security/advisories/GHSA-7j6g-gw2r-mw48

Also in this release: cancelled MCP client connections are cleaned up (#2365), Python version probes work on Windows PowerShell (#2398), Chinese translation of the DeepSeek harness guide (#2400).

releases.name: v0.54.6
releases.body:
## Highlights

**MCP servers no longer outlive their client session when a stdio bridge is configured (#2325).** When Claude Code or Codex exited, it closed the server's stderr socket. The next log line then raised `BrokenPipeError`, which silently skipped shutdown, so the server and its bridged upstream tree (for example chrome-devtools or context7 from `~/.ouroboros/mcp_servers.yaml`) stayed alive indefinitely. Now a log call never raises into its caller. And after cleanup, any task the server spawned that is still alive is cancelled; if it refuses to finish within one grace period, the server is force-exited. In our reproduction, the server now exits in about 0.6s instead of hanging (#2433).

**Config edits keep UTF-8 settings intact** across edits and undo (#2431).

If you applied the workaround from #2325 (redirecting stderr to a file, or removing the stdio bridge entry), you can revert it after upgrading.

## What's Changed
* docs(skills): fix Getting Started links that 404 from shipped skills by @PerryLink in https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/pull/2427
* fix(config): preserve UTF-8 settings across edits and undo by @zittenyetten in https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/pull/2431
* fix(mcp): exit stdio serve when the client closes stderr with a bridge attached by @Q00 in https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/pull/2433
* docs(readme): sync Chinese README with the English source, fix critical Copilot and extras guidance by @lg114 in https://github.com/Q00/ouroboros/pull/2430

releases.body:
## What's Changed
* docs: correct what 0.52.0 changed, and give documentation drift a page by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2480
* feat(perf): plans that claim only what they can back, and an over-fetch detector by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2495

* fix(security): detect vendor credential shapes and PEM keys, not just variable names by @Aman-goel-04 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2223
* refactor(workspace): one dialect base for every contract type, and topics that follow RabbitMQ bindings by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2501

* fix(ui): scroll only the tab row when ViewTabs reveals its active tab by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2498
* feat(workspace): open co-changing file pairs in a drawer, with search and cap reporting by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2499
* feat(workspace): replace the System Map inspector with a drawer, lenses and findings by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2500
* fix(security): mask secrets in every stored snippet, and clear rows stored raw by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2496
* fix(communities): never name a community after a third-party module by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2502
* feat(graph): bundle community links in the Files view, and make it the default by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2503
* feat(perf): promote plans on facts that settle their prerequisites by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2504
* refactor(php): one composer reader and framework-facts registry, with PHP references the graph used to miss by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2505

* refactor(search): move query-shape routing into a module with no database import by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2511
* feat(laravel): serve routes under their groups, link registrations, and read migrations as tables by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2512
* feat(perf): read session.get as a query, and prove fewer batch plans than before by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2513
* feat(perf): keep repetition with nothing to change out of the default queue by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2514
* fix(health): keep the test named for a file when a validation list is capped by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2515
* fix(ui): give the health map the expected actionability state by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2520
* refactor(core): move knowledge silo ranking and onboarding targets into core by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2517

* fix(test-impact): report a failed head-commit read as degraded instead of absent by @Aman-goel-04 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2529
* fix(providers): make opencode subprocess concurrency configurable via shared resolver by @Aman-goel-04 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2485
* fix(mcp): keep pathless symbol rows out of get_answer's homonym union by @8rulerstar in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2391
* fix(cli): honor REPOWISE_MODEL environment variable in provider resolution by @Tyagiquamar in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2276
* fix(rust): inherit `impl` block visibility from target type/trait declaration (#2389) by @rishu685 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2427
* fix(health): count Pascal for-in loops, add a performance dialect by @Laex in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2233

releases.body:
## What's Changed
* docs(plugin): say what the Claude Code plugin runs and what leaves the machine by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3041
* release(vscode): 0.11.0 by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3042
* fix(plugin): pass the plugin directory's checks by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3043
* fix(tests): remove claude plugin manifest claim from COUNT_CLAIMS by @justonemorenight in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3045
* fix(workspace): queue missing-fingerprint reindex under a shared database by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3044
* fix(persistence): loosen PostgreSQL columns at startup so Docker upgrades need no Alembic step by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3068
* fix(decisions): say how many decisions were kept from how many candidates by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3088
* fix(answer): give reasoning models room to write the synthesized answer by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3094
* feat(update): index uncommitted work with repowise update --working-tree by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3095
* fix(risk): pair FooTest.java, FooTests.cs and FooSpec.kt with their source by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3096
* feat(context): add the skeleton+ view: every signature with its lines and all non-function code by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3097
* fix(mcp): resolve Class.method and bare unique names the same way everywhere by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3099
* ci: run unit tests across all runner cores with pytest-xdist by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3098
* fix(mcp): stop searches waiting 30s for a readiness signal nothing tracks by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3115
* feat(risk): list the test files a change will probably need to edit by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3101
* fix(answer): keep the retrieval ranking first in keyless citations by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3102
* perf(update): skip history and analysis phases on a working-tree-only update by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3107
* feat(answer): serve a compact ranked shortlist on low and keyless answers by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3108
* fix(editor-files): steer agents correctly on keyless indexes and mid-edit by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3109
* feat(answer): rank files named in a stack trace or by identifier in the question first by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3116
* fix(tests): count keyless candidate_files the way the citation rule serves them by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3122
* fix(mcp): mark served targets with uncommitted edits instead of calling them fresh by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3100
* refactor(risk): one test list and no empty families in the get_risk PR directive by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3117
* perf(risk): serve the PR blast radius only on request by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3118
* fix(risk): stop risk summaries from overstating or understating a change by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3123
* refactor(risk): drop the uncalibrated structural score from get_risk replies by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3124
* docs(mcp): tighten the search_codebase docstring by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3125
* feat(search): rank files the query names first and return an exact symbol alone by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3127
* feat(mcp): list every edit site of a symbol, verified against live files by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3126
* feat(mcp): accept a grep-style pattern argument as the search query by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3128
* feat(search): name the matching symbols and lines inside each file hit by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3130
* feat(search): return matching source lines for identifier and literal queries by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3131
* feat(mcp): tell agents when to reach for repowise instead of a text search by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3134
* feat(symbol): outline a large class instead of returning its whole body by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3136
* feat(answer): serve a ranked file list when keyless retrieval is weak by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3137
* feat(context): keep only the target symbol's body in a symbol skeleton by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3135
* fix(change-risk): floor and cap the 'bigger than N%' percentile at 99 by @Nehant14 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3120
* fix(gemini): drop additionalProperties from tool schemas by @mercael91 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3064
* fix(test-paths): count __mocks__ anywhere and the other .NET test-project suffixes by @ybai08 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2669
* fix(health): a repo with no scored file has no score, not 10.0 by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3053
* docs(reference): add the API facts OpenAPI cannot carry by @sloemo01 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2342
* fix(test-paths): classify Perl-style t/ as a Python test tree (#2962) by @soumojit-D48 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3046
* fix(go): capture a generic call written with explicit type arguments by @ybai08 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2992
* fix(uninstall): list and remove the post-commit hook that init installs by @Aman-goel-04 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2655
* fix(ingestion): support comments in tsconfig.json and jsconfig.json (#3058) by @rishu685 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3067
* fix(providers): default anthropic and claude_cli to claude-haiku-5-5 by @sammcj in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3093
* fix(cli): drop a stale embedding_model pin when init resolves none by @Aman-goel-04 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2654
* fix(health): stop knowledge_loss firing on a pure-rename-only commit window by @Aman-goel-04 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3075
* fix(mcp): stop watchdog walk at unnamed or dead ancestor by @Aman-goel-04 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3142
* fix(mcp): anchor fix history recency to indexed commit instead of wall clock (#3110) by @rishu685 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3145
* fix(generation): sort wiki backlinks deterministically before applying cap (#2792) by @rishu685 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2881
* fix(editor-files): separate the confidence and scope sentences in the CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md header (#3103) by @tecsmurf in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3144
* feat(web): i18n foundation (next-intl + English fallback + catalog gates) by @limitcool in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3129
* feat(web): add the zh-CN catalog and the language switcher by @limitcool in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3151
* refactor(providers): share one base for agent CLI providers by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3167
* feat(providers): declare every LLM provider once, as a ProviderSpec by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3168
* feat(agents): add the Basic tier and an Indexing column by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3169
* feat(init): default the provider picker to the agent you use by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3171
* fix(settings): read provider, embedder and price facts from the server by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3172
* feat(agents): add GitHub Copilot CLI and Kiro targets, Copilot instructions for VS Code by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3173
* docs(agents): add the agent platform recipe for contributors by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3178
* feat(agents): rewrite Cursor shell commands through a preToolUse hook by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3177
* fix(mcp): accept a query argument as the symbol id in get_symbol by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3140
* fix(search): match path queries against filename words by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3180
* fix(answer): lead the keyless answer with the top retrieval file by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3184
* fix(answer): trim keyless medium answers on large repos by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3186
* fix(context): cap one file's reference sites so a mock-heavy test cannot flood the list by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3183
* feat(graph): bind names destructured from a dynamic import() by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3181
* feat(search): return the best-matching lines for prose queries by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3189
* fix(doctor): join the stderr drain before building the crash detail by @Pushpak731 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3165

releases.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(ui): close contract gaps for hosts that deploy separately from the UI package by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3566
* feat(health): order Fix first by the function's own change history by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3565
* docs(readme): hosted and Foresight near the top, with one way in to each by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3574
* feat(health): say what a Break up split buys in its reason by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3581
* fix(jvm): resolve Kotlin imports of top-level functions and properties by @Aman-goel-04 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3407
* fix(jvm): flag Java and Kotlin public API for published modules (#3504) by @rishu685 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3577
* fix(core): recognize literal Python lazy exports by @z2Ace0107 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3570
* feat(health): a complexity map for Swift by @ybai08 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3450
* fix(dataflow): a grouped Go var declares its names by @ybai08 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3472
* docs(health): update class metrics availability for Dart, F#, and Obj-C by @AlaminSaifullah in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3479
* fix: name keyless upgrade commands in init, status, and get_answer by @Aman-goel-04 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3143
* fix(health): lead a Fix first finding with the stored plan its first step lifts by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3582
* feat(refactoring): test commands for Go, Rust, JVM and Ruby plans by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3585
* feat(health): hold back layers measured below the precision bar per language by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/2921
* feat(refactoring): run a plan's C# tests with dotnet test by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3583
* feat(refactoring): leave the Extract Method helper's name to the person applying the plan by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3588
* fix(health): bind the catch variable as a def in Java, C# and C++ dataflow dialects by @Aman-goel-04 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3483
* fix(health): state the performance queue's reason on every finding and settle example-path contexts by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3612
* fix(graph): bind Kotlin alias imports by alias and drop the fake wildcard module by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3607
* fix(graph): type Kotlin constructor properties and Swift stored properties as receivers by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3609
* feat(graph): type Dart call receivers from fields, parameters and locals by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3610
* fix(graph): a module alias reaches only the module's top-level declarations by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3617
* fix(swift): a subscript read is not a call by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3618
* fix(graph): give Java same-arity overloads and enum-constant methods their own node by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3616
* fix(swift): an extension is not a constructible class by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3619
* fix(graph): type Java call chains, inherited fields, super and cast receivers by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3623
* fix(jvm): the same-package tier no longer offers another class's method by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3620
* fix(graph): an overload tie never lands on an overload that can't take the call's arguments by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3625
* fix(index-scope): stop reporting a keyless index as upgrading by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3634
* fix(tests): ignore type-only conftest imports when narrowing test selection by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3633
* fix(health): let a production origin keep example-named packages in Fix first by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3629
* fix(tests): count only the base side of the index gap by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3628
* fix(change-risk): count only fixes from before the change in the line-overlap block by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3632
* fix(graph): give Java anonymous-class and Kotlin object-expression methods their own node by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3624
* feat(graph): link Spring routes to their handler methods by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3650
* chore(deps): bump tree-sitter-swift to 0.7.4 by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3647
* fix(graph): resolve Java's qualified S.super.m() through the super walk by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3671
* fix(health): classify Dart codegen, minified bundles and webpack chunks as generated by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3637
* fix(dead-code): read generated files as unindexed users by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3639
* fix(dead-code): say why a safe-only view is empty by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3646
* fix(health): stop counting a try block as a nesting level by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3648

* fix(graph): make a Java @interface and its elements symbols by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3670
* fix(mcp): resolve Class.method and Class::method targets with no file by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3635
* fix(health): withhold the headline band when most code files are unanalysed by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3641
* fix(dead-code): a module with a program main is run, not a zombie or unused export by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3645
* fix(tests): run @SpringBootTest integration tests with every selection by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3636
* fix(mcp): complete reference edit sets for Go, Java and Kotlin packages by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3642
* fix(health): roll anonymous-class members up to their named owner by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3643
* fix(graph): let Kotlin, Swift and Dart parameters shadow a bare call by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3679
* fix(graph): bind a bare Kotlin call to an extension only with its receiver in scope by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3681
* fix(mcp): name the nearest symbols when a get_context target misses by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3638
* fix(health): name one worst file on every surface by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3653
* fix(dead-code): Gradle and Android entry roots for convention plugins, test modules and manifests by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3657
* fix(mcp): read freshness and live files from the served checkout by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3644
* fix(doctor): note a Claude Code MCP entry that serves another repo by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3649
* fix(tests): let next see tests that reach a file through a package barrel by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3651
* fix(why): say when the index has no accepted decisions or the path is missing by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3654
* fix(why): cap git_log at five and state history provenance once per block by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3655
* fix(health): word ownership_risk by the arm that fired, cap small files at low, rank test-file findings last by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3656
* fix(health): hold a flat boolean chain at low in complex_conditional by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3665
* fix(health): count a language-gated unit once in queue counts by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3667
* fix(distill): honour git log -n and keep each commit's author by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3660
* fix(health): make get_health cards, gap and count fields agree with the score by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3683
* fix(security): stop raising high findings on fixtures, scripts and bundles by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3685
* fix(graph): choose Java overloads by literal argument types and by arity against inherited overloads by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3672
* fix(graph): let a Java member type shadow a same-named import or package type by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3669
* fix(health): keep sweep commits and inheritance out of hidden coupling by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3686
* fix(dead-code): a co-change edge is not an importer in JVM, Go and C++ reachability by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3658
* fix(graph): keep name-only call tiers inside the caller's build by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3682
* fix(graph): never offer a Kotlin or Swift property as a bare call's callee by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3680
* fix(security): exempt __html type keywords only in type positions by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3687
* fix(health): record no hotspots as null in the trend, not 10.0 by @swati510 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3684
* fix(perf): drop perf rows that are the recommended idiom or stated intent by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3611
* refactor(refactoring): store JS/TS test commands in validation.test_runs by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/3613

releases.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(ingestion): stop one file from hanging or exhausting the parse by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4738
* fix(update): persist updates for a subdirectory index and scope git rows to it by @Marko0519 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4195
* feat(plugins): list every plugin registration, load plugin providers, add SeamRegistry.all and PLUGIN_API_VERSION by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4741
* docs(plugins): add a plugin author guide, a hello example plugin and a test that keeps it working by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4742
* docs(readme): lead with the agent savings, a new hero and plain-English benchmarks by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4750
* fix(health): stop flagging flat boolean chains as compound conditions by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4754
* fix(health): skip cancellation catches and documented fallbacks in error_handling, state facts in idiom reasons by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4755
* fix(server): take the update lock in background syncs and never overwrite newer health rows by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4756
* fix(health): stop primitive_obsession on CLI commands, keyword-only and framework-bound parameters, and same-file overrides by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4758
* fix(health): name C++ reference, operator, destructor and macro-prefixed functions by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4766
* fix(health): skip lock_in_loop when the lock belongs to the loop element by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4767
* fix(health): a switch opens one nesting level, its case arms none by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4762
* fix(coverage): drop files whose report lines no longer match the source at ingest by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4761
* fix(health): count Python pathlib-named calls as file IO only on a path receiver by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4764
* fix(health): stop god_class judging one part of a split partial class or a stateless mixin as the whole class by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4759
* fix(health): count TSX style objects and data props as markup, not code by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4760
* fix(health): stop defer_in_loop and list_insert_zero_in_loop firing when a later statement ends the loop by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4768
* fix(health): stop counting abstract, interface and extern methods as function units by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4772
* fix(health): make three performance findings say only what the code shows by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4773
* fix(health): say what held-back findings deduct in get_health, and describe the change-risk score basis by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4776
* fix(code-origin): class parser-generator output as generated and copied single-file libraries as vendored by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4784
* fix(health): stop pairing the shared skeleton of sibling files as duplication by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4788
* fix(health): keep coverage markers off empty files and code that does not ship by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4765
* fix(health): stop sql_select_star on EXISTS and explicit-column sources, skip temp-table DML by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4775
* fix(health): repeated_nesting becomes advisory by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4757
* fix(health): price refactoring and fix gains by rescoring the file, not summing health_impact by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4763
* fix(health): count a match guard once and skip for-each iterables in condition counts by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4783
* fix(health): make the headline split add up and mark advisory rows in the CLI findings table by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4770
* fix(health): treat extern C signatures as fixed and a condition-variable wait guard as unhoistable by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4781
* fix(ingestion): parse C++ classes behind export macros and fields behind thread-safety annotations by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4785
* fix(health): scope finding status updates to the requested repository by @jsolemd in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4725
* fix(serve): preserve an explicit REPOWISE_DATABASE_URL by @jsolemd in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4726
* fix(health): give Dart constructors, accessors and operators distinct names and count bare on handlers by @RaghavChamadiya in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4782
* fix(cli): surface broken built-in seam imports in `repowise plugins` by @Asymtode712 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4748
* fix(ui): keep the Overview header intact while a job runs by @jgt87 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4735
* feat(salesforce): link flow references from Aura, Visualforce, and Flexipage by @ZhangDT-sky in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4701
* feat(workspace): read Dapr pub/sub topics in .NET and Subscription manifests by @thymeed in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4729
* feat(workspace): read Ktor server routing and Javalin routes as HTTP providers by @ozenyunus35 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4644
* fix(data): record the schema= keyword on Alembic create_table providers by @Yi-111-a in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4192
* fix(augment): preserve leading dot for dot-directory paths in decision_inject and glob_rescue by @aazminu in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4027
* fix(ingestion): prefer the unique nearest COBOL mapset on ties by @ANO3457 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4743
* fix(analysis): track brace depth in C# interpolated strings during masking by @ANO3457 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4625
* fix(cli): persist provider to config.yaml on complete generate (#4280) by @rishu685 in https://github.com/repowise-dev/repowise/pull/4344
